key_verses.en: You may hate a thing though it is good for you — and love a thing though it is bad (sharr) for you
The worst (sharra) of living creatures are the deaf and dumb who do not reason
Whoever does an atom weight of evil (sharr) will see it
From the evil (sharr) of that which He created — repeated 4x
It throws sparks (sharar) like castles

quranic_analysis.sharr_vs_khayr: Sharr (evil) is the Quranic opposite of khayr (good). Tested with both (21:35). Allah hastens khayr but delays sharr (10:11).

dual_sense: Ibn Faris: root originally meant scattering (like sparks from fire). Moral evil is that which scatters harmony and well-being — a metaphorical extension from physical dispersion.

meaning.en: To calculate, reckon, think, suppose; sufficiency. Ibn Faris: core = enumeration/computation (al-'add wa al-ihsa'). Tripartite Quranic meaning: (1) Reckoning/account — hisāb (39x), yawm al-hisāb (Day of Account); (2) Thinking/supposing — hasiba (44x), classified among zanna and her sisters; (3) Sufficiency/enough — hasb (11x) — "Allah is sufficient for us" (3:173). Al-Hasīb = The Reckoner (Divine Name).
meaning.ar: العد والإحصاء — الحساب: المحاسبة — والحسب: الكفاية

key_verses.en: Every soul shall be paid in full — context of reckoning (hisāb)
Hasbunā Allāhu wa ni'ma al-wakīl — Allah is sufficient for us
Does man think (ayahsabu) We will not assemble his bones?
He provides from where he does not expect (lā yahtasibu)

quranic_analysis.tripartite: One root, three Quranic domains: calculation, thinking, sufficiency. All trace to Ibn Faris core: enumeration.

meaning.en: To fulfill, complete, pay in full; loyalty; death (euphemism). Ibn Faris: core = completion/fulfillment (tamām). Waffā (II, 18x) = to pay reward in full. Awfā (IV, 18x) = to fulfill covenant (awfū bi-'ahdī, 2:40). Tawaffā (V, 24x) = to take in full — Quranic euphemism for death: Allah "takes souls fully" (39:42). Awfā (adj, 2x) = fullest recompense (53:41). Wafiyy = loyal, faithful.
meaning.ar: التمام والوفاء — إكمال الشيء وإتمامه

derived_forms.meaning: to take in full — death euphemism

key_verses.en: Fulfill (awfū) My covenant, I will fulfill your covenant
Fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have covenanted
And Abraham, who fulfilled (waffā)
Allah takes (yatawaffā) the souls at their death
O Jesus, I will take you (mutawaffīka)

quranic_analysis.tawaffa_euphemism: Tawaffā = literally "to take in full." Used as Quranic euphemism for death: Allah takes the soul completely at death's appointed time.

meaning.en: To return, repeat, go back, restore. Ibn Faris: core = return to a previous state. Āda (I, 18x) = to return. Aʿāda (IV, 18x) = to cause to return/repeat — almost exclusively divine: "He originates creation then repeats it" (10:4, 85:13). Maʿād = place of return, the Hereafter (28:85). ʿĪd = festival — recurring celebration (5:114). Proper noun ʿĀd (24x) = the ancient tribe.
meaning.ar: العود: رجوع الشيء إلى حاله التي كان عليها — والمعاد: المرجع

derived_forms.meaning: to cause to return, repeat, restore

key_verses.en: As He originated you, so will you return (taʿūdūn)
Indeed He originates (yubdiʾu) and repeats (yuʿīdu)
He originates creation, then repeats it (yuʿīduhu)
He will bring you back (rādduka) to a place of return (maʿād)
Be for us a festival (ʿīdan) — Jesus prayer

quranic_analysis.note: 24 occurrences are the proper noun ʿĀd (tribe of Hud). Excluding proper noun: 39 verbal/derived uses.

meaning.en: To seek, request, demand, search for. Ibn Faris: core = seeking/searching (ṭalab). Rare in Quran (4x) but extremely productive in Islamic vocabulary: ṭālib (student/seeker of knowledge), maṭlūb (sought/required), ṭalab (request). 22:73 has both ṭālib and maṭlūb in one verse — "the seeker and the sought are both weak." Descendants: Turkish talep, Persian/Urdu talab.
meaning.ar: التماس الشيء وطلبه — الطالب: ملتمس العلم

key_verses.en: Night chases day, seeking (yaṭlubuhu) it rapidly
You would never be able to seek it (ṭalaban)
Both the seeker (al-ṭālib) and the sought (al-maṭlūb) are weak

quranic_analysis.islamic_vocab: Despite only 4 Quranic occurrences, root is foundation for: ṭālib al-ʿilm (student of knowledge), maṭlūb (wanted/required person), ṭalab (demand/petition).

meaning.en: To turn, revolve, circulate. Ibn Faris: core = circulation/rotation. Dāra (I, 1x) = to turn/revolve (33:19 — eyes revolving). Adāra (IV, 1x) = to cause to turn/carry out (2:282 — commerce circulation). Dār (48x) = house/dwelling — the dominant Quranic form (dār al-ākhirah = the Hereafter, dār al-salām = Paradise, dār al-bawār = ruin). Dāʾirah (3x) = turn of fortune/misfortune. Dayyār (1x) = inhabitant (71:26). NOTE: "alternating days" (3:140) and "wealth circulation" (59:7) are from root d-w-l, NOT d-w-r.
meaning.ar: الدوران — الدار: محل الإقامة — والدائرة: النائبة

key_verses.en: Eyes revolving (tadūru) like one in death throes
Commerce you carry out (tudīrūnahā) among yourselves
For them is the Home of Peace (dār al-salām) with their Lord
Leave not on earth any inhabitant (dayyār) from disbelievers
We fear a misfortune (dāʾirah) may strike us

quranic_analysis.important_note: Root d-w-r is distinct from d-w-l. 3:140 (nudāwiluhā — We alternate) and 59:7 (dawlah — wealth circulation) use d-w-l, NOT d-w-r.

meaning.en: To be wide, spacious, encompass, have capacity. Ibn Faris: core = opposite of narrowness. Wasiʿa (6x) = to encompass — exclusively theological: Allah's knowledge/mercy/throne encompasses all (2:255, 7:156). Wusʿ (5x) = capacity — "Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity" (2:286). Wāsiʿ (9x) = All-Encompassing (Divine Name) — paired with ʿAlīm. Wāsiʿah (4x) = spacious/vast (of earth, 4:97). Mūsiʿ (2x) = wealthy, expander (2:236, 51:47 — the universe expander).
meaning.ar: الوسع: ضد الضيق — والوسع: الطاقة والقدرة

key_verses.en: His Throne extends (wasiʿa) over the heavens and earth — Āyat al-Kursī
Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity (wusʿahā)
My mercy encompasses (wasiʿat) all things
We built the heaven with might — We are its Expanders (mūsiʿūn)
Was Allah's earth not spacious (wāsiʿah)?

quranic_analysis.al_wasi: Al-Wāsiʿ (All-Encompassing) as Divine Name: 7 of 9 times paired with ʿAlīm. Once: Wāsiʿu al-maghfirah (vast in forgiveness, 53:32).

meaning.en: To follow, succeed, obey; follower. Ibn Faris: core = following behind. Ittabaʿa (VIII, 136x) = the central Quranic concept of intentional following — of revelation (7:3), prophets (3:31), truth vs desire. Tabiʿa (I, 9x) = to follow/come after. Atbaʿa (IV, 15x) = to cause to follow/pursue. The key verse: "If you love Allah, follow me (ittabiʿūnī)" (3:31). NOTE: The root is ت ب ع (t-b-'), NOT ط ب ع (ṭ-b-' = to seal). The Buckwalter TbE gives the wrong root.
meaning.ar: الاتباع — التبع: من يتبع غيره — والاتباع: قبول ما يؤمر به

key_verses.en: Whoever follows (tabiʿa) My guidance — no fear on them
If you love Allah, then follow me (ittabiʿūnī)
Follow (ittabiʿū) what is revealed to you from your Lord
Believers follow (ittabaʿū) truth; disbelievers follow falsehood
Fasting two consecutive (mutatābiʿayn) months

quranic_analysis.ibn_faris: Core = following behind — physically, in rank, in obedience. The central Islamic ethical binary: ittibāʿ al-haqq (following truth) vs ittibāʿ al-hawā (following desire).

important_note: This is root ت ب ع (tbE in Buckwalter lowercase), NOT ط ب ع (TbE uppercase = to seal). The original file entry 48 listed TbE with count 11 — this was the WRONG root. Correct root tbE has 172 occurrences.

meaning.en: To promise, threaten; appointed time. Ibn Faris: core = making a binding commitment — for good or evil. Context determines meaning: waʿd = promise (good) AND threat (evil). Waʿada (I, 70x) = to promise/threaten. Wāʿada (III, 4x) = to appoint a time (2:51 — forty nights with Moses). Tawāʿada (VI, 1x) = mutual appointment. Waʿd (49x) = promise. Waʿīd (6x) = threat/warning. Mīʿād (6x) = appointed time — "Allah does not break the mīʿād" (3:9). Mawʿūd (1x) = the Promised Day (85:2).
meaning.ar: الوعد: التزام أمر من الخير والشر — والميعاد: الوقت المعين

key_verses.en: Allah does not break the Promise (lā yukhlifu al-mīʿād)
Give us what You promised us (waʿadttanā)
We found what our Lord promised (waʿadanā) to be true
Ishmael was true to his promise (ṣādiq al-waʿd)
We appointed (wāʿadnā) with Moses forty nights — Form III
By the Promised Day (al-yawm al-mawʿūd)

quranic_analysis.ambivalent_root: Same root for promise and threat — context determines. Allah's waʿd to believers = Paradise. To disbelievers = Hell. Satan's waʿd = deception (4:120).

meaning.en: To be near, approach, draw close; relatives. Ibn Faris: core = nearness/approach — opposite of buʿd (distance). Qariba (I, 11x) = to approach (mostly prohibitive: "do not approach"). Qarraba (II, 5x) = to bring near (qurbān = sacrifice/offering, 5:27). Iqtaraba (VIII, 5x) = to draw near (54:1 — the Hour draws near). Qarīb (26x) = near/imminent — "I am near" (2:186). Aqrab (19x) = nearer — "We are nearer than his jugular vein" (50:16). Qurbā (16x) = nearness of kin. Muqarrabūn (8x) = those brought near to Allah (angels, righteous).
meaning.ar: القرب: ضد البعد — والقربان: ما يتقرب به — والقريب: الداني

key_verses.en: I am near (qarīb) — I answer the caller's call
We are nearer (aqrab) to him than his jugular vein
The Hour has drawn near (iqtarabat) and the moon split
Prostrate and draw near (iqtarib) to Allah
Takes what he spends as means of nearness (qurubāt) to Allah
They offered an offering (qarraba qurbānan) — Cain and Abel
Those are the nearest ones (al-muqarrabūn)

quranic_analysis.semantic_field: Physical (approach a tree, 2:35), temporal (the Hour is near), spiritual (Allah is near, draw near to Him), relational (near kin, dhu al-qurbā), ritual (qurbān as means of nearness).

meaning.en: To dislike, hate, be averse; to compel, force. Ibn Faris: core = opposition/aversion. Kariha (I, 17x) = to dislike/hate (2:216 — you may dislike something yet it is good for you). Akraha (IV, 5x) = to compel/force — passive ukriha (16:106 — one forced while his heart is firm). Ikrāh (2x) = compulsion — "No compulsion in religion" (2:256). Makrūh (1x) = hateful (17:38). Karraha (II, 1x) = to make hateful (49:7 — Allah made faith beloved and disbelief hateful). In fiqh: makrūh = disliked but not forbidden (legal category).
meaning.ar: الكراهية: ضد المحبة — الإكراه: الإجبار — لا إكراه في الدين

meaning.en: To witness, testify, be present; testimony, martyrdom. Ibn Faris: core = presence + knowledge. Shahida (I) = to witness/testify (~55x). Ash'hada (IV) = to make testify — the Primordial Covenant (7:172 ashhadahum). Istash'hada (X) = to call for evidence (2:282 debt verse). Shahādah (~10x) = testimony; the Islamic creed. Shāhid (~40x) = active witness. Shahīd (~20x) = eminent witness AND martyr — same semantic shift as Greek martys. Muqarrabūn shuhadā' = martyrs (3:140). Key: Allah shahida (3:18 — bears witness to tawhid). Two witnesses for debt (2:282).
meaning.ar: الشهادة: الحضور والعلم — الشهيد: من يَشهد — والشاهد: من حضر وعلم

meaning.en: To repent, turn back, return. Ibn Faris: core = return (rujūʿ). Tāba (I, 63x) = to repent/turn back to God. Tāba ʿalā = God turns in mercy/accepts repentance. Tawbah (7x) = repentance — tawbatan nasūhā (66:8 = sincere repentance). Al-Tawwāb (12x) = Divine Name — The Ever-Relenting, Acceptor of Repentance (11x paired with al-Raḥīm). Tawb (1x) = verbal noun (40:3). Matāb (2x) = place/manner of return. Pre-Islamic borrowing from Aramaic tǝṯūḇtā. Allah loves al-tawwābīn (2:222).
meaning.ar: التوبة: الرجوع إلى الله — والتواب: كثير القبول للتوبة — إن الله يحب التوابين

meaning.en: Thing, something; to will, wish. One of the most frequent roots (519x). Ibn Faris: two cores — willing/desiring + existence of a thing. Shāʾa (I, 236x) = to will/wish — predominantly divine will: "whom He wills," "if Allah wills" (in shā'a Allāh). Shayʾ (283x) = thing — the most generic noun in Arabic. "kullu shay'in" (everything) appears frequently with divine attributes: ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr (over all things powerful), bi-kulli shay'in ʿalīm (knowing of all things). Mashīʾah = divine will (verbal noun).
meaning.ar: الشيء: الموجود — والمشيئة: الإرادة — والله على كل شيء قدير

meaning.en: Day, era, period. The most eschatologically dense root. Noun only — no verb forms. Yawm (405x) = day. Ayyām (pl., ~30x) = days. Yawmayn (dual, ~2x) = two days. ~75% of occurrences are eschatological: yawm al-qiyāmah (~70x), yawm al-dīn (~15x), al-yawm al-ākhir (~40x). Yawm also means literal calendar day, daytime, and era (ayyām = periods). Proto-Semitic *yawm-. Ibn Faris: core = a period of time. Yawma-idhin = on that day (compound).
meaning.ar: اليوم: وقت من الزمان — يوم القيامة — يوم الدين — اليوم الآخر

meaning.en: Punishment, torment, torture. Ibn Faris: core = preventing/restraining. ʿAdhdhaba (II, 41x) = to punish/torment. ʿAdhāb (322x) = punishment — the most frequent eschatological noun. Grevious punishment (ʿazīm), painful (alīm), severe (shadīd), of the Fire (al-nār). "Not lightened" (2:162). ʿAdhb (2x) = sweet/fresh water — same root, opposite sense: "restrained" from salt. Hadith: ʿadhāb al-qabr (punishment of the grave).
meaning.ar: العذاب: المنع والحبس — وعذب: منع عن مراده — والعذب: الماء المحبوس عن الملوحة

meaning.en: All, every, each; burden, dependent. Ibn Faris: core = gathering/comprehensiveness. Kull (359x) = all/every — the universal quantifier. Most frequent in idāfah: kullu shay'in (everything), ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr (over all things powerful). Kullamā (15x) = whenever. Kall (1x) = burden/dependent (16:76). Kalālah (2x) = inheritance from side-branch (no direct ascendant/descendant, 4:12, 4:176). Post-Quranic: iklīl = crown (from Form II kallala — to crown).
meaning.ar: الكل: الجمع والإحاطة — كل شيء — وكلما: كل وقت — والكل: العيال

meaning.en: To work, do, act; deed, action. Ibn Faris: core = intentional action with craftsmanship. ʿAmila (I, 276x) = to do/work. ʿAmal (71x) = deed/action. The canonical Quranic formula: āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāt (those who believe AND do righteous deeds) — appears ~30x as the soteriological key. Atom's weight of good seen (99:7). Deeds displayed on Judgment Day (99:6). Active participle: ʿāmil (12x) = doer/worker. Distinction: ʿamal (intentional action) vs kasb (earning, 2:281).
meaning.ar: العمل: صنع الشيء بإحكام وإرادة — آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات — خير الأعمال أدومها

meaning.en: Command, order, matter, affair. Ibn Faris: core = commanding and the thing commanded. Amara (I, 77x) = to command/order (antonym: nahā). Amr (166x) = command AND matter/affair — dual meaning inherent: what a commander commands becomes the 'matter' at hand. Divine: when He decrees a matter (amran, 2:117). Ulū al-amr = those in authority (4:59). Shāwirhum fī al-amr = consult in the affair (3:159). Al-nafs al-ammārah = the soul commanding evil (12:53). Hebrew cognate: amar (to say). Amīr = emir/commander.
meaning.ar: الأمر: ضد النهي — والأمر: الشأن والحال — وأولو الأمر: الحكام — وله الخلق والأمر

meaning.en: To forgive, pardon, cover. Ibn Faris: core = covering/veiling (satr). Mighfar = helmet (covers head). Forgiveness = covering of sins from punishment. Ghafara (I, 65x) = to forgive. Istaghfara (X, 40x) = to seek forgiveness (istaghfirū rabbakum). Al-Ghafūr (91x) = Oft-Forgiving (Divine Name — most frequent form, paired with al-Raḥīm ~80x). Al-Ghaffār (5x) = Perpetual Forgiver. Maghfirah (28x) = forgiveness. 39:53: "He forgives all sins (yaghfiru al-dhunūba jamīʿan)" — do not despair of Allah's mercy.
meaning.ar: الغفر: الستر والتغطية — والمغفرة: ستر الذنب — والغفور: كثير المغفرة — إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا

meaning.en: Protector, guardian, ally, friend; nearness. Ibn Faris: core = nearness/proximity. Waliyy (86x) = protector/ally/friend — al-Walī as Divine Name (42:9,28). Awliyāʾ = allies/friends (of Allah, 10:62; of believers, 9:71). Mawlā (18x) = protector/master. Wallā (II, 30x) = to turn/appoint. Tawallā (V, 78x) = to take as ally / turn away. Key: Allāhu waliyyu alladhīna āmanū (2:257). "Do not take Jews/Christians as awliyāʾ" (5:51). "Your waliyy is Allah, His Messenger, and the believers" (5:55). Awlā (11x) = more worthy/closer. Wilāyah (2x) = guardianship.
meaning.ar: الولي: القرب والدنو — الله ولي الذين آمنوا — والولي: الناصر والمعين

meaning.en: Garden, Paradise; jinn; to cover/conceal. Ibn Faris: core = covering/concealment. All meanings derive from this: Jannah (147x) = garden/Paradise — a "covered" garden canopied by trees. Jinn (22x) = unseen beings — concealed from human sight. Junnah (2x) = shield — what covers/protects. Janīn = embryo — concealed in womb. Majnūn (11x) = mad — one whose mind is covered. Jānn (7x) = jinn/snake. Jinnah (10x) = madness. One root unifies: Paradise, jinn, embryo, shield, and madness — all through covering.
meaning.ar: الجنة: الستر — الجنة: جنّة الأشجار — والجن: المستترون عن العيون — والمجنون: المستور العقل

meaning.en: At, near, with, in the presence of; stubborn. Two semantic poles: (1) ʿInda (197x) = preposition/adverb — at, near, with, in one's possession. Min ʿindi = from (God). ʿIndī = I have. (2) ʿAnīd (4x) = stubborn/obstinate (11:59, 14:15, 50:24, 74:16). Ibn Faris: relationship to a reference point — staying near (ʿinda) vs swerving away (ʿanada). Etymologically from contraction of "eye" + "hand" — before one's eyes, at hand. Ottoman Turkish borrowed ʿind = side.
meaning.ar: العند: القرب والحضور — والعنيد: المعارض المخالف — وعند: ظرف مكان

meaning.en: Light, illumination; fire. Ibn Faris: core = illumination/radiance. Nār (145x) = fire — overwhelmingly Hellfire, also earthly fire. Nūr (43x) = light — divine (24:35 Allāhu nūru al-samāwāt), revealed (Quran as nūr), eschatological (believers' light 57:12). Munīr (6x) = luminous. The nūr/nār dichotomy: both from same root — fire is light with heat, light is radiance without consuming. Āyat al-Nūr (24:35) has nūr 5x + nār 1x in one verse. Proto-Semitic *nūr-.
meaning.ar: النور: الضوء والإشراق — والنار: الضوء مع الحرارة — الله نور السموات والأرض

meaning.en: Good, better, best; choice. Ibn Faris: core = choosing and preference. Khayr (~186x) = good/better/best — most common positive adjective. Opposite: sharr. "You may dislike something while it is khayr for you" (2:216). The elative: khayru al-rāziqīn (Best of providers). Ikhtāra (VIII, 4x) = to choose — "He creates and chooses; no choice is theirs" (28:68). Khiyarat (2x) = choice/option. Khayrāt (10x) = good deeds. Istikhāra (Form X, post-Quranic) = seeking divine guidance for choice.
meaning.ar: الخير: الاختيار والتفضيل — والخير: ضد الشر — وربك يخلق ما يشاء ويختار

meaning.en: Good, beautiful, excellent. Ibn Faris: core = beauty and goodness (opposite of ugliness). Aḥsana (IV, 21x) = to do good/excel — "He perfected everything He created" (32:7). Iḥsān (12x) = excellence — defined in Jibrīl hadith: worship as if you see Him. Ḥasanah (28x) = a good deed. Ḥasanāt (3x) = good deeds. Al-Ḥusnā (17x) = the Best — al-asmāʾ al-ḥusnā (Most Beautiful Names). Muḥsin (38x) = good-doer — "Allah loves al-muḥsinīn." Aḥsan (36x) = better/best — "best of creators" (23:14).
meaning.ar: الحسن: ضد القبح — والإحسان: الإتقان — والله يحب المحسنين — وأسماء الله الحسنى

meaning.en: To hear, listen; hearing. Ibn Faris: core = perception through hearing. Samiʿa (I, 78x) = to hear — "samiʿnā wa-aṭaʿnā" (we hear and obey, 2:285). Asmaʿa (IV, 13x) = to make hear. Istamaʿa (VIII, 16x) = to listen attentively/eavesdrop. Al-Samīʿ (46x) = All-Hearing (Divine Name) — paired with al-ʿAlīm/al-Baṣīr. Samʿ (22x) = hearing faculty. "If only we had listened (nasmaʿu) or reasoned" (67:10). Proto-Semitic *šamaʕ-. Cognate: Hebrew shama.
meaning.ar: السمع: الإدراك بالأذن — والسميع: كثير السمع — سمعنا وأطعنا — والله سميع عليم

meaning.en: To go out, exit, emerge; to bring forth. Ibn Faris: core = emergence and separation — transition from interior to exterior. Kharaja (I, 97x) = to go out/exit. Akhraja (IV, 40x) = to bring forth — key divine act: bringing life from death (3:27), creation from earth (20:55), night from day. "From it We created you, to it We return you, from it We bring you forth (nukhrijukum) again" (20:55). Khurūj (5x) = exodus/going forth. Makhraj (9x) = place of exit/way out. Istakhraja (X, 1x) = to extract (12:76).
meaning.ar: الخروج: الانتقال من الباطن إلى الظاهر — أخرج: أبرز — منها خلقناكم ومنها نخرجكم تارة أخرى

meaning.en: To be righteous, good, sound; to reform, reconcile. Ibn Faris: core = soundness/goodness — opposite of fasād (corruption). Ṣāliḥāt (62x) = righteous deeds — canonical pair "āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāt" appears ~55x. Ṣāliḥ (65x) = righteous (person). Prophet Ṣāliḥ (9x). Aṣlaḥa (IV, 28x) = to reform/reconcile/make peace. Iṣlāḥ (7x) = reform. Ṣulḥ (2x) = peace/reconciliation — "reconciliation is better" (4:128). Muṣliḥ (5x) = reformer — opposite mufsid (corrupter).
meaning.ar: الصلاح: ضد الفساد — والإصلاح: تقويم المعوج — آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات — والصلح خير

meaning.en: To kill, slay; to fight. Qatala (I, 83x) = to kill/slay. Qātala (III, 54x) = to fight (mutual). Qitāl (13x) = fighting — "fighting is prescribed for you though it is hateful" (2:216). Iqtatala (VIII, 4x) = to fight each other. Qatl (10x) = killing. Key prohibition: "Do not kill the soul" (6:151, 17:33). Killing one = killing all (5:32). Fighting in sacred months prohibited (2:217). Quttila (II passive, 4x) = massacred. Proto-West Semitic *ḳatal-; cognate Hebrew קָטַל.
meaning.ar: القتل: إزهاق الروح — والقتال: المقاتلة — الفتنة أشد من القتل — كتب عليكم القتال

meaning.en: Heart; to turn, invert, overturn. Ibn Faris: core = turning/reversing. Qalb (132x) = heart — central Quranic term for spiritual-intellectual center. Hearts find rest in dhikr (13:28). It is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts (22:46). Inqalaba (VII, 17x) = to turn back. Proto-Semitic *libb- > *qalb.
meaning.ar: القلب: التحويل — ألا بذكر الله تطمئن القلوب — فإنها لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب

meaning.en: Partnership, association; shirk (polytheism). Ibn Faris: core = mixing/partnership. Ashraka (IV) = to associate partners with God — the unforgivable sin (4:48). Shirk = the greatest zulm (31:13). Mushrik = polytheist. Theological meaning may be semantic loan from Old South Arabian.
meaning.ar: الشرك: الخلط والجمع — إن الشرك لظلم عظيم — لا يغفر أن يشرك به

meaning.en: Death; to die. Mata (I, 39x) = to die. Amata (IV, 21x) = to cause death — divine prerogative. Mawt (50x) = death — Allah created death as a test (67:2). Every soul shall taste death (3:185). Proto-Semitic *mawt-. Cognate: Hebrew mavet.
meaning.ar: الموت: ضد الحياة — خلق الموت والحياة ليبلوكم — كل نفس ذائقة الموت

meaning.en: To be great; pride, greatness. 18 Quranic forms. Allahu Akbar. Istakbara (X, 40x) = to be arrogant — THE sin of Iblis. Kabbara (II, 4x) = to magnify. Akbar (24x) = greater/greatest. Kabir (40x) = great; al-Kabir as Divine Name. The moral duality: greatness ascribed to Allah = virtue; man claiming greatness = gravest sin.
meaning.ar: الكبر: العظمة — الله أكبر — استكبر إبليس — الكبير المتعال

meaning.en: Other than, except; to change. Ibn Faris: core = difference and transition. Ghayr (147x) = other than/except — the Quranic exception word. Ghayyara (II, 4x) = to change — Allah does not change a people until they change themselves (13:11).
meaning.ar: الغير: الخلاف — غير المغضوب عليهم — إن الله لا يغير ما بقوم حتى يغيروا ما بأنفسهم

meaning.en: Sight, vision; to see. Ibn Faris: core = knowledge and perception. Al-Basir (51x) = All-Seeing (paired with al-Sami). Basar (48x) = physical sight. Basirah (7x) = inner insight. It is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts (22:46).
meaning.ar: البصر: العلم بالشيء — والبصير: المبصر — فإنها لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب

meaning.en: Sign, verse, miracle; which, any. Ayah (382x) = sign/verse — Quranic verses are ayat (signs). Plural ayat. The Quran most frequent self-designation. Ayy = which/any (interrogative). Proto-Semitic *awayat- (sign, cognate Hebrew ot).
meaning.ar: الآية: العلامة — والآيات: الدلائل — تلك آيات الكتاب — سنريهم آياتنا في الآفاق

meaning.en: Earth, land, ground. Ard (461 word tokens) = most frequent geographical term. He created heavens and earth in six days (7:54). He spread out the earth (13:3). The earth will be replaced (14:48). Proto-Semitic *ars-. Cognate: Hebrew eretz.
meaning.ar: الأرض: مستقر البشر — خلق السموات والأرض — والأرض مددناها — يوم تبدل الأرض غير الأرض

meaning.en: Sky, heaven; name. Ibn Faris: core = elevation. Two branches: (1) Sama (310x) = sky/heaven — samawat = seven heavens. (2) Ism (39x) = name — a name ELEVATES the named. In the name of Allah (1:1). Cognates: Hebrew shamayim, Hebrew shem.
meaning.ar: السم: العلو والارتفاع — والسماء: المرفوع — والاسم: ما يعلى به المسمى — بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

meaning.en: To protect, guard; piety, God-consciousness. Ibn Faris: core = protection/safeguarding. Ittaqa (VIII, 166x) = to fear God/be righteous. Taqwa (17x) = piety — the best of provisions (2:197). Muttaqun (49x) = the God-conscious — the Quran first audience (2:2). Waqa (I, 16x) = to protect. Atqa (2x) = most righteous — noblest is the most God-conscious (49:13).
meaning.ar: الوقاية: الحفظ والصيانة — والتقوى: وقاية النفس — إن أكرمكم عند الله أتقاكم

meaning.en: Last, final, end; other. Ibn Faris: core = delay and posteriority. Al-Akhir = the Last (Divine Name, 57:3). Al-Akhirah = the Hereafter (~115x of 155 akhira occurrences). Al-yawm al-akhir = the Last Day (~40x). Akhar (70x) = other/another. Akhkhara (II, 15x) = to delay/give respite. Six derived forms. Cognate: Hebrew achar (after).
meaning.ar: الآخر: التأخر — هو الأول والآخر — والآخرة: الدار الآخرة — واليوم الآخر

meaning.en: After; distance, far. Ibn Faris: core = distance and remoteness. Bad (199x) = after — the temporal preposition (opposite: qabl). Baid (25x) = far/distant. Bud (7x) = distance — bu dan li- = away with/perdition to. Bauda (I, 2x) = to be far. Mubadun (1x) = removed far away (21:101). Antonym: qarib (near).
meaning.ar: البعد: المسافة — وبعد: ضد قبل — وبعيد: ضد قريب — وبعدا للقوم الظالمين

meaning.en: Path, way, road. Ibn Faris: core = path and flowing. Sabil = way/path — appears 176x, noun only. Key phrase: fi sabil Allah (in the way of Allah, ~40x). Ibn al-sabil = traveler (zakah recipient). Subul (plural) = paths. Cognate: Hebrew shvil (path).
meaning.ar: السبيل: الطريق — وفي سبيل الله — وابن السبيل — ولا تتبعوا السبل

meaning.en: Evil, bad, ugly; to distress. Ibn Faris: core = ugliness and evil. 12 derived forms. Sa a (I, 30x) = to be evil/grieve — opposite of ni ma. Su (50x) = evil/harm — the soul commands evil (12:53). Sayyiat (36x) = evil deeds — hasanat erase sayyiat (11:114). Saw at (5x) = shame/private parts (Fall narrative). Opposites: hasan, khayr.
meaning.ar: السوء: القبح والشر — والنفس لأمارة بالسوء — والحسنات يذهبن السيئات — ساء سبيلا

meaning.en: First, former; family; interpretation. Ibn Faris: core = beginning and precedence. Al-Awwal = the First (Divine Name, 57:3). Awwal (82x) = first/former. Al-awwalin = former peoples. Ulū (45x) = possessors of — ulū al-albab (men of intellect). Al (26x) = family of. Tawil (17x) = interpretation/fulfillment — none knows its tawil except Allah (3:7).
meaning.ar: الأول: التقدم والبداية — هو الأول والآخر — أولو الألباب — وما يعلم تأويله إلا الله

meaning.en: Many, much, abundance, multitude. Ibn Faris: core = opposite of qilla (fewness). Kathir (63x) = much/many. Akthar (80x) = more/most — but most people do not know (refrain pattern ~40x). Kathura (2x) = to be many. Takathur (2x) = rivalry in abundance — diverts you (102:1). Kawthar (1x) = Abundant Good (Surah 108).
meaning.ar: الكثرة: ضد القلة — وأكثر الناس لا يعلمون — ألهاكم التكاثر — إنا أعطيناك الكوثر

meaning.en: Like, similar; example, parable. Ibn Faris: core = likeness and similarity. Mathal (88x) = example/parable — daraba mathalan (strike an example) ~30x. Mithl (75x) = like/similar — nothing is like Him (42:11). Tamathil (2x) = statues. Tamaththala (V, 1x) = to assume likeness (19:17). Cognate: Hebrew mashal (proverb).
meaning.ar: المثل: الشبه — وضرب الله مثلا — ليس كمثله شيء — وتماثيل

meaning.en: Some, part, portion. Ibn Faris: core = partition and some. Bad (157x) = some/part — opposite of kull (all). Badukum li-ba din = some of you to others (mutual/reciprocal). A single word (2:73) = a part of it. Badah (1x) = mosquito (2:26) — from same root. Reciprocal usage: looked at each other (some of them to others).
meaning.ar: البعض: الجزء — بعضكم لبعض عدو — أفتؤمنون ببعض الكتاب وتكفرون ببعض — كبعض

meaning.en: Below, besides, other than, without. Ibn Faris: core = lowness and nearness. Dun (144x) = below/other than — always nominal/prepositional. Min duni Allah = other than Allah (dominant usage). Dun is the primary exclusion term. Antonym: fawq (above). Etymology: from d-n-w (nearness/lowness).
meaning.ar: الدون: الخسوسة والقرب — ومن دون الله — وما من إله إلا الله — دون ذلك

meaning.en: To meet, encounter; to cast, deliver. Ibn Faris: core = encountering and meeting. 16 derived forms. Alqa (IV, 71x) = to cast/throw/deliver/reveal — dominant form. Liqa (24x) = meeting — liqa Allah (meeting with God). Laqiya (I, 14x) = to meet/find. Iltaqa (VIII, 7x) = to meet each other — the two seas meet (55:19). Alqa asa = Moses cast his staff. Talaqqa (V) = to receive.
meaning.ar: اللقاء: المصادفة والملاقاة — وألقى عصاه — ولقاء الله — والتقى الجمعان — مرج البحرين يلتقيان

meaning.en: God, deity. THE MOST FREQUENT ROOT (2851x). Allah (2699x) = THE God — contracted from al-ilah. Ilah (147x) = god/deity. Allahumma (5x) = O God (vocative). Ibn Faris: core = worship. La ilaha illa Allah = central shahada. Proto-Semitic *il-. Cognate: Hebrew Elohim, Aramaic Alaha.
meaning.ar: الأله: العبادة — لا إله إلا الله — قل هو الله أحد — ولله الأسماء الحسنى

meaning.en: Blessing, bliss, favor, ease. Ibn Faris: core = ease/softness. Nima (50x) = blessing/favor — from Allah, to be remembered. Naim (17x) = bliss — gardens of bliss (Paradise). Anama (IV, 17x) = to bless — those You have blessed (1:7). Nima (I, 18x) = how excellent! (praise formula). Naam (33x) = cattle/livestock (providers of ease). Cognate: Hebrew naam (to please).
meaning.ar: النعمة: اللين والسهولة — صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم — وجنة نعيم — وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها

meaning.en: To ask, question, request. Ibn Faris: core = asking/requesting. Saala (I, 106x) = to ask/inquire — they ask you about the Hour (7:187). Sual = question. Masul = questioned (everyone accountable). Tasaalu (VI, 9x) = to ask one another. The root of all petition and inquiry.
meaning.ar: السؤال: الطلب — يسألونك عن الساعة — ولا تسألوا عن أشياء — كل نفس بما كسبت رهينة

meaning.en: To be near, approach; this world. Ibn Faris: core = nearness. Dunya (115x) = the near life (this world) — contrasted with akhirah. Adna (12x) = nearer/lower. Dana (I, 2x) = to approach. Daniyah (3x) = hanging near (fruit in Paradise). The Quranic worldview in one root: duniya vs akhira.
meaning.ar: الدنا: القرب — الحياة الدنيا — والسماوات الدنيا — الزهرة الدنيا وما الحياة الدنيا إلا متاع الغرور

meaning.en: To obey; willing; to be able. Ibn Faris: core = willing obedience. Ataa (IV, 72x) = to obey — atiu Allaha wa atiu al-rasul. Istataa (X, 42x) = to be able — from willing compliance to capacity. Tawaan = willingly — tawan aw karhan (4x). Tatawwaa (V, 2x) = to volunteer (supererogatory). Tawah (II, 1x) = to entice (5:30). Taah = obedience. The Quranic commands to obey run through this root.
meaning.ar: الطوع: الانقياد — أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول — طوعا كرها — فاتقوا الله ما استطعتم

meaning.en: To vow; to warn; warner. Ibn Faris: two cores — warning (indhar) and vowing (nadhr). Andhara (IV, 44x) = to warn — arise and warn (74:2). Nadhir (58x) = warner — the Prophet as nadhir. Nadhara (I, 4x) = to vow — Mary mother. Nadhr = vow. Mundhir (15x) = warner. Vowing is pan-Semitic (Hebrew neder); warning is distinctively Arabic.
meaning.ar: النذر: الإنذار والنذر — قم فأنذر — وما أنا إلا نذير مبين — إني نذرت للرحمن صوما

meaning.en: To gather, collect, unite; all; Friday. Ibn Faris: core = gathering scattered things. 11 forms! Jamaa (I, 22x) = to gather (Day of Gathering). Jamii (53x) = all/entire. Ajmain (26x) = all (intensive). Jam (13x) = gathering. Ajmaa (IV, 4x) = to resolve/agree unanimously. Ijtimaa (VII, 2x) = to assemble. Jumuah (1x) = Friday (day of gathering). Majma (2x) = confluence — meeting of two seas (18:60). Antonym: farraqa (disperse).
meaning.ar: الجمع: ضم المتفرق — يوم الجمع — وأجمعوا أمركم — وجميعا — والجمعة

meaning.en: To look, watch, await; to grant respite. Ibn Faris: core = expectation, awaiting, delay. 10 forms. Nazara (I, 87x) = to look/see/await — dominant form. Andhara (IV, 12x) = to grant respite — Iblis asked for respite (7:14). Intazara (VIII, 8x) = to wait/expect. Nazar = sight. Nazira (37:88) = a glance. Munzarun (6x) = those given respite. Muntazirun (6x) = those who wait. Imperative: unzur = Look! (20x).
meaning.ar: النظر: التوقع والانتظار — انظر كيف — فانتظر إنهم منتظرون — أنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون

meaning.en: SUMMER (CORRECTION: this is ص ي ف = summer, NOT س ي ف = sword). Single occurrence: 106:2 — journey of winter and summer (rihlat al-shitai wa-l-sayf). The sword root س ي ف (sayf) has ZERO Quranic occurrences — it is not in the Quran at all. The Buckwalter Syf (capital S = ص) refers to SUMMER. This corrects the AI-hallucinated original entry that claimed sword/jihad meaning.
meaning.ar: الصيف: أحد فصول السنة — رحلة الشتاء والصيف — ملاحظة: ليس سيفا

data_correction: Original entry HALLUCINATED sword/jihad meaning. This root means SUMMER only. Sword (سيف) is absent from Quran.

meaning.en: To seek, intend, will, desire; to seduce/entice. Ibn Faris: core = going to-and-fro, oscillation, seeking. Arada (IV, 139x) = to intend/will — dominant form (yuridu Allahu bikum al-yusr, 2:185). Rawada (III, 8x) = to seduce/solicit — attempting to obtain against resistance (Yusuf 12:23-61, 7 of 8 occurrences). Ruwaydan (1x) = gradually/a little (86:17). No Form I in Quran. Core image: seeking motion back-and-forth.
meaning.ar: الرود: الذهاب والمجيء والتردد — يريد الله بكم اليسر — وراودته التي هو في بيتها عن نفسه

meaning.en: DOG (CORRECTION: this is ك ل ب = dog, NOT ق ل ب = heart which is root qlb ID 71). Kalb (5x) = dog of Companions of Cave (18:18, 18:22). Mukallibin (1x) = hunting-dog trainers (5:4).
meaning.ar: الكلب: الحيوان المعروف — وكلبهم باسط ذراعيه بالوصيد — مكلبين

data_correction: FIXED: Original AI hallucinated this as قَلْب (heart). Buckwalter klb is ك ل ب (dog), distinct from qlb (ق ل ب).

meaning.en: Five, fifty, one-fifth. Ibn Faris: core = the number five. Khamsah (3x) = five. Khamsin (2x) = fifty. Khumus (1x) = one-fifth (8:41). Khamisah (2x) = the fifth oath (24:7-9). Proto-Semitic *khamisum. Cognate: Hebrew khamésh.
meaning.ar: الخمس: العدد — خمسة — خمسين عاما — خمسه

meaning.en: To strive, struggle, exert; jihad. Ibn Faris: core = effort and hardship. Jahada (III, 27x) = to strive/fight in the path of Allah. Jihad (4x) = striving. Jahd (5x) = the utmost. Mujahidin (4x) = those who strive.
meaning.ar: الجهد: الطاقة والمشقة — جاهدوا — أقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم — والمجاهدين

meaning.en: To steal; thief, theft. Ibn Faris: core = taking stealthily. 9 occurrences. Saraqa (I, 4x in Yusuf story). Sariq/sariqah (5:38 — male and female thief). Istaraqa (VIII, 1x — devils stealing hearing, 15:18). Cognate: Akkadian sarāqum.
meaning.ar: السرق: أخذ الشيء خفية — والسارق والسارقة فاقطعوا أيديهما

meaning.en: To succeed, come after; to differ; vicegerent. Ibn Faris: core = coming after/behind. 18 forms! Khalifah (9x) = vicegerent. Ikhtalafa (VIII, 35x) = to differ. Akhlafa (IV, 14x) = to break promise. Khalf (22x) = behind. Ikhtilaf (7x) = diversity. Istakhlafa (X, 5x) = to grant succession. Proto-Semitic *khalap-.
meaning.ar: الخلف: المجيء بعد — إني جاعل في الأرض خليفة — لا يخلف الميعاد — اختلاف الليل والنهار

meaning.en: Confusion, perplexity. Hapax legomenon (once in Quran). Hayran (6:71) = confused, bewildered. Ibn Faris: core = returning and confusion. NOTE: 5:26 uses root ت ي ه (T-Y-H), not ح ي ر.
meaning.ar: الحير: الرجوع والتحير — حيران — ملاحظة: يتيهون (5:26) من جذر ت ي ه

meaning.en: Edge, margin, brink; letter; to distort. Ibn Faris: core = edge and side. Harf (1x) = edge — worshiping on an edge (22:11). Yuharrifuna (II, 4x) = they distort scripture (2:75, 4:46, 5:13, 5:41).
meaning.ar: الحرف: الطرف والجانب — يعبد الله على حرف — يحرفون الكلم عن مواضعه

meaning.en: Chest, breast; to issue/emanate. Ibn Faris: core = foremost part. Sadr (44x) = chest — seat of secrets. Allah knows what is in the breasts (14+ times). Sharh al-sadr = expansion of breast (94:1). Sadara (I, 1x) = to proceed (99:6).
meaning.ar: الصدر: المقدم — ألم نشرح لك صدرك — ويعلم ما في الصدور — ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل

meaning.en: Term, appointed time, deadline. Ibn Faris: core = limited period with fixed end. Ajal (47x) = appointed term. Muajjal = appointed (3:145). Ajalayn (dual, 28:28) = two terms. Min ajli (5:32) = because of.
meaning.ar: الأجل: المدة المحدودة — لكل أجل كتاب — كتابا مؤجلا — من أجل ذلك

meaning.en: To forget; oblivion. Ibn Faris: core = absence from remembrance. Nasiya (I, 35x) = to forget. Ansa (IV, 7x) = to cause to forget. Mansiyy = forgotten (19:23). Insan is NOT from nisy (folk etymology); it derives from uns (familiarity).
meaning.ar: النسيان: غيبة الشيء عن الذكر — نسوا الله فنسيهم — ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا — وما كان ربك نسيا

meaning.en: To fear, be afraid; fear, terror. Ibn Faris: faza (terror and dread). 124 occurrences. Khafa (I, 83x) = to fear. Khawf (26x) = fear. Khifat (6x). Khawa (II, 4x) = to frighten. Takhwif (1x) = intimidation (17:59).
meaning.ar: الخوف: الفزع — فلا تخافوهم وخافون — وأمنهم من خوف — لا خوف عليهم

meaning.en: To earn, acquire, gain. Ibn Faris: gaining and collecting. Kasaba (I, 62x) = to earn. Iktasaba (VIII, 5x) = personal liability. laha ma kasabat wa alayha ma iktasabat (2:286). Persian loan: kasb = profession.
meaning.ar: الكسب: الجمع والتحصيل — لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت

meaning.en: To fear with awe; monks; monasticism. Ibn Faris: fear with veneration. Yarhabu (I, 3x) = fear God. Turhibu (IV, 1x) = terrify. Istarhabu (X, 1x). Ruhban (3x) = monks. Rahbaniyyah (1x) = monasticism. Count corrected from 4 to 12.
meaning.ar: الرهب: الخوف مع هيبة — فارهبون — ورهبانية — وترهبون به عدو الله

meaning.en: To pass, elapse; time; bitter. Ibn Faris: passing/going AND bitterness. Marra (I, 10x) = to pass. Marrah (19x) = once/time. Mustamirr (X, 2x) = continuous (54:2). Amarr (1x) = more bitter (54:46). Mirrah (1x) = strength (53:6).
meaning.ar: المر: المرور والذهاب — مرة — والمستمر — ومرارة — وأمر — ذو مرة

meaning.en: Speech, word; to wound. Ibn Faris: speaking and wounding — both from jaw/mouth action. Kalima (28x) = word. Kallama (II, 20x) = to speak — Allah spoke to Moses directly. Kalimat (14x) = words/decrees. Kalam (4x) = speech. Kalm = wound.
meaning.ar: الكلم: من القول — كلمة — وكلم الله موسى تكليما — وكلمات ربي — والكلم: الجرح

meaning.en: To boil, gush, rage. Ibn Faris: boiling and gushing. Fara (I, 3x) = to boil — Noah oven (11:40, 23:27), Hell boiling (67:7 hiya tafur). Fawr (1x) = suddenness immediately (3:125).
meaning.ar: الفور: الغليان والفيضان — وفار التنور — وهي تفور — من فورهم هذا

meaning.en: To cut; to narrate; retribution. Ibn Faris: cutting. Qassa = to narrate (7:35, 12:3). Qisas = retribution (2:178). Surah 28: al-Qasas. Modern: miqass = scissors. Count updated from 1 to 5.
meaning.ar: القص: القطع — القصاص: التتبع — يقصون عليك — القصاص في القتلى

meaning.en: Thread, string; needle. Ibn Faris: stretching and lengthening. Khayt (2x) = thread — white thread of dawn from black (2:187). Khiyat (1x) = needle — eye of needle (7:40). Verbs khata/khayyata (to sew) NOT in Quran.
meaning.ar: الخيط: السلك الممدود — الخيط الأبيض من الخيط الأسود من الفجر — سم الخياط

meaning.en: To set up, erect; fatigue; share. Ibn Faris: standing erect AND fatigue. Nasib (21x) = share. Nusub/ansab (3x) = idol/altar idols (5:3, 5:90). Nasab (4x) = fatigue. Nasibatun (1x) = exhausted (88:3).
meaning.ar: النصب: قيام الشيء والتعب — نصب — ناصبة — وأنصاب — ونصيب

meaning.en: Poverty, need; vertebrae. Ibn Faris: breaking vertebrae AND poverty (poverty breaks the back). Faqir (12x) = poor. Faqr (1x) = poverty (2:268). Faqirah (1x) = backbreaking calamity (75:25). Antonym: ghani.
meaning.ar: الفقر: كسر فقار الظهر والفقر ضد الغنى — فقير — فقيرا — فاقرة

meaning.en: Heaviness, dignity, deafness; to honor. Ibn Faris: core = heaviness and weight. Waqr (6x) = deafness (heavy ear). Wiqr (1x) = load (51:2). Waqar (1x) = dignity/grandeur (71:13). Waqqara (II, 1x) = to honor (48:9).
meaning.ar: الوقر: الثقل — وقرا في آذانهم — ووقارا — وتوقروه — وقرا (حمل)

meaning.en: Back, surface; to appear; to support. FIXED: Buckwalter Zhr = ظ ه ر (59x), NOT ز ه ر (1x splendor). 59 occurrences. Zahr (21x) = back. Zuhur (11x) = backs. Zahir (17x) = apparent — al-Zahir Divine Name (57:3). Azhara (IV) = to manifest. Zahiyr (7x) = helper. Zahr as ride/surface — did We not expand your breast (94:3).
meaning.ar: الظهر: ضد البطن — وهو الظاهر والباطن — وظهر الفساد — وتظاهرون — وأنتم ظاهرون

data_correction: FIXED: count 1→59. Buckwalter Zhr = ظهر (back/appear/support), NOT زهر (splendor, 1x at 20:131).

meaning.en: To complain, plead. Ibn Faris: core = complaint and disclosure. Ashku (I, 12:86) = I complain — Jacob: only to Allah. Tashtaki (VIII, 58:1) = she pleads — the woman of zihar. Mishkat (24:35) = niche — Ge'ez loanword listed under this root.
meaning.ar: الشكوى: البث — إنما أشكو بثي وحزني إلى الله — وتشتكي إلى الله — مشكاة

meaning.en: To recompense, reward, repay; sufficiency. Ibn Faris: recompense + sufficiency. 118 occurrences, 5 forms. Jaza (I, 73x) = to recompense. Jaza (42x) = reward/requital. Jizyah (1x) = tribute (9:29). Jaz (1x) = one who avails (31:33). Key: 45:22 — creation for just recompense. najzi al-muhsinin (7x).
meaning.ar: الجزاء: المكافأة — ولتجزى كل نفس بما كسبت — هل جزاء الإحسان إلا الإحسان — والجزية

meaning.en: To begin, originate. Ibn Faris: core = beginning. 15 occurrences. Bada (I, 12x) = to begin/originate. Yubdi (IV, 3x) = to originate — He originates then repeats (yubdiu wa yu'id). No verbal nouns in Quran. Cognate: Hebrew bada (to invent).
meaning.ar: البدء: الابتداء — كما بدأكم تعودون — إنه هو يبدئ ويعيد — يبدئ الخلق

meaning.en: To be dry, arid. Ibn Faris: core = dryness opposite of moisture. 4 occurrences. Yabisat (12:43, 46) = dry ears of corn (Joseph dream). Yabasan (20:77) = dry path through sea (Moses). Yabisin (6:59) = dry — no moist nor dry except in a clear Book. Cognate: Hebrew yavesh.
meaning.ar: اليبس: الجفاف — وأخر يابسات — طريقا في البحر يبسا — ولا رطب ولا يابس

meaning.en: To prostrate, bow in worship. Ibn Faris: core = bowing with humility. 92 occurrences. Sajada (I, 35x) = to prostrate — Iblis refused. Masjid (28x) = mosque. Sujud (6x) = prostration. Sajid (23x) = prostrator. Etymology: Aramaic segid. Key: al-Masjid al-Haram (15x), al-Aqsa (17:1).
meaning.ar: السجود: التطامن والخضوع — واسجد واقترب — ومساجد — وتراهم ركعا سجدا — ألا يسجدوا لله

meaning.en: To refuse, reject. Ibn Faris: core = refusal. 13 occurrences. Aba (I) = to refuse — Iblis refused to prostrate (2:34, 15:31, 20:116 paired with istakbara). Aba illa = refused except/insisted. Heavens/earth/mountains refused to bear the Trust (33:72). Proto-Semitic *abay-.
meaning.ar: الإباء: الرفض — أبى واستكبر — وأبين أن يحملنها — يأبى — أبى أكثر الناس إلا كفورا

meaning.en: To advance step by step; degree, rank. Ibn Faris: core = sequential progression. 20 occurrences. Darajat (18x) = degree/rank. Istadraja (X, 2x) = to lead gradually to destruction (7:182, 68:44 — from where they know not).
meaning.ar: الدرج: الشيء بعد الشيء — سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون — درجات — ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات

meaning.en: To drive, herd; leg, shin; market. Ibn Faris: core = driving and urging. 17 occurrences. Saqa (I, 7x) = to drive — clouds, water, people to judgment. Saq (4x) = leg — Day the shin is uncovered (68:42). Suq (2x) = market — from Aramaic shuqa.
meaning.ar: السوق: الحث والدفع — وسيق الذين كفروا — يوم يكشف عن ساق — الأسواق — وسائق

meaning.en: To study, learn; effacement. Ibn Faris: two cores — studying/repetition AND effacement/obliteration. 6 occurrences. Darasa (I, 5x) = to study — they studied it (6:105, 7:169, 34:44). Dirasat (1x) = study (6:156). Effacement sense not in Quran. Possible Hebrew darash semantic loan.
meaning.ar: الدرس: الدراسة والتكرار — وقد درسوا ما فيه — أم لكم كتاب فيه تدرسون

meaning.en: To build; son. Ibn Faris: constructing — opposite of demolition. 184 occurrences. Bana (I, 11x) = to build heavens. Ibn/bunayya/banun (~143x) = son/children. Bunyan (7x) = structure. Bina (2x) = canopy. Proto-Semitic *banay-. Cognate: Hebrew banah.
meaning.ar: البناء: ضد الهدم — وبنينا السماء — يا بني — بني إسرائيل — بنيان مرصوص

meaning.en: Awareness with depth. 52 occurrences. Al-Khabir (45x) = All-Aware Divine Name — paired with Alim, Latif, Basir. Khabar/akhbar (4x) = news. Khubr (2x) = knowledge. No verbs in Quran. Knowledge through testing/experience.
meaning.ar: الخبر: العلم بالتجربة — وهو اللطيف الخبير — كلاء على أخباركم — ولا ينبئك مثل خبير

meaning.en: To join, connect, arrive. 12 occurrences. Yasilu (I, 10x) = to join/reach. Wassala (II, 1x) = to convey (28:51). Wasilat (1x) = sacred ewe (5:103).
meaning.ar: الوصل: الضم والجمع — يصلون ما أمر الله به أن يوصل — ولقد وصلنا لهم القول

meaning.en: To separate, divide, distinguish. 72 occurrences across 14 forms. Faraqa (I, 5x) = divide. Farraqa (II, 9x) = differentiate. Tafarraqa (V, 8x) = be divided. Furqan (7x) = Criterion. Fariq (33x) = party/group.
meaning.ar: الفرق: فصل الشيء — وفرقنا بكم البحر — ولا تفرقوا — والفرقان

meaning.en: To understand. SINGLE Quranic occurrence. Fahhamnaha (II, 21:79) = We gave understanding to Solomon. Fahima (I) = to understand. Mafhum = concept.
meaning.ar: الفهم: العلم بالشيء — ففهمناها سليمان — وكلا آتينا حكما وعلما

meaning.en: To be pleased, satisfied. 73 occurrences. Radiya (I, 38x) = to be pleased — reciprocal divine-human pleasure (5:119, 9:100, 58:22, 98:8). Ridwan (13x) = divine good pleasure. Mardah (5x) = cause of pleasure.
meaning.ar: الرضا: ضد السخط — رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه — ورضوان — وابتغاء مرضات الله

meaning.en: Heat, boiling; intimate friend. Ibn Faris: heat AND nearness. Hamim (14x) = boiling Hell-drink. Hamim (6x) = intimate friend — no friend on Judgment Day (70:10). Yahmum (1x) = black smoke (56:43).
meaning.ar: الحم: الحرارة والقرب — حميم آن — يسأل حميم حميما — ويحموم

meaning.en: Half, middle; justice. Ibn Faris: half AND justice (giving fair share). 7 occurrences. Nisf (7x) = half — inheritance law (4:11-176) and night prayer (73:3,20). No verbs in Quran. Insaf = fairness from giving the right half.
meaning.ar: النصف: الشطر والعدل — فنصف — نصف ما فرضتم — قم الليل نصفه

meaning.en: Righteousness, piety, kindness; land. Ibn Faris: two cores — truth/piety AND expanse/land. 32 occurrences. Barr (12x) = land. Birr (8x) = righteousness — not turning faces east or west (2:177). Abrar (6x) = the righteous. Barr (adj, 2x) = dutiful to parents (19:14, 19:32). Al-Barr (1x) = Most Kind Divine Name (52:28). Proto-Semitic *barr-.
meaning.ar: البر: الصدق والتقوى — ليس البر أن تولوا وجوهكم — وبرا بوالديه — والأبرار — وهو البر الرحيم

meaning.en: Burden, covenant, heavy obligation. FIXED: count 6->3. Ibn Faris: binding and heavy load. 3 occurrences. Isr (3x) = burden — do not place upon us a burden (2:286). My covenant (3:81 — prophetic covenant). Their burden (7:157 — strictures of Torah). NOT to be confused with ص ر ر (asarra = to persist).
meaning.ar: الإصر: العهد الثقيل — ولا تحمل علينا إصرا — وأخذتم على ذلكم إصري — ويضع عنهم إصرهم

data_correction: FIXED: count 6->3. Root is أ ص ر (burden/covenant), NOT ص ر ر (to persist).

meaning.en: To last, endure; perpetuity. Ibn Faris: stability and continuance. 9 occurrences. Dama (I, 7x) = as long as — ma dama construction. Daimun (2x) = everlasting — Paradise fruit (13:35), constant in prayer (70:23). All Form I perfect or active participle.
meaning.ar: الدوام: الثبات والاستمرار — ما دامت السموات والأرض — أكلها دائم — على صلاتهم دائمون

meaning.en: To forbid, prohibit; sacred, sanctuary. Ibn Faris: two poles — prohibition AND sanctity. 83 occurrences. Harrama (II, 39x) = to forbid/make unlawful. Haram (33x) = sacred/prohibited — al-Masjid al-Haram. Mahrum (4x) = deprived. Muharram (5x) = forbidden. Hurumat (2x) = sacred things. The root oscillates: what is forbidden IS what is sacred.
meaning.ar: الحرام: المنع والتعظيم — حرم — والمسجد الحرام — والأشهر الحرم — محروم — حرمات

meaning.en: To read, recite; the Quran. Ibn Faris: core = gathering and bringing together. 88 occurrences. Qaraa (I, 16x) = to read/recite — iqra (96:1) = first revealed word! Quran (70x) = the Recitation — the gathered divine speech. Qurū (1x) = menses (blood gathers in womb). Proto-Semitic *qara-. Cognate: Hebrew qara.
meaning.ar: القرء: الجمع والضم — اقرأ باسم ربك — إن علينا جمعه وقرآنه — القرآن — قروء

meaning.en: To prescribe, impose, make obligatory. FIXED: f-r-D (ف ر ض) = obligation (18x), distinct from f-r-d (ف ر د = alone, 5x). 18 occurrences. Farada (I, 9x) = to prescribe/impose. Faridah (6x) = obligation/dower (2:236-237). Mafrud (2x) = obligatory. Farid (1x) = old cow (2:68). Ibn Faris: determination and specification.
meaning.ar: الفرض: التقدير والتحديد — فريضة — وفرضناها — لا فارض ولا بكر — مفروضا

data_correction: FIXED: Root is ف ر ض (obligation, 18x), NOT ف ر د (alone, 5x). Distinct roots.

meaning.en: Head; chief, leader. 18 occurrences — all noun (ras/ruus). No verbs in Quran. Wash your heads (5:6). Shave your heads (2:196). Heads of capital (2:279). Hanging heads in shame (32:12). Proto-Semitic *ras-. Cognate: Hebrew rosh, Akkadian reshum. Rais = leader (Arabic > Turkish reis, Swahili rais).
meaning.ar: الرأس: رئيس القوم — وامسحوا برؤوسكم — رؤوس أموالكم — ناكسوا رؤوسهم — رئيس

meaning.en: Yellow, turning yellow; emptiness; whistle. Ibn Faris: core = yellowness, color of gold. 5 occurrences. Sufr (77:33) = yellow (Hell sparks). Safra (2:69) = yellow cow. Musfarran (30:51, 39:21, 57:20) = turning yellow — vegetation withering. Sifr = zero (Arabic > cipher/zero). Safar = month Safar. Safir = whistling.
meaning.ar: الصفرة: لون الذهب — صفراء فاقع لونها — مصفرا — كأنه جمالات صفر — صفر

meaning.en: Tower, constellation; display/adornment. Ibn Faris: conspicuous appearance + elevation. 7 occurrences. Buruj (4x) = constellations (85:1, 25:61, 15:16) AND fortified towers (4:78). Tabarruj (33:33) = do not display yourselves — women of Jahiliyyah. Mutabarrijat (24:60) = displaying women. Borrowed: Greek pyrgos (tower) > Syriac burga > Arabic burj.
meaning.ar: البرج: الظهور والارتفاع — والسماء ذات البروج — ولا تبرجن تبرج الجاهلية — غير متبرجات

meaning.en: To restrain, withhold; palm; completely. Ibn Faris: gathering + prevention. 15 occurrences. Kaffa (I, 8x) = to restrain/withhold — restrain your hands (4:77). Kaffatan (5x) = all together/comprehensively. Kaffayn (2x) = two palms. Proto-Semitic *kapp- (palm). Cognate: Hebrew kaf. NOT to be confused with kuffar (ك ف ر = disbelievers).
meaning.ar: الكف: الجمع والمنع — كفوا أيديكم — كافة — كفيه — ادخلوا في السلم كافة

meaning.en: To compel, force; to mend, restore; tyrant. Ibn Faris: strength/force + mending. 10 occurrences — all jabbar. Jabbar (9x) = tyrant/insolent (human, negative). Al-Jabbar (1x, 59:23) = the Compeller/Irresistible (Divine Name, positive). No verb forms in Quran. Cognate: Hebrew gavar (to prevail). Jabr = algebra (restoration).
meaning.ar: الجبر: القهر والإصلاح — الجبار — العزيز الجبار المتكبر — جبارين — جبارا

meaning.en: To burst, gush; dawn; wickedness. Ibn Faris: splitting/opening AND moral depravity. 24 occurrences. Fajr (6x) = dawn (89:1, 97:5). Fujjar (4x) = wicked. Fujur (1x) = wickedness — inspired soul with fujur and taqwa (91:8). Fajjara (II, 6x) = to cause to gush — rivers, springs. Infajarat (VII, 1x) = gushed forth — 12 springs (2:60).
meaning.ar: الفجر: شق الشيء — والفجر — والفجور — فألهمها فجورها وتقواها — فانفجرت — فجار

meaning.en: To give sufficiency, enrich. FIXED: root is ق ن ي (sufficiency), NOT ق ن ع (contentment). SINGLE occurrence. Aqna (53:48) = and suffices — paired with aghna (and enriches). Allah is the One who enriches and gives sufficiency.
meaning.ar: القني: الإغناء والإقناء — وأغنى وأقنى — هو الذي أغنى وأقنى

data_correction: FIXED: Root is ق ن ي (sufficiency), NOT ق ن ع (contentment). Different final radical.

meaning.en: To divide, distribute; to swear/take an oath. Ibn Faris: core = division and apportionment. 33 occurrences in 10 forms. Aqsama (IV, 20x) = to swear — dominant form. Qasama (I, 2x) = to divide. Qismah (3x) = portion/share. Muqassimat (51:4) = distributors (angels). Muqtasimun (15:90) = dividers of Scripture.
meaning.ar: القسم: التفريق والتجزئة — وأقسموا — ونحن قسمنا بينهم — فالمقسمات أمرا — المقتسمين

meaning.en: To join, pair; horn, generation; companion. Ibn Faris: core = joining and gathering. 36 occurrences in 5 forms. Qarn/qurun (23x) = generation/century — destroyed generations. Qarin (8x) = companion — Satan as qarin. Muqarranin (3x) = bound in chains. Dhul-Qarnayn (3x) = the Two-Horned One (18:83). Proto-Semitic *qarn- (horn).
meaning.ar: القرن: الضم والجمع — وكم أهلكنا من القرون — قيضنا لهم قرناء — مقرنين في الأصفاد — ذا القرنين

meaning.en: Pilgrimage (Hajj); argument/proof. Ibn Faris: core = intentional aiming. 33 occurrences. Hajj (9x) = pilgrimage. Hajja (I, 1x) = to perform Hajj. Hajja (III, 12x) = to argue/dispute. Hujjah (7x) = proof/argument. Hajj (1x) = pilgrim. Hijaj (1x) = years (28:27). Cognate: Hebrew chag (festival).
meaning.ar: الحج: القصد — ولله على الناس حج البيت — يحاجونكم — حجة — حاج — ثمني حجج

meaning.en: Forbearance, clemency; dream, puberty. Ibn Faris: two cores — forbearance AND dream. 21 occurrences. Halim (15x) = Forbearing — Divine Name (11x) and applied to Ibrahim/Ishmael/Shuayb (4x). Ahlam (6x) = dreams (12:44, 21:5) + puberty (24:58-59) + minds (52:32). Al-Halim paired with Ghafur/ Alim/Shakur.
meaning.ar: الحلم: ضد السفه — والله غفور حليم — أضغاث أحلام — بلغوا الحلم — حليم

meaning.en: Companion, gentleness, ease; elbow. 5 occurrences. Rafiq (1x) = companion — with prophets and righteous (4:69). Marafiq (1x) = elbows (5:6). Mirfaq (1x) = ease/comfort (18:16). Murtafaq (2x) = resting place — Hell fire and Paradise (18:29,31). Semantic orbit: gentle companionship + physical comfort.
meaning.ar: الرفق: اللطف واللين — رفيقا — المرافق — مرفقا — مرتفقا

meaning.en: To stand, stop, detain. 4 occurrences. Wuqifu (I passive, 3x) = they are made to stand — before their Lord (6:27,30). Waqifuhum (I imperative, 1x) = stop them (37:24). Mawqufun (1x) = made to stand — before Allah (34:31). All eschatological: standing before God for judgment.
meaning.ar: الوقف: القيام والمنع — ووقفوا على ربهم — وقفوهم إنهم مسؤولون — موقوفون

meaning.en: To prevent, forbid, protect, defend. Ibn Faris: prevention + protection. 17 occurrences. Manaa (I, 12x) = to prevent — what prevented you from prostrating (7:12, 38:75). Manna (2x) = habitual forbidder of good (50:25, 68:12). Manua (1x) = withholding (70:21). Mania (1x) = defending fortresses (59:2). Mamnua (1x) = never withheld (56:33). Cognate: Hebrew mana.
meaning.ar: المنع: الحفظ والحرمان — ما منعك أن لا تسجد — مناع للخير — مانعتهم حصونهم — ممنوعة

meaning.en: Flame, shooting star, meteor. FIXED: root is ش ه ب (flame), NOT ش ح ب (pale/emaciated). 5 occurrences. Shihab (4x) = burning flame/shooting star (15:18, 27:7, 37:10, 72:9) — devils pelted with shihab. Shuhub (1x) = flaming fires (72:8). All in context of jinn trying to eavesdrop on heaven.
meaning.ar: الشهاب: شعلة النار — شهاب مبين — شهابا — شهبا — إلا من خطف الخطفة فأتبعه شهاب ثاقب

data_correction: FIXED: Root is ش ه ب (shooting star/flame), NOT ش ح ب (pale). Buckwalter h = ه, not ح.

meaning.en: To escape, be absent. FIXED: root is ع ز ب (escape), NOT ع ذ ب (punish, which is root E*b ID 56). 2 occurrences. Azaba (I, 2x) = to escape/be absent — nothing escapes (ya zubu) from your Lord (10:61, 34:3). Distinct root from E*b (ع ذ ب = punishment, 373x).
meaning.ar: العزب: الذهاب والبعد — وما يعزب عن ربك من مثقال ذرة — لا يعزب عنه مثقال ذرة

data_correction: FIXED: Root ع ز ب (escape, 2x) is distinct from ع ذ ب (punish, ID 56, 373x). Latin Ezb = ع ز ب, NOT ع ذ ب.

meaning.en: To ride, mount, embark. 15 occurrences. Rakiba (I, 9x) = to ride — ships, animals (36:72, 43:12). Rakkaba (II, 1x) = to assemble (82:8). Rikab (1x) = riding camels (59:6). Rakb (1x) = caravan. Rukban (1x) = riding (2:239). Rakub (1x) = mount. Mutarakib (1x) = thick clustered (6:99).
meaning.ar: الركب: ركوب الدابة — لتركبوها — والفلك — ركبانا — متراكبا — ركبا

meaning.en: Reward, wage, recompense. Ibn Faris: core = recompense for work. 108 occurrences. Ajr (105x) = reward — overwhelmingly divine reward. Istajara (X, 2x) = to hire (28:26 — Musa). Tajura (I, 1x) = to work for hire (28:27). Ujur (pl) = bridal due/mahr (4:24, 33:50). Hadith: al-ajr = heavenly thawab. Cognate: Hebrew agrah (fee).
meaning.ar: الأجر: الجزاء على العمل — أجرهم — أجورهن — استأجر — أجر عظيم

meaning.en: Nobility, generosity, honor. Ibn Faris: core = honor and superiority. 47 occurrences in 8 forms. Karim (30x) = noble/generous — the Noble Quran (56:77). Karramna (II, 2x) = We honored — Children of Adam (17:70). Akram (2x) = most noble — noblest is most God-conscious (49:13). Al-Akram (96:3) = the Most Generous. Mukramun (5x) = the honored ones. Dhu al-Jalal wal-Ikram (55:27,78) = Lord of Majesty and Honor.
meaning.ar: الكرم: الشرف والنبل — إنا أكرمناه — إن أكرمكم عند الله أتقاكم — وقل ربي زدني كرما

meaning.en: To make, manufacture, do. 20 occurrences. Sanaa (I, 15x) = to make/construct — Noah built the Ark (11:37). Istanaa (VIII, 1x) = to choose/produce — I have produced you for Myself (20:41). Sun (2x) = workmanship — heavens as Allah sun (27:88). Sanat (1x) = making — David taught armor-making (21:80). Masani (1x) = strongholds (26:129).
meaning.ar: الصنع: عمل الشيء بإحكام — واصنع الفلك — صنع الله — واصطنعتك لنفسي — مصانع

meaning.en: To return; to discuss; wide-eyed (hur). 13 occurrences. Yahura (I, 1x) = to return (84:14 — he thought he would never return to Allah). Yuhawiru (III, 2x) = to discuss/converse (18:34, 37). Hawariyyun (5x) = disciples — Jesus white-clad disciples (3:52). Hur (4x) = fair maidens (wide-eyed). Tahawur (VI, 1x) = mutual questioning (58:1). Al-Hayy al-Qayyum also carries the Divine sense of the One who perpetually turns affairs.

meaning.en: To be swift, quick, hasten. Ibn Faris: speed — opposite of slowness. 23 occurrences. Yusaria (III, 9x) = to hasten — hasten to good deeds and forgiveness (3:133). Saria (10x) = swift — Allah is swift in reckoning (8x), swift in penalty (2x). Asraa (2x) = swifter/swiftest. Siraa (2x) = hurrying (50:44, 70:43).
meaning.ar: السرعة: ضد البطء — سارعوا إلى مغفرة — إن الله سريع الحساب — أسرع — سراعا

meaning.en: Grave, tomb, burial. 8 occurrences. Qabr/qubur (6x) = grave. Maqabir (1x) = graveyards — until you visit the graveyards (102:2). Aqbara (IV, 1x) = to provide burial — then causes his death and provides a grave (80:21). Maqbur (passive participle) is NOT in Quran.
meaning.ar: القبر: مدفن الميت — ثم أماته فأقبره — زرتم المقابر — قبور

meaning.en: Insult, revile; cause, means, way. FIXED: count 5->11. 11 occurrences. Sabab (9x) = cause/means/way/rope — dominant usage. Dhu al-Qarnayn followed a way (18:85, 89, 92). Yasubbu (I, 2x) = to insult — do not insult what they invoke besides Allah (6:108).
meaning.ar: السبب: الحبل والطريق — فأتبع سببا — ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله — سب

data_correction: FIXED: count 5->11. Sabab (cause/means, 9x) dominates over insult (2x).

meaning.en: To return, repel, reject, send back. Ibn Faris: returning and repelling. 59 occurrences in 8 forms. Radda (I, 36x) = to return/repel/reject — dominant. Irtadda (VIII, 8x) = to turn back/apostatize. Maradd (6x) = place of return/averting — la maradda lahu (there is no averting it). Radd (3x) = repeller/returner. Taraddada (V, 1x) = to waver — hearts in doubt (9:45).
meaning.ar: الرد: الرجع والمنع — ردوا إلى الله — لا مرد له — ارتدوا على أدبارهم — راد

meaning.en: Refuge, shelter. 3 occurrences — ALL noun malja. Malja (3x) = refuge/shelter — they will find no refuge (9:57, 9:118, 42:47). No verb forms in Quran.
meaning.ar: اللجأ: الملاذ — يجدوا ملجأ — ملجأ — لا ملجأ من الله

meaning.en: To despair, lose all hope. 13 occurrences. Ya isa (I) = to despair — never despair of Allah mercy (12:87, 39:53). Istay asa (X, 3x) = to lose hope completely (Joseph brothers, 12:80, 12:110). Ya us (adj) = despairing. Ya s = despair. Opposite: raja (hope).
meaning.ar: اليأس: القنوط — لا تيأسوا من روح الله — استيأسوا — يئوسا — يأسا

meaning.en: To despair, give up hope. 6 occurrences. Qanata (I) = to despair — do not despair of Allah mercy (39:53, with yAs). Qunut (v.n.) = despair. Qanit (act. part.) = despairing. Qanut (adj) = very despairing — man is very despairing (41:49).
meaning.ar: القنط: اليأس — لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله — قنوطا — قانطون — يئوس قنوط

meaning.en: To heal, cure. 6 occurrences. Shifa (v.n.) = healing/cure — in it is a cure for what is in the breasts (10:57), honey as healing (16:69). Shafa (I) = to heal (9:14, 26:80). NOTE: shafa ah (intercession) is from DIFFERENT root ش ف ع (, 29x), not this root.
meaning.ar: الشفاء: البرء من المرض — فيه شفاء للناس — شفاء — يشف — شفاء

meaning.en: Illness, disease, sickness. FIXED: count 5->24. 24 occurrences. Marad (14x) = disease — in their hearts is a disease (2:10, dominant: spiritual hypocrisy disease). Marid (adj, 5x) = sick/ill. Marda (3x) = sick (pl). Mariid (2x) = ill. I cannot be ill (26:80). One of the most frequent condition roots.
meaning.ar: المرض: السقم — في قلوبهم مرض — مريض — مرضى — إني مرضت

data_correction: FIXED: count 5->24. Dominant usage: spiritual disease of hypocrisy (2:10).

meaning.en: To gasp, cry out. 2 occurrences. Shahiq (2x) = gasping/crying out — the horrible sound of Hell (11:106, 67:7). Both are the noun describing the sound of the damned.
meaning.ar: الشهيق: الصوت الشديد — لهم فيها زفير وشهيق — سمعوا لها شهيقا

meaning.en: To sell; to purchase, exchange. Ibn Faris: barter and exchange. 25 occurrences — Arabic contranym (buy AND sell). Shara (I, 4x) = to sell — they sold Yusuf (12:20). Ishtara (VIII, 21x) = to purchase/exchange — overwhelmingly negative (exchange truth for falsehood); EXCEPT 9:111 (Allah purchased believers lives).
meaning.ar: الشرى: المبادلة — وشروه بثمن بخس — اشتروا الضلالة بالهدى — إن الله اشترى من المؤمنين أنفسهم

meaning.en: To intend, aim; moderate; straight path. 6 occurrences. Qasd (2x) = straight/balanced path (16:9, and moderation in walking 31:19). Muqtasid (1x) = moderate (35:32). Qasid (1x) = moderate path (5:66, 9:42, 31:32). Ibn Faris: core = straightness and moderation.
meaning.ar: القصد: الاعتدال والاستقامة — وعلى الله قصد السبيل — واقصد في مشيك — مقتصد

meaning.en: To confine, besiege, restrict. FIXED: count 12->6. 6 occurrences. Ahsara (IV) = to be confined/restricted (2:196 during Hajj, 2:273 charity). Hasara (I) = to besiege (9:5). Hasur (adj) = chaste (John the Baptist, 3:39). Hasir (1x) = mat/prison floor (17:8).
meaning.ar: الحصر: التضييق — أحصرتم — حصورا — حصيرا — محصورين

data_correction: FIXED: count 12->6.

meaning.en: To surround, encircle; garden. 3 occurrences — ALL hada iq (enclosed gardens/orchards). Hada iq (3x) = gardens — enclosed by walls or careful cultivation (27:60, 78:32, 80:30). The verb hadaqa (to encircle) not in Quran.
meaning.ar: الحدق: الإحاطة بالنظر — وحدائق ذات بهجة — حدائق — وحدائق غلبا

meaning.en: To betray, deceive; treachery. Ibn Faris: breach of trust (naqd al-amanah). 16 occurrences in 6 forms. Khana (I, 5x) = to betray — do not betray Allah and the Messenger (8:27). Ikhtana (VIII, 2x) = to deceive oneself. Khiyanah (2x) = betrayal. Khawwan (2x) = treacherous. Khainin (3x) = traitors. Khainah (2x) = treacherous glance (5:13, 40:19).
meaning.ar: الخيانة: نقض الأمانة — لا تخونوا الله والرسول — خائنة الأعين — خوانا أثيما

meaning.en: Provision, supplies. 2 occurrences — both in the Hajj verse (2:197). Tazawwadu (V, 1x) = take provisions — and take provisions, for the best provision is taqwa (2:197). Zad (1x) = provision — same verse.
meaning.ar: الزاد: ما يتزوده المسافر — وتزودوا فإن خير الزاد التقوى

meaning.en: To slip, stumble, err. 4 occurrences. Zalla (I, 2x) = to slip — lest your feet slip after being firm (2:209, 16:94). Azalla (IV, 1x) = to make slip — Satan made them slip (2:36). Istazalla (X, 1x) = to cause to slip (3:155). Zalzala (earthquake) is DIFFERENT root (ز ل ز ل).
meaning.ar: الزلل: الوقوع في الخطأ — أزلهما الشيطان — لا تزل قدم — استزلهم — الزلزلة: جذر مستقل

meaning.en: To gain, profit. SINGLE occurrence at 2:16 — their trade did not profit (fama rabihat tijaratuhum).
meaning.ar: الربح: النماء والزيادة — فما ربحت تجارتهم

meaning.en: To complete, perfect, be finished. 22 occurrences. Atamma (IV, 16x) = to perfect/complete — I perfect My favor upon you (2:150). Tamma (I, 4x) = to be completed — the Word of your Lord was completed (6:115). Tamam (1x) = completing (6:154). Mutimm (1x) = perfector (61:8).
meaning.ar: التمام: الكمال — وأتممت عليكم نعمتي — تمت كلمات ربك — تماما — متم نوره

meaning.en: To contain; blackness. 2 occurrences. Hawaya (1x) = entrails/intestines — that which is contained within (6:146). Ahwa (1x) = dark/blackish — dried vegetation turned black (87:5). No Form I verb hawa in Quran.
meaning.ar: الحوي: الجمع والاشتمال — حوايا — فأصبح غثاء أحوى — ما في بطونهما

meaning.en: To praise, commend. Ibn Faris: praise and commendation. 63 occurrences. Hamd (43x) = praise — al-hamdu lillah (1:2). Hamid (17x) = Praiseworthy (Divine Name, paired with Ghani/Aziz). Muhammad (4x) = the praised one (proper name). Ahmad (1x) = more praiseworthy (Jesus prophecy, 61:6). Mahmud (1x) = praised station (17:79). Hamidun (1x) = those who praise (9:112).
meaning.ar: الحمد: الثناء والمدح — الحمد لله رب العالمين — وهو الغني الحميد — محمد وأحمد

meaning.en: To move, stir. SINGLE occurrence. Tuharrik (II, 75:16) = move not your tongue with it (la tuharrik bihi lisanaka). Context: the Prophet told not to rush in repeating the revelation.
meaning.ar: الحركة: ضد السكون — لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به

meaning.en: Tree; to dispute, be entangled. Ibn Faris: intertwining and entanglement. 27 occurrences. Shajar (7x) = trees (collective). Shajarah (19x) = a tree — the forbidden tree, the blessed tree. Shajar (I, 1x) = a dispute arises (4:65). Core image: branches intertwining → tree AND entangled argument.
meaning.ar: الشجر: التداخل والالتواء — شجرة الخلد — مما اختلف أشجاره — فيما شجر بينهم

meaning.en: To drown, be overwhelmed. 23 occurrences. Aghraqa (IV, 17x) = to drown — We drowned them (Pharaoh). Gharaq (1x) = drowning (10:90). Gharq (1x) = violently (79:1). Mughraqun (IV pass. part., 4x) = drowned ones. Form I gharaqa does NOT occur in Quran.
meaning.ar: الغرق: الغرق في الماء — فأغرقناهم في اليم — حتى أدركه الغرق — والنازعات غرقا — مغرقين

meaning.en: To live; life; modesty; to greet. Ibn Faris: two cores — life (opposite of death) AND modesty. 184 occurrences in 12 forms. Ahyā (IV, 51x) = to give life. Hayāh (76x) = life — overwhelmingly al-hayat al-dunya (68/76x). Hayy (24x) = living — al-Hayy al-Qayyum (5x). Tahiyyah (6x) = greeting. Istahyā (X, 9x) = to spare life AND to be shy. Hayyah (1x) = snake (Moses staff). Hayawān (1x) = true life (Hereafter, 29:64).
meaning.ar: الحياة: نقيض الموت — هو الحي القيوم — الحياة الدنيا — وتحية — يستحيي — حية — الحيوان

meaning.en: DUPLICATE of ID 48 (tbE, 172x). To follow. This is the same root ت ب ع (to follow) recorded twice in the dataset. The primary entry is ID 48 with full analysis.
meaning.ar: الإتباع — مكرر: انظر ID 48

meaning.en: To inform; news; prophet. Ibn Faris: rising/elevation → announcement from on high. 160 occurrences in 6 forms. Nabba a (II, 46x) = to inform. Nabā (29x) = great news — al-naba al-azim (78:2). Nabī (75x) = prophet — from one who announces from God. Nubuwwah (5x) = prophethood. Nabī etymology: Aramaic loanword or native Arabic from nabā (news).
meaning.ar: النبأ: الظهور والارتفاع — عم يتساءلون عن النبإ العظيم — ونبي — ونبأ — ونبوة

meaning.en: DUPLICATE of ID 12 (nSr, 158x). To help, grant victory. Same root ن ص ر recorded twice. Primary entry is ID 12 with full analysis.
meaning.ar: النصر — مكرر: انظر ID 12

meaning.en: To measure, determine; power, ability; decree. Ibn Faris: measuring + power. 132 occurrences. Qadir (45x) = All-Powerful (Divine Name). Qadara (55x combined) = to measure/deem. Qadir (14x) = able. Taqdir (5x) = predestination/decree. Muqtadir (4x) = prevailing. Miqdar (3x) = measure. Qudur (1x) = cauldrons (homonym). Surah al-Qadr (97) = Night of Decree. Key: ala kulli shay in qadir (over all things All-Powerful).
meaning.ar: القدر: القدرة والتقدير — إن الله على كل شيء قدير — ليلة القدر — تقدير العزيز العليم

meaning.en: To resolve, determine, decide. FIXED: count 128->9. 9 occurrences. Azama (I, 4x) = to resolve — resolve on a matter (2:227, 3:186, 47:21). Azm (5x) = determination/resolution — from the resolution of matters (31:17). Ulū al-azm = possessors of resolve (among messengers, 46:35).
meaning.ar: العزم: القطع والبت — وإن عزموا الطلاق — من عزم الأمور — أولي العزم من الرسل

data_correction: FIXED: count 128->9. Only 9 occurrences.

meaning.en: To enter, come in. 126 occurrences. Dakhala (I, 76x) = to enter. Adkhala (IV, 42x) = to cause to enter/admit — enter them into Paradise. Dakhal (2x) = fault/defect. Dakhilun (2x) = entering. Mudkhal (3x) = place of entry. Key: enter the Garden of Eden (enter through gates).
meaning.ar: الدخول: ضد الخروج — ادخلوها بسلام آمنين — وأدخلناهم في رحمتنا — دخل — داخلا

meaning.en: Human being; skin; glad tidings. Ibn Faris: two cores — skin/outer surface AND good news (joy shows on the skin). 123 occurrences. Bashshara (II, 38x) = give glad tidings. Bashar (37x) = human being — only we are mortals like you. Bushra (15x) = glad tidings. Bashir (9x) = bearer of glad tidings (paired with nadhir). Istabshara (X, 7x) = to rejoice. Basharū (III, 2x) = have relations (skin-to-skin). Proto-Semitic *basar- (flesh).
meaning.ar: البشر: الجلد والخبر الصادق — بشرا مثلنا — وبشر المؤمنين — بشرى — بشيرا ونذيرا — وباشروهن

meaning.en: To provide, grant sustenance. Ibn Faris: fortune, allotment, bounty, giving. 123 occurrences. Razaqa (I, 61x) = to provide. Rizq (55x) = provision/sustenance. Raziqin (6x) = providers — Khayr al-Raziqin (Best of providers, 5x). Al-Razzaq (1x) = the All-Provider (Divine Name, 51:58). Etymology: Middle Persian rozig (daily bread) loanword.
meaning.ar: الرزق: الحظ والنصيب والإعطاء — وأنت خير الرازقين — إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين — رزقا

meaning.en: Hand, hands. 120 occurrences — ALL noun (yad/aydī). No verbs in Quran. Yad = hand — the Hand of Allah is above their hands (48:10). Aydi = hands. Most frequent body part; divine agency expressed as Hand. Key: give with your own hands into destruction (2:195), hands speak on Judgment Day (36:65).
meaning.ar: اليد: العضو — يد الله فوق أيديهم — ولا تلقوا بأيديكم إلى التهلكة — والأيدي — بيده

meaning.en: Paternal uncle, aunt. FIXED: count 119->5. Root ع م م in Quran = only uncle/aunt. Amm (2x) = paternal uncle. Ammat (3x) = paternal aunts. The word ummah (أمة, nation) is from DIFFERENT root أ م م (Amm, with hamza), NOT ع م م (Emm, with ayn). The general/universal meaning is NOT from this root.
meaning.ar: العم: أخو الأب — عم — عمة — عمات — ملاحظة: الأمة من جذر أمم (بالهمزة) ليس عمم (بالعين)

data_correction: FIXED: count 119->5. Root ع م م = uncle, NOT ummah (nation) which is from root أ م م. Different initial consonant.

meaning.en: To be mighty, powerful; honor, glory. Ibn Faris: strength, power, dominance. 119 occurrences. Al-Aziz (64x) = the Almighty (Divine Name, paired with Hakim/Rahim). Aziz (35x) = mighty/invincible. Izz/izzah (11x) = honor/glory — all honor belongs to Allah (35:10). Aazz (3x) = mightier. Azza (I, 1x) = overpowered (38:23). Aazza (IV, 1x) = to honor (3:26). Only 2 verb forms in Quran.
meaning.ar: العزة: القوة والشدة — وهو العزيز الحكيم — من كان يريد العزة فلله العزة جميعا — وعزني — وتعز

meaning.en: Father. 117+ occurrences. ALL noun (ab, aba — case forms). Not a verb root in Quran. Key: O my father (ya abati, ~14x), your fathers (aba ukum), their fathers (aba ahum). Father Ibrahim (Abu Ibrahim). NOTE: This root means FATHER only. The AI file confused it with root أ ب ي (aba = to refuse).
meaning.ar: الأبوة: الأب — يا أبت — آباؤكم — آبائهم — ملاحظة: ليس من رفض (أبى)

meaning.en: To spend; to sell; hypocrisy; tunnel. Ibn Faris: emergence/egress. 111 occurrences. Anfaqa (IV, 68x) = to spend — from what We provided them, they spend (2:3). Munafiqun/-at (32x) = hypocrites. Nifaq (3x) = hypocrisy. Nafaq (1x) = tunnel (6:35). Unique root: spending is wealth emerging, hypocrisy is falsehood emerging, tunnel is way out.
meaning.ar: النفق: الخروج والإنفاق — ومما رزقناهم ينفقون — المنافقون — نفقا — ونفاق

meaning.en: To eat, consume. 109 occurrences. Akala (I, ~65x) = to eat/consume. Kul (imperative, 32x) = eat! — Eat of the good things (2:168). Akkala (3x) = devourer. Ma kul (1x) = eaten. Key: eat and drink (kulu wa-shrabu, 2:60), consuming usury, eating of forbidden things.
meaning.ar: الأكل: ابتلاع الطعام — كلوا واشربوا — أكلهم — وكلا — آكل

meaning.en: To do, act, perform. 108 occurrences. Faala (I, 83x) = to do/act — what they used to do (kana yafaluna). Fail (9x) = doer. Maf ul (7x) = done/deed. The generic verb of action — all human and divine acts. Key: Allah is Aware of what you do (3:153).
meaning.ar: الفعل: العمل — بما كنتم تفعلون — فاعل — مفعول — افعلوا

meaning.en: To transgress; enemy, enmity. 106 occurrences. Aduww (39x) = enemy. Udwan (8x) = transgression. A da (7x) = prepared/returned. Aad (6x) = returned. Ada (6x) = enmity. I tada (VIII, 5x) = to transgress. Muta din (9x) = transgressors. Key: do not transgress (la ta tadū, 2:190). Satan is an open enemy (aduwwun mubīn).
meaning.ar: العدو: التجاوز والعداوة — إن الشيطان لكم عدو مبين — ولا تعتدوا — عدوانا — عاد

meaning.en: To exceed, excel; bounty, grace, preference. Ibn Faris: excess/increase. 104 occurrences. Fadl (84x) = bounty/grace — overwhelmingly Allah bounty. Faddala (II, 17x) = to prefer/favor — We preferred prophets over others. Tafdil (2x) = excellence. Yatafaddala (V, 1x) = to claim superiority (negative). Key: seek Allah bounty (wabtaghu min fadli Allah).
meaning.ar: الفضل: الزيادة — وابتغوا من فضل الله — وفضلناهم — وفضل — وهو ذو الفضل العظيم

meaning.en: To return, refer back, revert. 104 occurrences. Rajaa (I, 80x) = to return — to Allah is your return (5:105). Marji (16x) = place of return/destination. Raji (4x) = returning. Taraj (VI, 1x) = mutual return. Key: everything returns to Allah; refer disputes to God and Messenger.
meaning.ar: الرجوع: العودة — إلى الله مرجعكم — وإلى ربك الرجعى — راجع — مرجع

meaning.en: To permit, announce; ear. FIXED: root is أ ذ ن (ear/permission), NOT أ م ن (faith/safety, ID 4, 879x). The AI file had corrupted data. Azina (I, 4x) = to permit. Adhan (1x) = call to prayer (7:44). Adhin (1x) = attentive. Udhun (6x) = ear — pl. adhan (ears).
meaning.ar: الأذن: الإذن والاستماع — وأذن في الناس بالحج — أذن — آذان — وإذن

data_correction: FIXED: Root أ ذ ن (ear/permission, 95x total in concordance) NOT أ م ن (faith, ID 4). AI file corrupted root identity.

meaning.en: To be still, stagnant; to kick, flee. 3 occurrences. Tarkuduna (21:12) = you were fleeing (from punishment). Irkud (38:42) = strike (with your foot). Third occurrence: 21:13. Forms: rawakid (pl. stagnant). Root merges stillness and kicking/fleeing.
meaning.ar: الركض: الضرب والجري — اركض برجلك — يركضون

meaning.en: To destroy, ruin. 2 occurrences. Yukhribu (IV, 1x) = to destroy — they destroyed their houses with their own hands (59:2). Kharab (1x) = ruin/destruction (2:114). Form I kharib not in Quran.
meaning.ar: الخراب: الدمار — يخربون بيوتهم بأيديهم — خرابها

meaning.en: To beget, give birth; child, parent. 102 occurrences. Walad (56x) = child/offspring. Walid (14x) = father/parent. Waliday (10x) = parents (dual). Walada (I, 9x) = to beget/be born. Mawlud (3x) = one begotten. Walid (7x) = young child/boys (wildan in Paradise). Allah begets not, nor is He begotten (112:3).
meaning.ar: الولد: الإنجاب — لم يلد ولم يولد — وولد — ووالد — ووالديه — وولدان

meaning.en: Religion, judgment; debt, obedience. Ibn Faris: subjugation, obedience, reckoning. 101 occurrences. Dīn (92x) = religion/judgment — yawm al-dīn (Day of Judgment, 15x). Dayn (5x) = debt (2:282 the long debt verse). Madīnīn (2x) = brought to judgment. Proto-Semitic *dVn- (judgment). Persian dēn (religious conscience) shaped Islamic dīn.
meaning.ar: الدين: الخضوع والطاعة والحساب — مالك يوم الدين — إن الدين عند الله الإسلام — دينا — ومدينين

meaning.en: Youth, young person; to kindle/ignite. 4 occurrences. Shab (2x) = young men — companions of the youth (ashab al-kahf, 18:10,13). Shababat (1x) = young women (78:33). Yushabbu (II, 1x) = kindle (56:71 — fire you kindle). Roots  (ش ب ب) and  (ش ب ح) are different.
meaning.ar: الشباب: الحداثة — أصحاب الكهف فتيان — وشب — تشبون — الشَّابَّات

meaning.en: Brother, sister. 96 occurrences. Akh (75x) = brother. Ukht (14x) = sister. Ikhwah (7x) = brothers/siblings. Key: believers are brothers (ikhwah, 49:10). Prophets called their people brother (akhuhum). Joseph brothers (ikhwatu Yusuf). Proto-Semitic *ah-. Cognate: Hebrew ach.
meaning.ar: الأخوة: القرابة — إنما المؤمنون إخوة — وأخي هارون — إخوة يوسف — وأخت — وأخوات

meaning.en: Night. 92 occurrences. Layl (84x) = night — the night as a sign (2:164), night prayer (73:2), Night of Decree (laylat al-qadr). Laylah (8x) = a single night. Paired with nahar (day) in most occurrences. Proto-Semitic *laylay-. Cognate: Hebrew laylah.
meaning.ar: الليل: ضد النهار — والليل إذا يغشى — وليل — وليلة القدر — ليالي

meaning.en: To glorify; to swim/glide. Ibn Faris: gliding AND glorification (declaring transcendence). 92 occurrences. Subhana (42x) = Glory be to! (exclamatory). Sabbaha (II, 24x) = to glorify — everything in heavens and earth glorifies Allah. Tasbih (2x) = glorification. Sabh (2x) = swimming/gliding. Sabaha (I, 2x) = to swim/float (sun and moon, 21:33, 36:40). Cognate: Hebrew shibbeach (to praise).
meaning.ar: التسبيح: التنزيه والتحميد — سبحانك لا علم لنا — يسبح لله ما في السموات — وكل في فلك يسبحون

meaning.en: To not be (negation copula). 89 occurrences — ALL laysa with inflections. Laysa = not/is not/are not. The primary negation verb in Arabic. Negates nominative sentences. Conjugates: lastu, lasna, lasta, lasti, lastum, lastunna, laysa, laysat, laysu, lasna. Single form only — no other derived verbs or nouns in Quran.
meaning.ar: الليس: النفي — ليس البر أن تولوا وجوهكم — لست — ليست — لستم

meaning.en: Wealth, property. 86 occurrences — ALL noun māl/amwāl. Mal (singular) and amwal (plural) = wealth, property, possessions. No verb forms in Quran. Key: wealth as trial (fitnah, 8:28), wealth and children as adornment (18:46), spend from what We provided (2:254). Etymology: from Aramaic mamonā (wealth).
meaning.ar: المال: ما يملك — أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة — وأنفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه — ومال

meaning.en: To remain forever, abide eternally. Ibn Faris: permanence and eternity. 87 occurrences. Khalid (74x) = abiding forever — khalidīna fīhā (Paradise/Hell refrain). Khuld (6x) = eternity — Jannat al-Khuld (Garden of Eternity). Khulud (1x) = everlastingness. Mukhalladūn (2x) = immortal youths (Paradise). Akhlada (IV, 2x) = to cling to earth / to make immortal. Khalada (I, 2x). Cognate: Hebrew kheled (world/era).
meaning.ar: الخلد: البقاء والدوام — خالدين فيها — جنة الخلد — وما جعلناهم جسدا لا يأكلون الطعام وما كانوا خالدين

meaning.en: One, anyone; the One (of God). 85 occurrences. Ahad (74x) = one/anyone — Qul huwa Allahu Ahad (112:1). Ihda (11x) = one (feminine).
