Ahad is the ABSOLUTE ONE — used as divine predicate in Surah al-Ikhlas. Negation: la yaqdira alayhi ahadun (no one has power over him, 90:5). DISTINCT from wahid (numerical one, 30x). Proto-Semitic *ahad-. Cognate: Hebrew echad.
meaning.ar: الأحد: الواحد في النفي — قل هو الله أحد — لا يقدِر عليه أحد — إحدى — وليس كأحد

meaning.en: To be saved, escape; secret counsel. 84 occurrences. Najja (II, 29x) = to save/rescue. Anja (IV, 19x) = to save — We saved him. Naja (I, 8x) = to escape. Najwa (11x) = secret counsel/conversation. Tanaja (VI, 3x) = to whisper privately. Key: yawma yafirru al-mar u min akhihi... (Day of fleeing, 80:34). Najwa contexts: the hypocrites whispering (58:8-10).
meaning.ar: النجاة: الخلاص والسر — نجا — نجينا — تناجوا — نجواهم — وأسروا النجوى

meaning.en: How? 83 occurrences — ALL the interrogative particle kayfa. Kayfa tafuruuna (how do you disbelieve?). Kayfa faala rabbuka (how your Lord dealt with...). Kayfa takfuruna bi-Llahi... (2:28). Expressive: fa-kayfa (so how...?), kayfa law (how about if...?). Single form only — no verb derivatives in Quran.
meaning.ar: الكيف: الاستفهام — كيف تكفرون بالله — فكيف — كيف فعل ربك

meaning.en: To be equal, level, straight; to fashion, establish. Ibn Faris: equality and straightness. 83 occurrences in 7 forms. Istawa (VIII, 35x) = to be equal / to establish on the Throne (istawa ala al-arsh). Sawwa (II, 13x) = to fashion/proportion — He fashioned you (82:7). Sawa (27x) = equal/same — it is the same to them (sawaun alayhim). Sawiyy (5x) = straight/well-proportioned.
meaning.ar: التسوية: المساواة والاستقامة — الرحمن على العرش استوى — فسواك فعدلك — سواء عليهم — صراطا سويا

meaning.en: Heel; consequence, punishment; to follow after. 80 occurrences. Iqab (20x) = punishment. Aqaba (III, 35x) = to punish/follow. Uqba/uqba (5x) = ultimate outcome — the best outcome (lil-muttaqin, 13:22). Aqab (4x) = heels. Mu aqqib (2x) = one following. Key: good outcome (aqibat al-muttaqin) vs evil outcome (su al-aqibah). Ibn Faris: core = coming after.
meaning.ar: العقب: الإتيان بعد الشيء — والعاقبة للمتقين — عقاب — أعقاب — معقبات

meaning.en: To present, display, turn away; to be broad. FIXED: root is ع ر ض (to present/turn away), NOT أ ر ض (earth, ID 78, 461x). 79 occurrences. Arada (IV, 23x) = to turn away — they turned away from My signs. Arada (I, 28x) = to present/expose. Mu rid (19x) = one turning away. Arid (1x) = broad/wide. Buckwalter ErD = ع ر ض (E=ayin), distinct from ArD (أ ر ض, A=hamza).
meaning.ar: العرض: الظهور والإعراض — أعرض — ونعرض جهنم — معرضون — عريض

data_correction: FIXED: Root ع ر ض (ayin-ra-dad = present/turn away), NOT أ ر ض (hamza-ra-dad = earth, ID 78). AI file had wrong Arabic.

meaning.en: To reveal, inspire; revelation. Ibn Faris: secret/hidden communication. 78 occurrences — Form IV dominant (72x). Awha (IV) = God revealed to prophets (42:7), inspired the bee (16:68), inspired Moses mother (28:7), devils inspire one another (6:112). Wahy (6x) = revelation — it is only a revelation revealed (53:4). Three modes: divine revelation, instinctual inspiration, evil whispering.
meaning.ar: الوحي: الإعلام الخفي — إن هو إلا وحي يوحى — وأوحى ربك إلى النحل — يوحون إلى أوليائهم

meaning.en: Face, direction; to face, turn toward. 78 occurrences. Wajh (35x) = face — the Face of your Lord remains (55:27). Wujuh (35x) = faces — faces whitened/blackened (3:106). Wajih (2x) = eminent/noble — he was eminent in this world and the Hereafter (3:45). Tawajjaha (V, 1x) = to head toward. Key: wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah (2:115).
meaning.ar: الوجه: ما يواجه به — فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله — وجوه يومئذ ناضرة — وجيها

meaning.en: To hit, befall, afflict; correctness. FIXED: root is ص و ب (to hit/befall), NOT ث و ب (garment/reward). 77 occurrences. Asaba (IV, 28x) = to hit/befall — what befalls them. Sayyib (20x) = raincloud. Musib (11x) = one who hits. Sawab (1x) = correctness. Sabba (I, 8x) = to pour. Buckwalter Swb = ص و ب (S=sad), distinct from vwb (ث و ب, ID 421).
meaning.ar: الصواب: الإصابة — أصاب — يصيب — صيب — مصيب — صواب

data_correction: FIXED: Root ص و ب (sad-waw-ba = hit/befall), NOT ث و ب (tha-waw-ba = reward/garment, ID 421). AI file had wrong Arabic root.

meaning.en: To reach, attain, deliver, convey. 77 occurrences. Balagha (I, 43x) = to reach/attain — until he reaches his full strength. Balagh (15x) = delivery/proclamation — my duty is only clear delivery. Baligh (9x) = adjective: reaching/effective. Ablagha (IV, 5x) = to deliver/convey. Baligh (1x) = eloquent. Key: the Messenger duty is only balagh al-mubin (clear proclamation, 24:54).
meaning.ar: البلاغ: الوصول والإيصال — وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ المبين — بلغ أشده — بالغ — أبلغكم

meaning.en: To be few, little. 76 occurrences. Qalil (70x) = little/few. Qalla (I, 1x) = to be little. Yuqallilu (II, 1x) = to make appear few. Aqall (2x) = lesser/fewer. Aqallat (IV, 1x) = carried clouds. Qalilah (1x) = small force (2:249).
meaning.ar: القلة: ضد الكثرة — قليلا ما تؤمنون — وقليل من عبادي الشكور

meaning.en: To harm, damage; affliction. 74 occurrences in 11 forms. Yadurru (I, 19x) = to harm. Durr (19x) = affliction. Darr (10x) = harm. Darra (9x) = hardship. Udturra (VIII, 7x) = forced by necessity. Yudarra (III, 3x) = made to suffer. Dirar (2x) = causing harm. Al-Darr = Divine Name (paired with al-Nafi).
meaning.ar: الضر: الأذى — إن يمسسك الله بضر — لا يضركم — واضطر — ضراء ولا ضرار

meaning.en: Might, severity, hardship. 73 occurrences. Bi sa (I, 40x) = how evil is! Bas (25x) = might/severity. Basa (4x) = adversity/suffering. Bais (1x) = wretched punishment. Bais (1x) = miserable. Tabt is (VIII, 2x) = do not be distressed.
meaning.ar: البأس: الشدة — بئسما اشتروا به — بأسنا — والبأساء — وبئس

meaning.en: House, dwelling; to spend the night. 73 occurrences. Bayt (65x) = house — al-Bayt (Ka bah). Bayyata (II, 4x) = to plot by night. Bayat (3x) = by night. Yabitu (I, 1x) = to spend the night prostrating (25:64).
meaning.ar: البيت: المأوى — وطهر بيتي — بيت العنكبوت — يبيتون — بياتا

meaning.en: To be rich, self-sufficient; to avail. Ibn Faris: wealth and independence from need. 73 occurrences. Aghna (IV, 39x) = to enrich/avail. Ghaniyy (20x) = self-sufficient — al-Ghaniyy (Divine Name). Istaghna (X, 4x) = to deem self-sufficient (96:7). Aghniya (4x) = rich people. Mughnun (2x) = one who avails. Ghaniya (I, 4x) = to prosper. Al-Ghaniyy (18x) paired with al-Hamid.
meaning.ar: الغنى: الثراء والاستغناء — والله الغني الحميد — ما أغنى عنه ماله — واستغنى

meaning.en: Man, men; foot, leg. 73 occurrences. Rajul (29x) = man (singular). Rijal (28x) = men (plural). Rijl (15x) = foot/leg. Rajil (1x) = infantry/on foot (17:64).
meaning.ar: الرجل: الذكر البالغ — واستشهدوا شهيدين من رجالكم — ورجلا — وأرجلكم

meaning.en: To be high, exalted; height. Ibn Faris: height and elevation. 70 occurrences. Ta ala (I, 14x) = Exalted is He! of Allah. Ta al (IV, 8x) = Come! imperative. Aliyy (11x) = Most High (al-Aliyy Divine Name). A la (9x) = highest. Uluww (4x) = arrogance. Illiyyun (2x) = lofty station. Muta al (13:9) = Transcendent. Proto-Semitic *aly-. Cognate: Hebrew elyon.
meaning.ar: العلو: الارتفاع — وتعالى عما يصفون — وهو العلي العظيم — سبح اسم ربك الأعلى

meaning.en: To enjoy, benefit; provision. 70 occurrences. Mata (35x) = provision/enjoyment of this world. Matta a (II, 18x) = to grant enjoyment. Tamatta a (V, 11x) = to enjoy. Istamta a (X, 6x) = to benefit/enjoy.
meaning.ar: المتاع: المنفعة — متاع الحياة الدنيا — ومتعناهم إلى حين — فتمتعوا

meaning.en: To entrust, rely upon. 70 occurrences. Tawakkala (V, 40x) = to put trust in — upon Allah let believers rely (3:159). Wakil (24x) = Trustee/Guardian. Mutawakkilun (V act. part., 4x) = those who rely. Wukkila (II pass., 2x) = entrusted.
meaning.ar: التوكل: الاعتماد — وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون — وكفى بالله وكيلا

meaning.en: To think, suppose, believe; assumption. Ibn Faris: vacillation between certainty and doubt. 69 occurrences — sister of zanna (two accusatives). Ya zunnuna (47x) = they think/suppose/are certain. Zann (21x) = assumption. Zann can mean certainty (2:249 — those certain they will meet Allah) or mere assumption (53:28).
meaning.ar: الظن: التردد بين اليقين والشك — الذين يظنون أنهم ملاقو الله — إن الظن لا يغني من الحق شيئا

meaning.en: To dwell, be still; rest, tranquility. 69 occurrences. Sakana (I, 15x) = to dwell/rest. Sakinah (6x) = tranquility — His tranquility descended upon them (9:26, 48:4, 48:18, 48:26). Maskin (23x) = poor/needy. Maskan (12x) = dwelling. Askana (IV, 5x) = to settle/lodge. Sakan (3x) = rest/resting place. Sikin (1x) = knife (12:31).
meaning.ar: السكن: السكون والسكينة — فأنزل الله سكينته عليه — والمأوى مسكن — ومسكين

meaning.en: To perish, be destroyed; to destroy. 68 occurrences. Ahlaka (IV, 51x) = to destroy — We destroyed them for their sins. Halaka (I, 5x) = to perish/die. Muhlik (IV act. part., 5x) = one who destroys. Halik (2x) = (will be) destroyed. Tahlukah (1x) = destruction — do not cast yourselves into destruction (2:195).
meaning.ar: الهلاك: الفناء — أهلكناهم — ولا تلقوا بأيديكم إلى التهلكة — مهلك — هالك

meaning.en: To send, raise, resurrect. Ibn Faris: sending and rousing (al-irsal wa al-itharah). 67 occurrences. Baatha (I, 52x) = to raise/send — God raises the dead, sends prophets. Mab uthun (9x) = resurrected ones. Ba th (4x) = resurrection (yawm al-ba th). Inba atha (VII, 1x) = to be sent forth. Inbi ath (1x) = being sent forth. Proto-Semitic root. Antonym: amata (to cause death).
meaning.ar: البعث: الإرسال والإثارة — يبعثكم فيه — ويوم البعث — مبعوثون — لعلي أعمل صالحا

meaning.en: To commit crime; criminal. 66 occurrences. Mujrim (IV act. part., 52x) = criminal/sinner — overwhelmingly: al-mujrimun (the criminals). Jaram (5x) = la jaram = no doubt. Ajrama (IV, 5x) = to commit crime. Yajrima (I, 3x) = to incite/prevent. Ijram (1x) = crime.
meaning.ar: الجرم: الذنب — والمجرمون — لا جرم أن لهم النار — وما يجرمكم — أجرم

meaning.en: Eye, spring of water. 65 occurrences. Ayn (57x) = eye or spring — aynan jariyah (flowing spring). In (4x) = beautiful/large eyes (of maidens in Paradise). Ma in (4x) = flowing spring/stream. Proto-Semitic *ayn-. Cognate: Hebrew ayin.
meaning.ar: العين: البصر وينبوع الماء — عينا تجري — وحور عين — ومن ماء معين

meaning.en: To lose, suffer loss. Ibn Faris: loss and decrease. 65 occurrences in 10 forms. Khasira (I, 16x) = to lose. Khasirin (32x) = losers — al-khasirun (the losers). Akhsar (4x) = greatest losers. Khusran (3x) = loss. Takhsir (1x) = causing loss. Mukhsir (1x) = loss-causer. Key: inna al-insana la-fi khusrin (103:2 — mankind is in loss). Possible relation to Hebrew khaser (absent/missing).
meaning.ar: الخسر: النقصان — إن الإنسان لفي خسر — والخاسرين — والأخسرين أعمالا — خسرانا

meaning.en: To flow, run, sail. 64 occurrences. Jara (I, 57x) = to flow/run — rivers flowing beneath (tajri min tahtiha al-anhar), ships sailing, sun and moon running their courses. Jariyat (2x) = sailing ship. Jawar (3x) = ships (pl.). Majra (1x) = course (of a ship). Jariyat (2x) = flowing/sailing.
meaning.ar: الجري: الانسياب — تجري من تحتها الأنهار — والفلك تجري في البحر — وكل في فلك يسبحون

meaning.en: Water. 63 occurrences — ALL the noun ma (water) with case variants. Ma = water, ma in = flowing water. Root is م و ه (mim waw ha), NOT م و ح. Key: We made from water every living thing (21:30). His Throne was upon water (11:7). Water as source of life, purification, punishment (flood). Proto-Semitic *may-. Cognate: Hebrew mayim.
meaning.ar: الماء: السائل — وجعلنا من الماء كل شيء حي — وكان عرشه على الماء — ماء معين

meaning.en: To decree, judge, fulfill, finish. Ibn Faris: decisive completion and judgment (ihkam al-amr wa al-faragh minhu). 63 occurrences. Qada (I, 59x) = to decree/judge/fulfill — When He decrees a matter (2:117), His command is fulfilled as destiny decreed. Maqdiyy (2x) = decreed. Qadiyat (1x) = final end (69:27). Qadin (1x) = decreeing. Semantic range: divine decree, judgment, fulfillment of terms, killing, completing.
meaning.ar: القضاء: إحكام الأمر والفراغ منه — فإذا قضى أمرا — وقضى بينهم — فإذا قضيتم مناسككم — قضاء

meaning.en: Magic, sorcery; dawn. 63 occurrences. Sihr (28x) = magic/sorcery. Sahir (22x) = magician. Mashur (4x) = bewitched. Sahar (3x) = before dawn — by the dawn (89:1, al-Fajr). Sahhar (1x) = expert magician. Musahharin (2x) = those bewitched. Dual meaning: magic (illusion/deception) and dawn (the pre-dawn hour when magic is most potent).
meaning.ar: السحر: الخداع والوقت قبل الفجر — وجاءوا بسحر عظيم — قالوا إنما أنت من المسحرين — والفجر — سحر

meaning.en: To recite, follow. Ibn Faris: following + recitation — two inseparable senses. 63 occurrences. Yatlu (50x) = he recites — recites to them His verses. Utlu (imperative, 7x) = Recite! (first revealed command after iqra). Yutla (passive, 11x) = it is recited. Tilawa (1x) = recitation. Taliyat (participle, 1x) = those who recite. ONLY one occurrence in the original following sense: the moon follows the sun (91:2).
meaning.ar: التلاوة: الاتباع والقراءة — يتلو عليهم آياته — واتل ما أوحي إليك — والقمر إذا تلاها

meaning.en: To touch, feel, afflict. 61 occurrences. Massa (I, 56x) = to touch/afflict — when harm touches man. Mass (2x) = touch — no touch (of madness). Yatamassa (VI, 2x) = to touch — Hell and Paradise touch (55:54). Misas (1x) = touching (20:97). Key: no blame if you divorce before touching them (2:236-237).
meaning.ar: المس: اللمس والإصابة — وإن يمسسك الله بضر — ولا تمسوهن — وأن تمسوهن

meaning.en: To increase, add. 61 occurrences. Zada (I, 49x) = to increase — My Lord, increase me in knowledge (20:114). Izdada (VIII, 8x) = to increase (oneself). Ziyadah (2x) = increase/surplus. Mazid (2x) = extra/more — for them is more (10:26). Key phrase: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge (rabbi zidni ilman).
meaning.ar: الزيادة: النماء — وقل رب زدني علما — فزادهم الله مرضا — وازدادوا — مزيد

meaning.en: To test, tempt, persecute; trial. Ibn Faris: testing gold by fire to examine purity. 60 occurrences. Fitnah (34x) = trial/temptation/persecution — oppression is worse than killing (2:191, 2:217). Fatana (I, 23x) = to test/tempt — Satan tempts you. Futun (1x) = a trial (20:40). Fatinin (1x) = tempters. Maftun (1x) = afflicted/tempted. Wealth and children are fitnah (8:28, 64:15). Supplication: make us not a trial for wrongdoers (10:85).
meaning.ar: الفتنة: امتحان الذهب بالنار — والفتنة أشد من القتل — أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة — لا تجعلنا فتنة للقوم الظالمين

meaning.en: Unseen, absent; to backbite. 60 occurrences. Ghayb (49x) = the unseen — those who believe in the unseen (2:3). Ghuyub (4x) = unseen things. Ghaibin (3x) = absent ones. Ghayabat (2x) = bottom of well (Yusuf). Yaghtab (VIII, 1x) = to backbite — do not backbite one another (49:12). Ghaibat (1x) = absent (fem.). Knower of the unseen and the witnessed (Alim al-ghayb wa al-shahadah).
meaning.ar: الغيب: ما غاب عن الحواس — يؤمنون بالغيب — عالم الغيب والشهادة — ولا يغتب بعضكم بعضا

meaning.en: To appear, be manifest; back, surface; to support. DUPLICATE of ID 122 (Zhr, 59x). 10 forms. Zahara (I, 10x) = to appear. Azhara (IV, 8x) = to make appear. Zahr (15x) = back. Zahir (8x) = apparent — al-Zahir (Divine Name, 57:3). Zahir (6x) = helper. Zahara (III, 6x) = to support.
meaning.ar: الظهر: الظهور والبروز — وهو الظاهر والباطن — ظهور — أظهر — تظاهرون

meaning.en: Women. 59 occurrences — ALL the noun nisa (women/wives). No verb forms in Quran for this root. Nisa = women (generic). Key: O Prophet, tell your wives and daughters and the women of the believers (33:59). Also niswah (few women — Yusuf story).
meaning.ar: النساء: جمع امرأة — يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك وبناتك ونساء المؤمنين — ونسوة

meaning.en: To purify, give charity; growth. 59 occurrences. Zakah (32x) = obligatory charity — establish prayer and give zakah. Zakka (II, 12x) = to purify — purify them (the Prophet). Tazakka (V, 8x) = to purify oneself. Azka (4x) = purer/more virtuous — purer food (18:19, 2:232). Zaka (I, 1x) = to be pure. Zakiyy (1x) = pure (Yahya, 19:19). Zakiyyah (1x) = pure soul (18:74).
meaning.ar: الزكاة: النماء والطهارة — وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة — ويزكيهم — تزكى

meaning.en: To strike, hit; to set forth (an example); to travel. Ibn Faris: hitting and striking. 58 occurrences. Daraba (I, 55x) = to strike. Darb (3x) = striking. Key idioms: daraba mathalan = to strike a parable (~20x). Daraba fi al-ard = to travel (3:156). Daraba ala = to impose humiliation (2:61). Daraba bi asa = strike staff (Moses, 2:60). Daraba baynahum = put barrier between (57:13).
meaning.ar: الضرب: الإيقاع والتمثيل — واضرب لهم مثلا — ضربت عليهم الذلة — ضربا في الأرض

meaning.en: To count, number; to prepare. 57 occurrences in 11 forms. Aadda (IV, 20x) = to prepare — Allah has prepared for them (Paradise/Hell). Iddah (11x) = number, waiting period (of divorce). Adda (I, 7x) = to count. Adad (6x) = number. Madudah (6x) = numbered days. Madud (1x) = numbered day. Addada (II, 1x) = to count repeatedly (104:2). Udda (1x) = preparation (9:46). Addin (1x) = those who count. Taataddu (VIII, 1x) = to reckon.
meaning.ar: العد: الإحصاء — أعد الله لهم — فعدتهن — وعددا — أياما معدودات

meaning.en: Spirit, soul; wind; rest, mercy. Ibn Faris: breath/wind (nasim) or life (hayah). 57 occurrences. Ruh (21x) = spirit/soul — Ruḥ al-Qudus (Holy Spirit), min rūḥī (from My spirit breathed into Adam). Rīḥ (29x) = wind — mercy (glad tidings before rain) AND punishment (furious wind against Ad). Rawḥ (3x) = rest/mercy (12:87 — do not despair of Allah mercy). Rayḥān (2x) = fragrance/bounty. Rawāḥ (1x) = evening journey. Turīḥūna (1x) = bring home at evening. Proto-Semitic *rūḥ-. Cognate: Hebrew rúakh.
meaning.ar: الروح: النسيم والحياة — ونفخت فيه من روحي — روح القدس — ولا تيأسوا من روح الله — بريح — الريح

meaning.en: To forbid, prohibit; to cease, reach an end. Ibn Faris: prohibition/prevention (man). 56 occurrences. Nahā (I, 32x) = to forbid — they enjoin right and forbid wrong (amr bil-maruf wa nahy an al-munkar). Intahā (VIII, 16x) = to cease/desist. Muntahā (3x) = ultimate end — Sidrat al-Muntahā (53:14). Nuhā (2x) = intellect (that which restrains from folly). Nāhūn (1x) = those who forbid. Opposite: amr (command). Key pair: amr + nahy = moral backbone of Quran.
meaning.ar: النهي: المنع — يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر — انتهوا — سدرة المنتهى — أولي النهى

meaning.en: To call, proclaim, summon. 53 occurrences. Nādā (III, 44x) = to call out — they called out from afar (41:44), Moses Lord called him (79:16). Nidā (2x) = a call. Munādī (2x) = caller. Nadiyy (1x) = assembly/council. Tanāda (VI, 1x) = to call one another. Tanād (1x) = calling (40:32).
meaning.ar: النداء: الدعاء والصياح — وناداه ربه — فناداها من تحتها — مناديا ينادي — ناديكم

meaning.en: To be weak; to double, multiply. 52 occurrences in 12 forms. Daʿīf (8x) = weak — man was created weak (4:28). Ḍiʿf (11x) = double/multiple — multiplied punishment. Yuḍāʿif (III, 9x) = to double (reward). Istaḍʿafū (X, 8x) = to be oppressed/made weak — the oppressed among men (4:75). Daʿf (4x) = weakness — weakness after strength (30:54). Aḍʿaf (2x) = weaker. Mus taḍʿafūn (5x) = the oppressed. Muḍāʿafatan (1x) = multiplied.
meaning.ar: الضعف: ضد القوة — وخلق الإنسان ضعيفا — والمستضعفين — يضاعف — ضعفا — أضعف

meaning.en: Under, below. 51 occurrences — ALL the preposition/noun taḥt. Taḥtihā (under them) overwhelmingly in the Paradise refrain: tajrī min taḥtihā al-anhār (rivers flow beneath them, ~49x). Taḥt (2x) = under — tree under which they pledged (48:18).
meaning.ar: التَّحْت: الأسفل — تجري من تحتها الأنهار — تحت الشجرة — تحت

meaning.en: To be good, pure, pleasant. 50 occurrences. Ṭayyib (16x) = good/pure — eat of the good things (2:168). Ṭayyibāt (21x) = good things (provisions). Ṭayyibat (9x) = good/pure/blessed. Ṭāba (I, 3x) = to be good/be pleased — enter in peace (39:73 — fa-ṭibtum). Ṭūbā (1x) = blessedness (13:29).
meaning.ar: الطيب: ضد الخبيث — كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم — وطاب — طوبى لهم — طيبات

meaning.en: To be corrupt, spoil; corruption. Opposite of ṣalāḥ (righteousness). 50 occurrences. Afsada (IV, 15x) = to cause corruption — those who spread corruption in the land (mufsidūn fī al-arḍ). Fasād (11x) = corruption — corruption has appeared on land and sea (30:41). Mufsid (IV act. part., 21x) = corrupter. Fasada (I, 3x) = to be corrupted — the heavens and earth would be corrupted (21:22).
meaning.ar: الفساد: ضد الصلاح — ولا تفسدوا في الأرض — ظهر الفساد في البر والبحر — والمفسدين

meaning.en: To benefit, profit, avail. 50 occurrences. Nafaʿa (I, 31x) = to benefit/profit — presumably benefit you (2:164). Manāfiʿ (8x) = benefits. Nafʿ (11x) = benefit. Key: day when no wealth or children will benefit (yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun wa-lā banūn, 26:88).
meaning.ar: النفع: ضد الضر — يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون — ومنافع — نفعا — ينفع

meaning.en: To reason, understand; to restrain. Ibn Faris: confinement/restraint — al-aql = al-habis (what restrains from blameworthy speech/action). 49 occurrences — ALL verbs (no noun aql in Quran). Taʿqilūna (27x) = you reason — afalā taʿqilūn (will you not reason?) — central Quranic refrain (~14x). Yaʿqilūna (19x) = they reason. Reasoning is an ACT, not a static possession. The root is exclusively verbal in Quran.
meaning.ar: العقل: الحبس والمنع — أفلا تعقلون — لقوم يعقلون — وما يعقلها إلا العالمون

meaning.en: To hasten, be quick; calf. 47 occurrences. Istaʿjala (X, 19x) = to seek to hasten — they seek to hasten punishment (yastaʿjilūna). ʿIjl (10x) = calf — the golden calf (al-ʿijl). ʿAjila (I, 5x) = to hasten. ʿAj jala (II, 5x) = to hasten something (divine). ʿĀjilat (3x) = the immediate life (al-ʿājilah = this world). ʿAjūl (1x) = hasty — man is ever hasty (17:11). Taʿajjala (V, 1x) = to hurry. Aʿjala (IV, 1x) = to make hasten.
meaning.ar: العجلة: السرعة — ويستعجلونك بالعذاب — وعجلت إليك رب لترضى — خلق الإنسان من عجل

meaning.en: To covenant, entrust; covenant, treaty. Ibn Faris: safeguarding and protection. 46 occurrences. Ahd (29x) = covenant/pact. Ahida (I, 6x) = to covenant (20:115). Ahada (III, 11x) = to mutually covenant. Fulfill Allah covenant (16:91). Mithaq is from root w-th-q.
meaning.ar: العهد: الحفظ والوصية — وأوفوا بعهد الله — عاهد — عهد

meaning.en: To guard, protect, preserve. 44 occurrences. Hafizun (13x) = guardians (of Reminder, 15:9). Hafiz (12x) = Guardian (Divine Name). Hafiza (I, 7x) = to guard. Yuhafizu (III, 4x) = to maintain prayers. Mahfuz (2x) = guarded (Lawh Mahfuz, 85:22). Ustuhfiza (X, 1x) = entrusted (Torah). Hifz (3x) = protection.
meaning.ar: الحفظ: الصيانة — إنا له لحافظون — والله حفيظ — في لوح محفوظ

meaning.en: Behind, back; to dispose, ponder. 44 occurrences. Dubur/adbar (18x) = back/behind. Yudabbiru (II, 4x) = to arrange affairs. Yatadabbara (V, 4x) = to ponder (Quran, 4:82). Adbara (IV, 4x) = to turn away/flee. Dabir (4x) = cut off their root. Mudbirin (8x) = fleeing.
meaning.ar: الدبر: الخلف — يولون الدبر — أفلا يتدبرون القرآن — يدبر الأمر

meaning.en: Secret; to conceal; joy; thrones. 44 occurrences. Asarra (IV, 18x) = to conceal/confide. Sirr (11x) = secret (He knows the secret and what is hidden). Surur (6x) = thrones/couches (Paradise). Surur (1x) = happiness. Sarra (2x) = ease/prosperity. Masrur (2x) = happy.
meaning.ar: السر: الإخفاء — يعلم السر وأخفى — أسر — سرر — مسرورين

meaning.en: To adorn, beautify. 46 occurrences. Zayyana (II, 26x) = to make fair-seeming (Satan adorned their deeds). Zinah (19x) = adornment (do not display your adornment, 33:33). Izzayyanat (V, 1x) = beautified itself (earth, 10:24).
meaning.ar: الزينة: التحسين — زين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم — ولا يبدين زينتهن

meaning.en: Morning; to become. 45 occurrences. Asbaha (IV, 28x) = to become/to be in morning (they became regretful). Misbah (4x) = lamp (sun). Subh (5x) = morning/dawn. Musbihin (5x) = early morning. Sabah (1x) = morning.
meaning.ar: الصبح: أول النهار — فأصبحوا خاسرين — وجعل الشمس سراجا

meaning.en: Path, way. 45 occurrences — ALL noun sirat. Al-sirat al-mustaqim (the straight path, ~35x). Possibly from Latin strata > Greek > Aramaic istrata > Arabic. No verb forms.
meaning.ar: الصراط: الطريق — اهدنا الصراط المستقيم

meaning.en: To leave, forsake. 45 occurrences — ALL Form I imperfect yadharu. Leave them to eat and enjoy (15:3). Leave Me and the deniers (73:11). Leave them in confusion (23:54). Imperfect only — no past tense in Quran.
meaning.ar: الوذر: الترك — ذرهم يأكلوا ويتمتعوا — وذرني والمكذبين

meaning.en: To gather, assemble, resurrect. Ibn Faris: gathering + expulsion. 43 occurrences. Hashara (I, 37x) = to gather/resurrect (~90% eschatological). Hashr (2x) = gathering (50:44). Hashirin (3x) = gatherers. Mahshurat (1x) = assembled.
meaning.ar: الحشر: الجمع والطرد — ويوم نحشرهم جميعا — يوم الحشر

meaning.en: To separate, explain, decide. 43 occurrences. Faṣṣala (II, 17x) = to explain in detail. Faṣl (9x) = judgment (yawm al-faṣl). Tafṣīl (5x) = detailed explanation. Faṣala (I, 5x) = to depart/judge. Fiṣāl (3x) = weaning.
meaning.ar: الفصل: القطع والتمييز — قد فصلنا الآيات — إن هذا لهو الفصل

meaning.en: To plot, scheme, plan strategem. Ibn Faris: twisting and deceit. 43 occurrences. Makara (I, 22x) = to plot — they plotted and Allah planned (3:54). Makr (19x) = plot/scheming — do they feel secure from Allah plot (7:99). Makirin (2x) = schemers — Allah is best of schemers (khayr al-makirin, 3:54). Original etymology: commerce/planning (Akkadian makarum). Human makr = blameworthy deception; Divine makr = perfect, just counter-strategy.
meaning.ar: المكر: الالتواء والخداع — ومكروا ومكر الله والله خير الماكرين — أفأمنوا مكر الله

meaning.en: To leave, abandon, forsake. 43 occurrences. Taraka (I, 40x) = to leave/forsake. Tarik (act. part., 3x) = one who leaves. Key: did We leave them (a taraknahum, 37:25). Do not leave on earth any disbeliever (71:26 — la tadhari).
meaning.ar: الترك: التخلية — لقد تركنا فيها آية — ولاتذر على الأرض من الكافرين

meaning.en: To grieve, be sad. 42 occurrences. Yahzun (I, 37x) = to grieve — do not grieve over them (la tahzan alayhim). Huzn (2x) = grief/sorrow. Hazan (3x) = grief. No Form IV ahzana in Quran — verb is solely Form I.
meaning.ar: الحزن: الغم — لا تحزن إن الله معنا — حزنا — يحزنك

meaning.en: Sea, ocean. 42 occurrences — ALL nouns. Bahr (41x) = sea — singular, dual bahrayn, plural bihar (seas boil, 81:6, 82:3). Bahirah (1x) = slit-eared she-camel (pagan practice, 5:103). Key: the two seas (bahrayn) between which is a barrier (55:19-20, 25:53).
meaning.ar: البحر: الماء الكثير — مرج البحرين يلتقيان — وإذا البحار سجرت — بحيرة

meaning.en: To be strong; power, strength. 42 occurrences. Quwwah (30x) = power/strength — take what We gave you with strength (2:63). Qawiyy (11x) = Strong (Al-Qawiyy, Divine Name, paired with Aziz). Muqwin (IV act. part., 1x) = wayfarers in desert (56:73). NO verb forms in Quran — root is nominal/adjectival only.
meaning.ar: القوة: ضد الضعف — خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة — وهو القوي العزيز

meaning.en: To mock, ridicule; to subjugate, subject. Ibn Faris: TWO OPPOSITES in one root — mockery AND subjugation. 42 occurrences. Sakhira (I, 11x) = to mock — do not mock one another (49:11). Sakhkhara (II, 22x) = to subject/subjugate — He subjected for you the sun and moon. Musakhkharat (3x) = subjected/servient. Sikhriyy (2x) = mockery. Al-Raghib: the unifying core is humiliation and compulsion — mocking subjugates socially; taskhir subjugates physically.
meaning.ar: السخر: الهزء والتذليل — لا يسخر قوم من قوم — وسخر لكم الشمس والقمر — سخريا

meaning.en: To turn away, hinder, avert, block. 42 occurrences in 5 forms. Sadda (I, 37x) = to turn away/hinder — they were turned away from the path. Sadid (1x) = purulent fluid (14:16). Sadd (2x) = hindering — hindering from Allah path (2:217). Sudud (1x) = aversion (4:61). Suddu (II pass., 1x) = they are hindered (13:33).
meaning.ar: الصد: المنع — وصدوا عن سبيل الله — صديد — صد — صدود

meaning.en: Above, over, superior; to recover. 43 occurrences. Fawq (41x) = above/over/superior — Allah is above them overpowering (fawqahum qahirun). Afaqa (IV, 1x) = to recover consciousness (Moses, 7:143). Fawaq (1x) = delay/respite (38:15). Mostly the location adverb fawq in various constructions.
meaning.ar: الفوق: العلو — والله غالب على أمره — فوق — أفاق — فواق

meaning.en: To carve, traverse; to answer, respond. 43 occurrences. Istajaba (X, 28x) = to answer/respond — the dominant form. Ujiba (IV, 8x) = to answer (passive). Jawab (4x) = answer. Mujib (IV act. part., 2x) = All-Responsive (Divine attribute, 11:61). Jabu (I, 1x) = carved out (rocks, 89:9 — Thamud carved mountains).
meaning.ar: الجوب: القطع والخرق والإجابة — استجاب — أجيب — جواب — وجابوا الصخر بالواد

meaning.en: To taste, experience. 63 occurrences. Dhaqa (I, 36x) = to taste/experience — so taste the punishment (fadhuqu al-adhab). Adhaqa (IV, 22x) = to make taste — We make them taste punishment/mercy. Dhaiqah (fem. act. part., 3x) = tasting — every soul will taste death (kullu nafsin dhaiqat al-mawt, 3:185, 21:35, 29:57). Dhaiqun (masc. act. part., 2x) = certainly tasters (37:31,38).
meaning.ar: الذوق: الإحساس بالطعم — كل نفس ذائقة الموت — فذوقوا العذاب — أذاقهم

meaning.en: To eat, taste; food. 48 occurrences. Ta'am (24x) = food. At'ama (IV, 13x) = to feed (Who fed them against hunger, 106:4). Ta'ima (I, 5x) = to eat. Istataama (X, 1x) = to ask for food. It'aam (3x) = feeding.
meaning.ar: الطعم: الأكل والذوق — فلينظر الإنسان إلى طعامه — وأطعمهم من جوع

meaning.en: To fear with awe, reverence, and knowledge. Ibn Faris: fear mixed with knowledge and reverence. 48 occurrences. Khashiya (I, 40x) = to fear with awe — Only those fear Allah who have knowledge (al-ulama, 35:28). Khashyah (8x) = reverent fear. Key: khashyah = fear born of knowledge and recognition of majesty.
meaning.ar: الخشية: الخوف مع العلم والتعظيم — إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء

meaning.en: The Hour (Judgment Day); a period, a while. 49 occurrences. Sa'ah (48x) = the Hour — overwhelmingly al-sa'ah (the Hour of Judgment). Sa'atan = for a while. Suwa (1x) = pre-Islamic idol (71:23). Key: they ask you about the Hour (7:187).
meaning.ar: الساعة: الوقت — يسألونك عن الساعة — وسواع

meaning.en: Sin, crime. 48 occurrences. Ithm (35x) = sin — dominant noun. Athim (7x) = sinful. Atham (1x) = penalty of sin. Athim (3x) = sinner. Tathim (2x) = recrimination.
meaning.ar: الإثم: الذنب — ولا تعاونوا على الإثم — أثيما

meaning.en: To curse, condemn. 41 occurrences. La'ana (I, 23x) = to curse — Allah curse upon the liars. La'nah (14x) = curse/imprecation. Mal'unin/mal'unat (2x) = accursed.
meaning.ar: اللعنة: الطرد والإبعاد — لعنة الله على الظالمين — ملعونين

meaning.en: To go around, circumambulate; group; flood. 41 occurrences. Ta'ifah (24x) = group/party. Tafa (I, 8x) = to go around/circuit (Ancient House, 22:29). Ta'if (4x) = visitation from Satan (7:201). Tufan (2x) = flood (Noah).
meaning.ar: الطواف: الدوران — وليطوفوا بالبيت العتيق — طائفة — طائف — طوفان

meaning.en: To succeed, prosper. Ibn Faris: splitting/cleaving AND triumph/success. 40 occurrences. Aflaha (IV, 27x) = to succeed — qad aflaha man tazakka (87:14). Muflihun (act. part., 13x) = the successful — ulai'ka hum al-muflihun (~12x refrain). Semantic link: fallah (farmer) splits earth → prosperity.
meaning.ar: الفلح: الشق والفوز — قد أفلح من تزكى — أولئك هم المفلحون

meaning.en: To perceive, be aware; poetry, poet; hair; rites. Dual core: hair AND awareness/knowledge. 40 occurrences. Yash'uru (I, 25x) = to perceive — but they do not perceive (refrain). Sha'ir (5x) = poet. Sha'a'ir (4x) = rites/symbols of God. Shi'r (2x) = poetry. Al-Shi'raa = Sirius. Mash'ar = Sacred Monument (2:198).
meaning.ar: الشعر: العلم والشعر — ولكن لا يشعرون — شاعر — شعائر الله — المشعر الحرام

meaning.en: To fill; chiefs, notables, assembly. 40 occurrences. Mala' (30x) = chiefs/notables (of Pharaoh people). Mala'a (I, 6x) = to fill Hell. Imtala'a (VIII, 1x) = to be filled. Mali'un (2x) = filling bellies.
meaning.ar: الملأ: أشراف القوم — وقال الملأ من قوم فرعون — لأملأن جهنم

meaning.en: To drink. 39 occurrences. Shariba (I, 15x) = to drink. Sharab (11x) = drink/beverage. Sharibun (5x) = drinkers. Mashrab (3x) = drinking place/spring. Shirb (3x) = share of drink.
meaning.ar: الشرب: تناول الماء — ويسقى من ماء صديد — شراب — مشرب

meaning.en: Sin, guilt; tail. 39 occurrences. Dhanb (35x) = sin/guilt — forgive us our sins. Dhanaba (I, 2x) = to sin. Mudhnib (2x) = sinner. Original: tail/appendage (what follows).
meaning.ar: الذنب: الإثم وذنب الدابة — فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا — مذنبين

meaning.en: To transgress, exceed bounds, overflow. 39 occurrences. Tagha (I, 18x) = to transgress/overflow — the water overflowed (Noah flood, 69:11). Taghut (8x) = idol/false deity/rebel. Tughyan (6x) = transgression/tyranny.
meaning.ar: الطغيان: مجاوزة الحد — فطغوا في البلاد — والطاغوت — طاغين

meaning.en: Authority, power; to impose. 39 occurrences. Sultan (37x) = authority/power/warrant — bring me clear authority. Sallata (II, 2x) = to give power over/impose.
meaning.ar: السلطان: القدرة والحجة — فاتوني بسلطان مبين — سلط عليهم

meaning.en: To open, grant victory, judge. Ibn Faris: opening (opposite of closing). 38 occurrences. Fataha (I, 16x) = to open/grant victory/judge. Fath (12x) = opening/victory (Surat al-Fath). Mafatih (3x) = keys/treasures. Al-Fattah (1x) = the Judge/Opener (Divine Name, 34:26).
meaning.ar: الفتح: نقيض الإغلاق — إنا فتحنا لك فتحا مبينا — وهو الفتاح العليم

meaning.en: To test, try, examine; to become worn out. 38 occurrences. Bala (I, 18x) = to test — that He may test you. Ibtala (VIII, 9x) = to test/try. Balwa (5x) = trial. Bala (6x) = to become worn out/old. Two cores: testing AND wearing out (both from prolonged exposure).
meaning.ar: البلاء: الاختبار — ليبلوكم فيما آتاكم — ابتلاء — بلي

meaning.en: To inherit, be heir. 35 occurrences. Waritha (I, 20x) = to inherit — We made the oppressed inherit the land (28:5). Mirath (3x) = inheritance. Warith (7x) = inheritor — We are the Inheritors (15:23).
meaning.ar: الوراثة: انتقال الملك — وأورثنا القوم — الميراث — وإنا لنحن نرث

meaning.en: To plot, scheme, devise. 35 occurrences. Kayd (28x) = plot/scheme — their plotting is in vain. Kada (I, 7x) = to plot. Makid (1x) = plotted against. Contrast: makr is strategic scheming, kayd is cunning/deceit.
meaning.ar: الكيد: المكر والحيلة — إن كيدهن عظيم — ويكيدون كيدا

meaning.en: To pardon, forgive, efface; to increase/abound. Ibn Faris: two cores — effacement/obliteration AND increase/abundance. 35 occurrences. Afa (I, 27x) = to pardon. Al-Afuww (intensive, 5x) = the Oft-Pardoning (Divine Name paired with Ghafur). Afw (2x) = forgiveness/surplus. Afin (1x) = those who pardon. Note (7:95): afaw = they became abundant — the other semantic branch.
meaning.ar: العفو: المحو والكثرة — والعافين عن الناس — وكان الله عفوًا غفورًا

meaning.en: To cut, sever, divide. 36 occurrences. Qata a (I, 17x) = to cut/sever — cut off their hands (5:38). Taqatta a (V, 5x) = to be cut off/severed. Qit ah (3x) = portion/group. Maqtu (2x) = cut off.
meaning.ar: القطع: الحسم والفصل — اقطعوا أيديهما — تقطع — قطعة — مقطوع

meaning.en: Falsehood, vanity, to be null. 36 occurrences. Batil (26x) = false/void — they consume wealth in falsehood. Abtala (IV, 5x) = to make void/nullify. Yabtul (I, 5x) = to become void. Opposite: haqq (truth). Truth has come and falsehood vanished (17:81).
meaning.ar: البطلان: الفساد والزوال — جاء الحق وزهق الباطل — وأبطل

meaning.en: To precede, outrun; to have preceded, escaped. 37 occurrences. Sabaqa (I, 19x) = to precede/outrun — they cannot outrun Him (sabaqa). Sabaqa (past, 12x) = what has preceded — what has passed of sin (2:275, 4:23). Sabiq (5x) = foremost/precedent — the foremost ones (al-sabiqun, 56:10). Asbaqa (IV, 1x) = to make precede (41:25).
meaning.ar: السبق: التقدم — والسابقون السابقون — فاستبقوا الخيرات — ما سبق

meaning.en: To desire, love passionately; to fall, descend. 38 occurrences. Ahwa (IV, 12x) = to desire/lust — do not follow desire (3:14). Hawa (I, 10x) = to fall/descend — he who falls headlong (22:31). Hawa (noun, 16x) = desire/passion — do not follow vain desire. Hawiyah (1x) = she will be thrown (Hell, 101:9).
meaning.ar: الهوى: المحبة والميل — ولا تتبع الهوى — هوى — فاتهوى به الريح — هاوية

meaning.en: To settle, dwell, be still; to admit, confess. 38 occurrences. Qarrara (II, 10x) = to settle/establish. Istaqarra (X, 12x) = to be settled/fixed — the sun runs to a resting place (36:38). Qarar (nom., 10x) = resting place/dwelling. Qarra (I, 1x) = to cool/refresh. Muqirrin (IV act. part., 5x) = confessing/admitting — we confess our sins (40:11, 67:9, 71:5).
meaning.ar: القرار: الاستقرار والاعتراف — لمستقر لها — واعترف — مقرين — قرار

meaning.en: To deny, reject; unknown, strange; evil. 37 occurrences. Ankār (IV, 16x) = to deny/reject — they denied Our signs. Munkar (17x) = evil/unknown — command good and forbid evil (amr bi-l-maruf wa nahy an al-munkar). Nukr (4x) = great evil (thing unheard of). Nakīr (1x) = how terrible was My rejection (35:26, 67:18).
meaning.ar: النكر: الإنكار — وأنكر — منكر — نكر — ونكير

meaning.en: To scatter; atom, small particle. 38 occurrences. Dharrah (noun, 6x) = atom/speck — an atom weight of good/evil (99:7-8, 10:61, 34:3, 34:22, 4:40). Dhurriyyah (32x) = offspring/progeny — their offspring (2:124, 4:9, 7:172). Etymology: offspring as scattered seed across generations.
meaning.ar: الذر: النشر والتفريق — مثقال ذرة — ذرية — ذرياتنا

meaning.en: Doubt, suspicion, uncertainty. 36 occurrences. Rayb (29x) = doubt — this is the Book, no doubt in it (la rayba fihi, 2:2). Irtāba (VIII, 7x) = to doubt/be suspicious. Murtāb (VIII act. part., 1x) = one in doubt.
meaning.ar: الريب: الشك — ذلك الكتاب لا ريب فيه — ارتب — مريب

meaning.en: To be heedless, neglectful, unaware. 35 occurrences. Ghafala (I, 12x) = to be heedless — they are heedless of the Hereafter. Ghāfil (12x) = heedless one — Allah is not heedless of what they do. Aghfala (IV, 1x) = to neglect. Ghafalah/ghufl (10x) = heedlessness.
meaning.ar: الغفلة: السهو — وما الله بغافل — غفلوا — غفلة — غافلين

meaning.en: To be pure, clean; to purify. 31 occurrences. Ṭahhara (II, 17x) = to purify — purify My House (2:125). Ṭahūr (2x) = pure/purifying — water purifying (25:48). Ṭāhira (2x) = pure. Maṭharah (2x) = means of purification. Ṭahurat (I, 8x) = to be pure.
meaning.ar: الطهارة: النقاء — وطهر بيتي — طهورا — مطهرة — يطهرن

meaning.en: Sun. 33 occurrences. Shams (33x) = the sun — presented as a sign of Allah power. The sun runs to its resting place (36:38). Swears by the sun and its brightness (91:1). All occurrences are the noun shams.
meaning.ar: الشمس: الكوكب المعروف — والشمس تجري لمستقر لها — والشمس وضحاها

meaning.en: To be blind; blindness (spiritual). 33 occurrences. Aʿmā (adj, 9x) = blind — the blind and the seeing are not equal. ʿAmiya (I, 13x) = to be blind — it is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts (22:46). ʿAman (nom., 6x) = blindness. ʿAmū (3x) = they wander blindly. ʿUmī (2x) = blind (pl.) — they are deaf, dumb, and blind (2:18).
meaning.ar: العمى: ذهاب البصر — فإنها لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب — عمي — عميان — أعمى

meaning.en: Throne (of God); arbor, trellis. 33 occurrences. Arsh (26x) = Throne (of Allah) — His Throne was on the water (11:7), Lord of the Mighty Throne (9:129, 23:86, 27:26). Urush (3x) = trellises/arbors. Yu'rishuna (I, 1x) = they erect trellises (24:15). Ma'rūshāt (1x) = those raised on trellises (6:141). Ibn Faris: core = raising, elevating, constructing. Cognate: Hebrew arash (to prepare).
meaning.ar: العرش: السرير والبناء — وكان عرشه على الماء — رب العرش العظيم — وعرش

meaning.en: To kneel; blessing, pool. 32 occurrences. Baraka (I, 3x) = to kneel — camels kneeling (19:71, 77:48, 7:78). Baraka (noun, 10x) = blessing — full of blessing (mubarakan). Barakat (2x) = blessings. Barakat (16x) = pools/water source. Ibn Faris: core = firmness and establishment — a camel kneels to become firm; a blessing is something firm and lasting.
meaning.ar: البركة: الثبات والنماء — وباركنا — بركات — مباركة — برك

meaning.en: To extend, stretch, supply; aid. 32 occurrences. Madda (I, 20x) = to extend/stretch — We have spread out the earth (15:19). Imdād (IV verbal noun, 4x) = supply/aid — We supplied them with fruit (2:61). Mumaddad (2x) = extended — in extended shade (56:30). Madad (nom., 4x) = supply/reinforcement.
meaning.ar: المد: الامتداد — والأرض مددناها — وأمددناكم — ممدود — مدد

meaning.en: To intercede; to pair, to be even. 31 occurrences. Shafa'ah (23x) = intercession — no intercession will be accepted (2:48). Yashfa'u (I, 7x) = to intercede — who will intercede with Him except by His permission (2:255). Shaf' (1x) = even number — by the even and the odd (89:3). Yastashfi'u (X, 1x) = to seek intercession. Ibn Faris: core = adding/pairing — intercession is adding your plea to someone else's case.
meaning.ar: الشفاعة: ضم الشيء إلى مثله — ولا تنفعها شفاعة — يشفع — والشفع والوتر

meaning.en: To hide, conceal; to become apparent. 34 occurrences. Akhfa (IV, 11x) = to hide/conceal — He knows what they conceal (tukhfi). Khafiya (I, 10x) = to be hidden — nothing is hidden from your Lord (10:61). Khifayah (1x) = secrecy. Makhfiyy (12x) = something concealed. Note: this root is a contranym — both to hide AND to make apparent (yukhfi = he hides; yakhfa = it becomes hidden).
meaning.ar: الخفاء: الاستتار — يعلم السر وأخفى — أخفى — خفية — لا يخفى على الله

meaning.en: To trust, be confident; to make firm, bind; covenant. 34 occurrences. Mithaq (25x) = covenant/solemn pledge — We took a covenant from the Children of Israel. Wathaqa (I, 2x) = they bound. Wuthuq (3x) = bonds/chains. Mawthiq (3x) = bond/promise. Tathiq (II, 1x) = to bind firmly. Ibn Faris: core = strength and firmness — a covenant binds parties firmly.
meaning.ar: الوثاق: الشد والقوة — ميثاق — وثق — وثاق — موثق

meaning.en: To be shy, modest; shame. 31 occurrences. Istahyā (X, 29x) = to feel shame/modesty — Allah is not shy to set forth an example (2:26). Hayā (nom., 1x) = modesty. Mustahyi (X act. part., 1x) = one feeling shy. Hadith: al-hayā min al-iman (modesty is part of faith). Distinct from hyy (ح ي ي = to live, 184x, ID 240).
meaning.ar: الحياة: ضد الموت — الحياء: ضد الوقاحة — لا يستحي — استحياء — الحياء من الإيمان

meaning.en: To incline, lean toward; wing; nightfall. 34 occurrences. Janaḥa (I, 2x) = to incline toward peace (8:61). Janāḥ (23x) = wing (of bird, metaphorically of humility). Janāḥ al-layl (1x) = wings of night (17:78). Jāniḥ (1x) = one inclining. Mujtaniḥ (VIII, 1x) = one shunning.
meaning.ar: الجناح: الميل — وإن جنحوا للسلم فاجنح لها — واخفض لهما جناح الذل

meaning.en: To suffice, be enough; to protect. 33 occurrences. Kafa (I, 35x total in root, all Quranic count 33) = to suffice — Allah suffices as a witness. Hasbunā Allah wa-ni'ma al-wakil — Allah is sufficient for us (3:173). Yakfi (imperfect) — and sufficient is Allah as Reckoner (4:6). Kifayah (nom.) = sufficiency.
meaning.ar: الكفاية: الغنى — وكفى بالله شهيدا — وحسبنا الله — يكفيك — كفى

meaning.en: To remain, continue, persist (all day); shade. 33 occurrences. Zalla (I, 23x) = to remain/persist/keep doing — they remained in it (48:12). Zill (7x) = shade — in extended shade (56:30). Zilāl (3x) = shades. Zulal (1x) = easy pure drink (76:14). Zallat (1x) = shading. Zamīl (1x) = deeply shaded. Note: the kāna construction equivalent — Zalla = to keep doing something for a prolonged period.
meaning.ar: الظل: البقاء والاستمرار — ظل وجهه مسودا — ظلوا فيه — ظل — ظلال

meaning.en: To avoid; side, beside; to go astray. 33 occurrences. Ijtanaba (VIII, 21x) = to avoid/shun — avoid the abominations (al-kabair). Janb (10x) = side — stand in prayer on one side. Janāb (1x) = at a distance. Jānib (1x) = one who strays.
meaning.ar: الجنب: البعد والجانب — فاجتنبوا الرجس — فعلى جنب — جنيب

meaning.en: Perhaps, maybe; to hope. 32 occurrences — ALL the auxiliary verb asa/yasi. Asa (perfect) = perhaps — perhaps Allah will bring victory (5:52). Yasi = perhaps. Used with subjunctive (an): asa an yakuna (perhaps it may be).
meaning.ar: العسى: الترجي — فعسى الله أن يأتي بالفتح — عسى — يسي

meaning.en: To enjoin, bequeath, instruct. 32 occurrences. Wassa (II, 25x) = to enjoin/bequeath — He has enjoined upon you the religion. Wasiyyah (2x) = testament/will — prescribed when death approaches (2:180). Tauwaṣṣā (VI, 4x) = to enjoin one another — to truth and patience (103:3). DISTINCT from wSl (و ص ل = to connect, ID 134).
meaning.ar: الوصية: الأمر — ووصى بها إبراهيم بنيه — وتواصوا بالحق — وصية

meaning.en: To kindle, ignite (fire); to dissemble. 32 occurrences. Awrā (IV, 5x) = to kindle fire. Tawārā (VI, 4x) = to hide/conceal. Warā (23x) = behind/after/beyond — beyond them is a barrier (18:93), behind them are their deeds.
meaning.ar: الوراء: الخلف — وكان وراءهم ملك — يوارون — أورى — وراء

meaning.en: Family, household; people of. 37 occurrences. Al (37x) = family/people of — Al Firawn (the people of Pharaoh), Al Ibrahim (the family of Abraham), Al Yaqub, Al Imran. SUB-ENTRY of root Awl (ID 85, 170x). This is the specific form al (= family of, not the definite article).
meaning.ar: الآل: أهل البيت — آل فرعون — آل إبراهيم — آل عمران

meaning.en: To come, arrive; its time has come. 36 occurrences. Ana (I, 18x) = to come/approach — has not the time come (a lam ya ni, 57:16). Ana (perf., 4x) = its time has come — when their term comes (7:34). Ina (nom., 2x) = time. Anah (1x) = extreme heat (boiling water).
meaning.ar: الأنى: الحين والوقت — ألم يأن للذين آمنوا — أنى — إنا — آن

meaning.en: To take shelter, seek refuge; to give refuge. 36 occurrences. Awa (I, 20x) = to seek shelter/give refuge — Did He not find you an orphan and give shelter (93:6). Iwa (IV, 8x) = to take shelter. Ma'wa (8x) = dwelling/refuge/shelter — the Fire is their refuge (3:151).
meaning.ar: الأوى: الرجوع والانضمام — ألم يجدك يتيما فآوى — مأوى — وأوى

meaning.en: To happen, occur; new; to narrate. 36 occurrences. Hadath (6x) = an occurrence/event (in ablution, 4:43, 5:6). Huduth (1x) = something new. Aḥādīth (16x) = narrations/stories/hadith. Hadith (13x) = narration — let them produce a narration like this Quran (52:34). Note: this is ح د ث (Hdv), NOT ه د ي (hdy = guidance, ID 18).
meaning.ar: الحدوث: التجدد — حديث — أحاديث — حدث

meaning.en: To pass, go by; bitterness. 35 occurrences. Marra (I, 10x) = to pass — they passed by it (37:137). Marrah (19x) = once, time — once (marrah) or twice (4x). Mustamirr (X, 2x) = continuous — a continuous punishment (54:2). Amarr (1x) = more bitter (54:46). Mirrah (1x) = strength (Gabriel, 53:6).
meaning.ar: المر: المرور والمرارة — مرت به — مرة — مستمر — ذو مرة

meaning.en: To mock, ridicule, scoff. 34 occurrences. Istahza'a (X, 27x) = to mock/ridicule — the dominant form: they mock them (yastahzi'una). Hazi'a (I, 2x) = to mock. Huzu'an (nom., 1x) = mockery. Huzuwat (3x) = (for) mockery. Mustahzi'ūn (X act. part., 1x) = mockers.
meaning.ar: الهزء: السخرية — يستهزئون — هزوا — مستهزئين — هزء

meaning.en: Three, third. 32 occurrences. Thalath (18x) = three — three days (3:41). Thalith (3x) = third — the third of three — Allah is the third of three (not Trinity, 5:73). Thuluth (2x) = one third. Thulutha (1x) = two thirds (4:11). Thalathin (1x) = thirty. Muthallath (V act. part.) not in Quran.
meaning.ar: الثلاثة: العدد — ثلاثة أيام — ثالث ثلاثة — ثلث — ثلثا — ثلاثين

meaning.en: To become apparent, manifest; desert. 31 occurrences. Bada (I, 17x) = to appear/become clear — what they used to conceal has now appeared (badā lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakunu yahtasibun, 39:47). Badw (nom., 2x) = desert/Bedouin. Abda (IV, 5x) = to reveal/show. Mus'abid (IV act. part., 1x) = one who reveals. Badiyat (1x) = manifest.
meaning.ar: البدو: الظهور — بدا لهم — أبدى — البادية — بدا

meaning.en: To create, originate; to be innocent of, free from. 31 occurrences. Bara'a (I, 12x) = to create/originate — He who created me (26:78). Bara' (7x) = innocent/free from — I am innocent of what you associate with Him. Barā'ah (2x) = freedom/disavowal — Surat al-Tawbah also called Barā'ah. Bari' (4x) = creator (the Maker). Barī' (2x) = free. Ibn Faris: core = creating AND being free of defect/affliction.
meaning.ar: البرء: الخلق والسلامة — وإذ قال إبراهيم لأبيه وقومه إنني براء — باري — براء

meaning.en: To overcome, defeat, prevail. 31 occurrences. Ghalaba (I, 25x) = to overcome/defeat — they will be overcome (sa-yughlabūna). Ghālib (4x) = prevailing/victorious — We will surely be victorious (3:12). Maghlūb (1x) = defeated. Istaghlaba (X, 1x) = to overwhelm.
meaning.ar: الغلب: القهر — سيغلبون — الغالبون — مغلوب — ليستغلبن

meaning.en: To emigrate, abandon. 31 occurrences. Hajara (III, 16x) = to emigrate (the Hijrah). Muhajirun (7x) = the Emigrants. Hajara (I, 5x) = to abandon/forsake. Mahjur (1x) = forsaken thing. DUPLICATE of ID 167 (Hjr, 31x — emigration).
meaning.ar: الهجر: الترك — والمهاجرين — مهجورا

meaning.en: To remain, stay, tarry. 31 occurrences. Labitha (I, 28x) = to remain/stay — they remained in their cave 300 years (18:25). Albatha (IV, 2x) = to cause to delay/hinder. Lubth (1x) = staying longer.
meaning.ar: اللبث: البقاء — فلبث فيهم ألف سنة — ولبثوا — ألبثني

meaning.en: To sit, stay; to be inactive. 31 occurrences. Qa'ada (I, 20x) = to sit/stay behind — those who stay behind. Qā'id (5x) = sitting (act. part.) — those who remember Allah sitting. Qa'ūd (1x) = watching/sitting. Maq'ad (3x) = seat/place — take your seats (Hell). Qu'ūd (2x) = sitting (verbal noun).
meaning.ar: القعود: الجلوس — وقعدوا — قاعدا — مقعد

meaning.en: To be pure, sincere; to escape, be free. 31 occurrences. Akhlaṣa (IV, 12x) = to be sincere/devote — worship Allah with sincere devotion (mukhlisina lahu al-din, 7:29). Khalaṣa (I, 5x) = to be pure/free. Khāliṣ (adj., 7x) = pure — pure milk (16:66). Mukhlaṣ (IV act. part., 4x) = sincere. Khalāṣ (2x) = escape/deliverance. Ibn Faris: core = purity and freedom from mixture.
meaning.ar: الإخلاص: التنقية — وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين — خالصا — أخلص

meaning.en: To lie, fabricate, turn away; lie. 30 occurrences. Iftaka (VIII, 8x) = to fabricate/invent a lie — they invent falsehood (yuftarūna al-kadhiba, 29:68). Iftarā (VIII) from f-r-y is much more common (ID 189, 60x). For this root: Ufika (I pass., 7x) = to be turned away/deluded. Ma'fūk (2x) = one turned away. Aftaka (I, 2x) = liars. Mu'fakāt (9x) = the overturned/lie cities.
meaning.ar: الإفك: الكذب — وإفكهم — أئفكا — والمؤتفكات

meaning.en: To be due, come to term; its appointed time; boiling water. 30 occurrences. Ana (I, 18x) = its term comes. An (nom., 8x) = time/moment. Aniy (nom., 3x) = boiling/hot (water). Anin/Anatin (2x) = when/at time. SUB-ENTRY of root Any (ID 386, 36x).
meaning.ar: الأنى: حين — أنى — آن — آنية — حين

meaning.en: To disobey, rebel. 30 occurrences. Asa (I, 26x) = to disobey — and he disobeyed (Adam, 20:121). Asi (4x) = disobedient/rebellious. Ma'siyah (verbal noun) = sin. Opposite: ata a (to obey).
meaning.ar: العصيان: المخالفة — فعصى آدم ربه — ولا يعصينك — عاص

meaning.en: To cut; to narrate; retribution. 30 occurrences. Qaṣaṣ (nom., 8x) = retribution — in retribution there is life (2:179). Qaṣṣa (I, 7x) = to narrate — We narrate to you the best of stories (12:3). Qaṣaṣ (3x) = stories (Surat al-Qaṣaṣ). Qissa (1x) = the truth. Ibn Faris: core = cutting — a story is cut into parts; retribution cuts the crime.
meaning.ar: القصص: القطع — نحن نقص عليك أحسن القصص — ولكم في القصاص حياة

meaning.en: To turn away, divert, avert. 30 occurrences. Sarafa (I, 14x) = to turn away — He diverts punishment from whom He wills. Ṣarrafa (II, 12x) = to distribute/explain in varied ways — We have explained the signs in diverse ways (ṣarrafna al-ayat). Maṣraf (4x) = place of turning/averting.
meaning.ar: الصرف: التحويل والتنقل — صرفنا الآيات — يصرف — مصرف

meaning.en: To strive, endeavor, exert; to walk rapidly. 30 occurrences. Sa a (I, 24x) = to strive/endeavor — man shall have nothing but what he strives for (53:39). Sa y (3x) = striving. Yasa u (3x) = to walk/spread (mischief in land).
meaning.ar: السعي: السرعة والعمل — وأن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى — وسعى لها سعيها

meaning.en: To travel, journey. 29 occurrences. Sara (I, 12x) = to travel/journey — travel through the land (siru fi al-ard). Sayyara (II, 5x) = to set in motion/move (mountains). Uṣiyra (I pass., 1x) = was made to travel. Sayyāra (1x) = caravan. Sarun (1x) = journeying.
meaning.ar: السير: الانتقال — سيروا في الأرض — وسيرت الجبال — سيارة

meaning.en: To fly; bird; to be optimistic/pessimistic (omen). 29 occurrences. Ṭayr (nom., 19x) = bird. Ṭāra (I, 2x) = to fly. Ṭā'ir (3x) = a bird AND an omen — every person's fate is tied to his neck (17:13). Taṭayyara (V, 2x) = to take bad omens — We augur ill of you (36:18).
meaning.ar: الطير: الحيوان الطائر — طائرا — طيرا — تطيروا — طير

meaning.en: To know, be aware; to extinguish. 29 occurrences. Adrā (IV, 17x) = to make know/inform — what will make you know (ma adraka, rhetorical formula ~13x). Darā (I, 9x) = to know — they do not know. Tadārā (VI, 2x) = to pretend ignorance. Dāri (1x) = extinguisher.
meaning.ar: الدراية: العلم — وما أدراك — لا تدرون — دارين

meaning.en: To triumph, be saved, achieve success. 29 occurrences. Fāza (I, 9x) = to triumph/be saved — whoever is saved from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has triumphed (3:185). Fawz (17x) = supreme triumph/salvation — that is the great triumph (al-fawz al-aẓim, 11x). Mufāz (3x) = place of escape/salvation.
meaning.ar: الفوز: النجاة والظفر — فمن زحزح عن النار وأدخل الجنة فقد فاز — ذلك هو الفوز العظيم

meaning.en: To cover, envelop, overwhelm. 29 occurrences. Ghashiya (I, 14x) = to cover/envelop — the Day when the Punishment covers them (29:55). Taghsha (V, 2x) = to cover oneself. Ghishāwah (3x) = covering/veil — over their eyes is a covering (2:7, 45:23). Ghashtu (I, 1x) = I covered. Istaghshā (X, 3x) = to cover (ears/garments).
meaning.ar: الغشاوة: الغطاء — أغطش — غشيت — غشاوة

meaning.en: To dispute, argue, wrangle. 29 occurrences. Yahdaluna (I, 1x) = they dispute. Jadala (III, 21x) = to dispute/argue — they dispute with you concerning the truth. Jadal (4x) = disputation/argument — man is the most contentious (18:54). Mujādil (2x) = disputant. Jidāl (1x) = argument.
meaning.ar: الجدل: المناظرة والمخاصمة — يجادلونك في الحق — وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا

meaning.en: Army, soldiers, host. 29 occurrences. Jund (13x) = army/soldiers — the hosts of the heavens and earth belong to Allah. Junud (15x) = armies/hosts. No one knows the hosts of your Lord except Him (74:31).
meaning.ar: الجند: العسكر — جنود السموات والأرض

meaning.en: To raise, lift, elevate, exalt. 29 occurrences. Rafa a (I, 14x) = to raise — We raised him to a high position (19:57). Rafi (2x) = Raiser of ranks (40:15). Marfu ah (3x) = raised/elevated. Ibn Faris: opposite of lowering.
meaning.ar: الرفع: ضد الوضع — ورفعناه مكانا عليا — رافع

meaning.en: Two, second, fold; to bend. 29 occurrences. Ithnayn (18x) = two (witnesses, 2:282). Than (5x) = second — the second of two in the cave (9:40). Istithna (X, 2x) = to make an exception — say insha Allah (18:23-24). Mathna (2x) = in pairs/twos.
meaning.ar: الاثنان: العدد — ثاني اثنين — واستثنى — مثنى

meaning.en: To love, desire, wish. 29 occurrences. Wadda (I, 22x) = to love/wish — they wish you would compromise (2:109). Mawaddah (5x) = love/affection — He placed between you love and mercy (30:21). Al-Wadud (1x) = the Loving (Divine Name, 85:14).
meaning.ar: الود: المحبة — ويودون — مودة — وهو الغفور الودود

meaning.en: To be just, to equate; to turn away. 28 occurrences. Adl (13x) = justice — be just, that is nearer to piety (5:8). Adala (I, 8x) = to be just. Adl (2x) = equivalent/ransom. Ibn Faris: equality and justice.
meaning.ar: العدل: المساواة والإنصاف — اعدلوا هو أقرب للتقوى

meaning.en: To surround, encompass, guard. 28 occurrences. Ahata (IV, 20x) = to encompass — Our punishment encompassed them (7:4). Muhit (IV act. part., 4x) = all-encompassing — Allah encompasses all things. Hitat (3x) = surrounding.
meaning.ar: الإحاطة: الإطافة والإدراك — أحاط — محيط

meaning.en: To originate, create, produce; to rise. 28 occurrences. Ansha a (IV, 22x) = to originate/create — He originated you. Nash at (1x) = creation. Inna nashi at al-layl (73:6) = rising at night for worship.
meaning.ar: النشأة: الإبداع — أنشأكم — ناشئة

meaning.en: To hope, expect, anticipate. 28 occurrences. Raja (I, 19x) = to hope/expect — they hope for His mercy. Arja (IV, 4x) = to defer/postpone. Tarajja (V, 2x) = to hope/be expectant.
meaning.ar: الرجاء: الأمل — يرجون رحمته — وأرجئ

meaning.en: Seven, seventy. 28 occurrences. Sab a (20x) = seven — seven heavens (2:29). Sab in (6x) = seventy — seventy men (7:155). Sab ah (1x) = seventh.
meaning.ar: السبعة: العدد — سبع سموات — سبعين

meaning.en: To be heavy, weighty; burden. 28 occurrences. Mithqal (9x) = weight of an atom. Thiqal (8x) = heaviness/burden. Thaqlan (2x) = the two heavy ones (jinn and mankind, 55:31). Thaqulat (I, 4x) = to be heavy (weighing).
meaning.ar: الثقل: خفة الوزن — مثقال ذرة — الثقلان

meaning.en: To return; reward, recompense; garment. 28 occurrences. Thawab (13x) = reward/recompense — so Allah gave them the reward of this world (3:148). Mathubah (4x) = reward. Thawaba (I, 2x) = he returned/relapsed. Tathwib (1x) = returning. Thiyab (7x) = garments. Thawb (1x) = garment. Ibn Faris: core = returning — a reward returns to the worker; a garment returns in its shape.
meaning.ar: الثواب: العود والجزاء — آتاهم الله ثواب الدنيا — ثياب — أثاب

meaning.en: To be empty, alone; to pass by. 28 occurrences. Khalat (I, 6x) = to pass by/gone — generations have passed before you. Akhla (IV, 12x) = to be alone — when you are alone (with a woman). Khalawna (I, 6x) = those who passed before. Khala (4x) = empty place/seclusion.
meaning.ar: الخلاء: الفراغ — قد خلت من قبلكم أمم — خلا — أخل

meaning.en: Certainty, conviction. 28 occurrences. Yaqin (17x) = certainty — until death came to him (hatta atahu al-yaqin, 74:47). Aqina (I, 3x) = to be certain. Mustayqinun/stayqana (X, 7x) = absolutely certain. Muqin (IV act. part., 1x) = those with certainty — in the Hereafter they are certain (2:4).
meaning.ar: اليقين: العلم الذي لا شك فيه — حتى أتانا اليقين — موقنين — استيقن

meaning.en: Ten, tenth. 27 occurrences. Ashr (14x) = ten — ten days (28:27). Ishrun (3x) = twenty. Ashara (5x) = ten. Ma asir (1x) = tithe. Ashir (1x) = tenth. Ushr (2x) = one-tenth.
meaning.ar: العشرة: العدد — عشرة أيام — عشرين — معشار

meaning.en: To wonder, be amazed; stranger. 27 occurrences. Ajiba (I, 13x) = to wonder/be amazed — do you wonder at the decree of Allah (11:73). Ajab (8x) = wonder/amazing thing — an amazing recitation (72:1). A ujiba (IV act. part., 5x) = wonderful/pleasing to him. Ujub (1x) = amazing.
meaning.ar: العجب: الاستغراب — أتعجبين من أمر الله — عجبا — معجب

meaning.en: To deceive, delude, beguile. 27 occurrences. Gharra (I, 22x) = to deceive/delude — let not this world deceive you (fa-la taghurrannakum al-hayat al-dunya, 35:5). Ghurur (4x) = deception — the deceiver (Satan) deluded you (57:14 gharrakum bi-Llahi al-gharur). Gharir (1x) = one who deceives.
meaning.ar: الغرور: الخداع — لا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا — وغركم بالله الغرور

meaning.en: To be easy, light; to be despised, humiliated. 26 occurrences. Ahan (IV, 14x) = to be vile/humiliated — they will be in humiliating punishment (adhabun muhin). Hawwan (II, 2x) = to make easy — for him We ease the way (92:7). Hayyin (4x) = easy/light. Hun (2x) = submission/humility. Mustahan (X, 2x) = despised — a despised fluid (semen, 77:20).
meaning.ar: الهوان: الذل — عذاب مهين — ويسر لليسرى — هين — أهون

meaning.en: Hell, Hellfire (al-Jahim). 26 occurrences. Jahim (25x) = Hellfire — the blazing Fire (al-Jahim). Jahima (I, 1x) = to be affected by Hellfire. One of the 7 names of Hell in the Quran.
meaning.ar: الجحيم: النار الشديدة — وتصلية جحيم — إن جهنم كانت مرصادا

meaning.en: To grow, sprout; plants, vegetation. 26 occurrences. Anbata (IV, 16x) = to cause to grow — We cause to grow thereby (rain) gardens. Nabat (5x) = vegetation/plants. Nabat (I, 5x) = to grow/sprout.
meaning.ar: النبات: ما أخرجته الأرض — فأنبتنا به حدائق — نباتا

meaning.en: To place, put, lay down; to bear a child. 26 occurrences. Wada a (I, 17x) = to place/put down/lay — when the Book is placed (39:69). Wada at (I, 4x) = she bore/delivered (a child, 3:36, 46:15). Awda a (IV, 2x) = to set down/deposit. Waddi (2x) = deposit/trust. Wadi a (1x) = that which is placed.
meaning.ar: الوضع: الإلقاء — وضع الكتاب — وضعتها — وضيعة

meaning.en: To be disgraced, humiliated, put to shame. 26 occurrences. Akhza (IV, 20x) = to disgrace/humiliate — so He may disgrace the disbelievers (9:2). Khizyun (5x) = disgrace/humiliation. Khazaya (1x) = and disgraced. Makhza (1x) = in disgrace.
meaning.ar: الخزي: الذل والهوان — ليخزي الكافرين — خزيا — مخزاة

meaning.en: To hold, grasp, withhold. 27 occurrences. Amsaka (IV, 25x) = to hold/withhold — He withholds the sky from falling (22:65). Imsak (1x) = holding/withholding — holding them in kindness (2:231). Istamsaka (X, 1x) = to hold fast/grasp — grasped the firmest handhold (2:256).
meaning.ar: المسك: الإمساك — يمسك السماء — فاستمسك بالعروة الوثقى

meaning.en: To bestow favor, grant; to cut. 27 occurrences. Mann (I, 16x) = to bestow favor — We bestowed favor upon you (2:47). Yammunnu (3x) = to remind of favors — do not remind of your charity (2:264). Mann (3x) = manna (food from heaven). Mannan (2x) = bestower. Mustamann (X, 1x) = to seek favor.
meaning.ar: المن: الإكرام والقطع — ولقد مننا عليك — لا تبطلوا صدقاتكم بالمن

meaning.en: Moon. 27 occurrences — ALL the noun qamar (moon). The moon as a sign of Allah (10:5, 21:33, 71:16). The moon split (54:1). The moon eclipsed/darkened (75:8). No verb forms in Quran. Uniquely Arabic word for moon.
meaning.ar: القمر: كوكب الليل — والقمر قدرناه منازل — انشق القمر

meaning.en: Tradition, customary practice; biography. 27 occurrences. Sunnah (16x) = way/customary practice — the sunnah of the former peoples (35:43). Sunnat Allah (8x) = the established way of Allah — and you will never find change in the way of Allah (33:62). Masnun (3x) = formed/shaped/molded — black mud molded (15:26).
meaning.ar: السنن: الطريقة — سنة الله في الذين خلوا من قبل — ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا

meaning.en: To repent, turn back. 27 occurrences — SUB-FORM of root twb (ID 53, 87x total). This is Form I taba (to repent) specifically. Tabu (I, 20x) = they repented. Yatubu (I, 4x) = he repents. Tubtu (I, 3x) = I repent. Tabtum (I perf.) = you repented.
meaning.ar: التوبة: الرجوع — تابوا — يتوب — تبت

meaning.en: To be incapable, unable, weak. 26 occurrences. A jaza (I, 11x) = to be incapable. Mu jiz (IV act. part., 4x) = one who frustrates/escapes — they cannot escape (mu jizin, 9:2). Mu jiz (adj., 11x) = incompetent/weak.
meaning.ar: العجز: الضعف — وما أنتم بمعجزين — عاجز

meaning.en: To transform, change; a year; intervening obstacle. 4 occurrences (in root meaning). Ahal (IV, 4x) = to transfer/transplant (2:260). Hal (2:233, 2:240, 65:1) = a year. Tahwil (2:173) = transformation. NOTE: The Buckwalter bwl (ب و ل = urine) is WRONG — the correct root is Hwl (ح و ل = change/transform).
meaning.ar: الحول: التحويل — حولا — لا تحويل
meaning.data_correction: FIXED: Root is ح و ل (Hwl = change/transform), NOT ب و ل (bwl = urine). The Buckwalter transliteration is wrong.

meaning.en: To bear a burden; sin, crime; minister/vizier. 27 occurrences. Wizr (noun, 11x) = burden/sin — no bearer bears the burden of another (6:164). Wazara (I, 11x) = to bear. Wazir (noun, 2x) = minister/helper — appoint for me a minister from my family (20:29). Awzar (pl., 3x) = burdens.
meaning.ar: الوزر: الحمل والثقل — ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى — واجعله لي وزيرا

meaning.en: To be present, attend; to come, approach. 25 occurrences. Ihtadara (VIII, 1x) = they attended. Haddara (II, 1x) = to bring/present. Haddara (I, 5x) = to present/come. Hadar (14x) = one who is present — and they found what they did present (3:30). Mahdar (1x) = a bringing forth. Hadrat (2x) = presence. Hadhir (1x) = prepared.
meaning.ar: الحضور: ضد الغياب — ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا — أحضرت

meaning.en: To define, limit, restrict; iron. 25 occurrences. Hudud (15x) = limits/boundaries — these are the limits of Allah (hudud Allah). Hadid (6x) = iron — We sent down iron (57:25). Had (2x) = edge/border. Hadad (1x) = limit. Muhaddad (1x) = defined/limited.
meaning.ar: الحد: المنع والحاجز — تلك حدود الله — وأنزلنا الحديد — محدود

meaning.en: To burn, be exposed to fire; to roast. 25 occurrences. Salah (I, 12x) = to be exposed to/burn in Fire — he will be exposed to the blaze (sa-yasla nar an dhata lahab, 111:3). Aslah (IV, 7x) = to cause to burn. Tasliyah (II verbal noun, 4x) = burning. Musallah (II pass. part., 1x) = burned. Sal (nom., 1x) = blaze.
meaning.ar: الصلي: الاحتراق — سيصلى نارا ذات لهب — وتصلية جحيم

meaning.en: Belly, interior, hidden; to be pregnant. 25 occurrences. Batn (nom., 18x) = belly/interior — in the bellies of your mothers (16:78). Batana (I, 2x) = to be hidden/concealed. Butun (pl., 4x) = bellies. Batn (1x) = belly. Batina (1x) = what they conceal.
meaning.ar: البطن: ضد الظهر — إذ أنتم أجنة في بطون أمهاتكم — وباطن

meaning.en: To spread, extend, stretch out; to be generous. 25 occurrences. Basata (I, 12x) = to extend/stretch out — stretching forth their hands (5:28). Basiṭ (2x) = extended — extended wing (of bird, 6:93). Bisāṭ (1x) = carpet (71:19). Basṭat (4x) = extensive/power (strength). Basāṭ (1x) = outstretched. Al-Bāsiṭ (Divine Name, the Extender).
meaning.ar: البسط: النشر والمد — باسط يديه — والأرض فرشناها — بسطة

meaning.en: Ship, boat; celestial orbit/sphere. 25 occurrences. Fulk (23x) = ship — the ship running in the sea (2:164). Falak (2x) = orbit — each in an orbit swimming (36:40). Both meanings derive from same root: circular motion. Possibly non-Semitic origin (Sumerian/Akkadian?).
meaning.ar: الفلك: السفينة والدائرة — والفلك تجري في البحر — وكل في فلك يسبحون

meaning.en: Tongue, language. 25 occurrences. Lisan (25x) = tongue/language — We sent every messenger in the tongue of his people (14:4). We have made it easy in your tongue (19:97). Tongues will testify on Judgment Day (24:24). Proto-Semitic *lasan-. Cognate: Hebrew lashon.
meaning.ar: اللسان: عضو الكلام — وما أرسلنا من رسول إلا بلسان قومه — لسان

meaning.en: Justice, fairness; to be unjust. 25 occurrences — CONTRANYM (both meanings opposite). Qisṭ (15x) = justice/equity — We sent messengers with clear proofs and the Balance of Justice (57:25). Muqsiṭ (IV act. part., 3x) = one who acts justly — Allah loves the just. Qasata (I, 4x) = to be unjust/deviate — they will be fuel for Hell (72:15). Aqsaṭ (adj., 3x) = more just.
meaning.ar: القسط: العدل والجور — وأقسطوا إن الله يحب المقسطين — قاسط — أقسط

meaning.en: To give drink, water, irrigate. 25 occurrences. Saqahum (I, 16x) = to give drink — their Lord gave them a pure drink to drink (76:21). Isqā (IV verbal noun, 1x) = irrigation (12:49). Siqāyah (4x) = drinking cup (of Joseph). Saqqa (II, 1x) = he gave drink. Mustasqā (X, 1x) = Moses seeking water.
meaning.ar: السقاية: الإرواء — سقاهم ربهم شرابا طهورا — وسقاهم — سقاية

meaning.en: To admonish, exhort, preach. 25 occurrences. Wa aza (I, 12x) = to admonish — admonish them (4:34, 31:13). Maw izah (9x) = admonition — an admonition has come to you from your Lord (10:57). Itta aza (VIII, 2x) = to heed admonition. Ya iz (2x) = an admonisher.
meaning.ar: الوعظ: التذكير بالخير — فعظوهن — موعظة — يعظكم

meaning.en: To grant, bestow, give freely. 25 occurrences. Wahaba (I, 21x) = to grant/bestow — O Lord, grant us from our spouses... (25:74). Hab (imperative, 4x) = grant! — Grant me a kingdom (38:35). Wahhab (nom., 3x) = Oft-Grantor — the Supreme Giver (3:8). Al-Wahhab = Divine Name (the Bestower).
meaning.ar: الهبة: العطاء — ربنا هب لنا من أزواجنا — إنك أنت الوهاب

meaning.en: To be low, abased, humiliated; to be easy, tractable. 24 occurrences. Adhalla (IV, 13x) = to humiliate/abase — whoever You humiliate (3:26). Dhalil (5x) = low/humble. Dhallala (II, 2x) = to make subservient/tame — He tamed them for you (36:72). Dhull (2x) = humiliation — humiliation of disbelief. Dhalul (2x) = tractable/easy.
meaning.ar: الذل: الهوان — تعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء — ذللناها لهم — ذليل

meaning.en: To harm, annoy, hurt. 24 occurrences. Adha (nom., 21x) = harm/annoyance — they cause you annoyance (2:222). Adhāhum (3x) = their annoyance. Yudhika (1x) = he annoys you.
meaning.ar: الأذى: الضرر — يؤذيان — أذى — آذاه

meaning.en: To live, populate; lifetime, age; to build/construct. 24 occurrences. Umur (7x) = life/lifetime — by your life (O Muhammad, 15:72). Amara (I, 12x) = to build/construct/populate — who built them (masajid, 9:17). Ya mur (2x) = he lived. Ammar (II, 1x) = he let live long. Imran (1x) = construction/building.
meaning.ar: العمر: الحياة والبناء — لعمرك — يعمر — وما يعمر من معمر

meaning.en: To be obscene, indecent, lewd; to exceed bounds. 24 occurrences. Fahishah (17x) = obscenity/indecency — do not approach indecencies (6:151). Afhasha (IV, 2x) = to commit obscenity. Fa hash (2x) = extremely/severely indecent. Mufahishah (1x) = obscenity (f.). Fahisha (2x) = foul thing.
meaning.ar: الفحشاء: القبح والتجاوز — ولا تقربوا الفواحش — فاحشة — فحش

meaning.en: To be angry; wrath, anger. 24 occurrences. Ghaḍiba (I, 12x) = to be angry — Allah became angry with them (4:93). Ghaḍab (7x) = wrath/anger — they earned wrath upon wrath (2:90). Maghḍūb (3x) = those who earned wrath (al-maghḍūbi alayhim, 1:7). Ghaḍbān (1x) = angry (Moses). Taghayyaẓa (V, 1x) = to rage with anger.
meaning.ar: الغضب: السخط — غير المغضوب عليهم — غضبان — غضب

meaning.en: To be ignorant, foolish. 24 occurrences. Jahila (I, 17x) = to be ignorant — they are ignorant people (2:273). Jahl (1x) = ignorance — the ignorance of the Age of Ignorance (jāhiliyyah, 33:33). Jāhil (4x) = ignorant person. Jāhilīn (2x) = ignorant ones. Opposite: ʿilm (knowledge). The root carries both intellectual AND moral ignorance — folly, not just lack of information.
meaning.ar: الجهل: ضد العلم — قوم لا يعلمون — جاهلية — جاهل

meaning.en: To almost do, be about to; to nearly happen. 24 occurrences. Kada (I, 24x) = to almost/was about to — the lightning almost snatches away their sight (2:20). DISTINCT from kyd (ك ي د = plot/scheme, ID 357, 35x). This is root ك و د (k-w-d). Used as auxiliary verb before imperfect (kada yaf alu = he almost did).
meaning.ar: الكود: المقاربة — يكاد البرق يخطف أبصارهم — كاد — تكاد

meaning.en: To be sick, ill; sickness. 24 occurrences — verb/noun sub-forms of marad (ID 224, 24x). Marida (I, 5x) = to be sick. Maria (3x) = sick (pl.). Maria (14x) = disease/illness. Mariid (2x) = ill person.
meaning.ar: المرض: مقابل الصحة — مريض — مرضى — في قلوبهم مرض

meaning.en: To observe, watch, guard; to be on guard. 24 occurrences. Irtiqaba (VIII, 3x) = to wait/watch — wait and see. Raqib (9x) = watcher/guardian — Allah is ever-watchful (raqib) over you (4:1). Taraqqaba (V, 2x) = to wait/look out. Raqabah (3x) = slave/neck — freeing a slave (neck). Muraqabah (1x) = observation. Murtaqib (VIII act. part., 6x) = one who waits.
meaning.ar: الرقب: الانتظار — إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا — رقبة — مرتقبون

meaning.en: Fruit, yield, produce. 24 occurrences. Thamar (12x) = fruit — produce of all kinds brought forth (2:155). Thamarāt (4x) = fruits (pl.). Thamara (I, 2x) = to bear fruit. Thamarat (6x) = fruits of (date palms and vines).
meaning.ar: الثمر: حمل الشجر — فأخرج به من الثمرات رزقا لكم

meaning.en: To fall, occur, happen; to be certain/wajib. 24 occurrences. Waqa a (I, 17x) = to fall/occur — when the Word falls upon them (27:82). Waqi (4x) = falling/descending. Mawqi (1x) = place/time of falling. Wuqu (1x) = occurrence/falling. Tawaqu a (V, 1x) = to expect/wait for falling.
meaning.ar: الوقوع: السقوط — إذا وقع القول عليهم — واقع — موقع

meaning.en: To release, divorce, set free. 23 occurrences. Tallaqa (II, 14x) = to divorce — when you divorce women (2:231). Talaqa (I, 2x) = to release/go forth. Talq (1x) = release/divorce. Intalaqa (VII, 5x) = to go forth/depart — go forth to what you were invited. Muntalaq (VII act. part., 1x) = gone forth.
meaning.ar: الطلاق: التخلية — فطلقوهن — طلقتم — انطلقوا

meaning.en: To wear, clothe; to mix, confuse, obscure. 23 occurrences — CONTRANYM (two opposite meanings). Labisa (I, 11x) = to wear/clothe — wear the garment of righteousness. Labasa (I, 12x) = to mix/confuse — and do not mix truth with falsehood (2:42). Ibn Faris: core = mixing — clothing is mixed with the body.
meaning.ar: اللبس: الخلط واللباس — ولا تلبسوا الحق بالباطل — لباس — لابس

meaning.en: To walk, go. 23 occurrences. Masha (I, 20x) = to walk — do not walk in the land exultantly (17:37). Yashun (2x) = to walk. Mashy (1x) = walk/gait. Mamsh (1x) = place of walking.
meaning.ar: المشي: السير — ولا تمش في الأرض مرحا — يمشون — مشي

meaning.en: To marry, wed; to have sexual relations. 23 occurrences. Nakaḥa (I, 14x) = to marry — and do not marry polytheist women (2:221). Nākiḥa (I, 5x) = one who marries. Istanakaḥa (X, 1x) = to marry a woman. Yankaḥu (3x) = he marries. Nikaḥ (1x) = marriage contract.
meaning.ar: النكاح: الزواج — ولا تنكحوا المشركات — نكاحا

meaning.en: To exceed limits, be extravagant, wasteful. 23 occurrences. Asrafa (IV, 17x) = to exceed limits/be extravagant — and do not be extravagant, He does not love the extravagant (6:141). Israf (2x) = excess/extravagance. Musrif (IV act. part., 4x) = extravagant one — indeed Allah does not guide one who is extravagant.
meaning.ar: الإسراف: مجاوزة الحد — ولا تسرفوا إنه لا يحب المسرفين — أسرفوا

meaning.en: To weigh, measure; weight, balance. 23 occurrences. Wazn (5x) = weight — We will set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection (21:47). Mawzun (5x) = weighed — they will be given to drink a measured cup (76:16). Mithqal (9x, using different root counting) = weight. Wazana (I, 3x) = to weigh. Mizan (4x) = balance/scale.
meaning.ar: الوزن: ثقل الشيء — والوزن يومئذ الحق — ميزان — موزون

meaning.en: Orphan. 23 occurrences. Yatim (20x) = orphan — Did He not find you an orphan and give shelter (93:6). Yatama (3x) = orphans (pl.). No verb forms in Quran. Repeated Quranic command: do not oppress the orphan (93:9).
meaning.ar: اليتم: فقد الأب قبل البلوغ — ألم يجدك يتيما فآوى — يتيما

meaning.en: Thousand; to be familiar, intimate. 22 occurrences. Alf (10x) = thousand — a thousand years (29:14). Uluf (3x) = thousands (pl.). Allafa (II, 5x) = to bring together/unite hearts — He brought together their hearts (8:63). Talif (V, 4x) = one familiar/intimate.
meaning.ar: الألف: العدد والألفة — ألف سنة — وألف بين قلوبهم

meaning.en: Arab, Arabic. 22 occurrences. Arabiyy (11x) = Arabic — an Arabic Quran (Qur an Arabiyy, 12:2). A rab (10x) = Arabs (Bedouins — al-A rab, 9:90). Arab (1x) = Arabic (adj.). The Quran describes itself as an Arabic Quran for a people who understand.
meaning.ar: العرب: الفصاحة — قرآنا عربيا — الأعراب — عربي

meaning.en: To rejoice, be glad, exult. 22 occurrences. Fariḥa (I, 15x) = to rejoice/exult — do not exult, Allah does not love the exultant (28:76). Farḥ (3x) = joy/rejoicing. Fariḥ (2x) = joyful. Tafraḥā (2x) = that you may rejoice. The negative sense (exulting in wealth) dominates in Quran; positive sense in charity/Allah grace.
meaning.ar: الفرح: السرور — لا تفرح إن الله لا يحب الفرحين — فرحين

meaning.en: To err, stray, go astray; seduction. 22 occurrences. Ghawā (I, 10x) = to stray/err — your companion has not strayed (Muhammad, 53:2). Aghwā (IV, 5x) = to lead astray/seduce — Satan led them astray. Ghayy (4x) = error/astray — they will be thrown into Ghayy (Hell valley, 19:59). Ghawiyy (adj., 2x) = one astray. Ghawāyah (1x) = error.
meaning.ar: الغواية: الضلال — ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى — فأغواه — غيا

meaning.en: Four, fourth; spring season. 22 occurrences. Arba a (12x) = four — four months (9:2). Rab (5x) = four (fem.). Arba in (3x) = forty — forty nights (2:51). Rub (1x) = one-fourth. Murabi (1x) = four (birds, 2:260).
meaning.ar: الأربعة: العدد — أربعة أشهر — أربعين ليلة — ربع

meaning.en: Dust, soil, earth. 22 occurrences. Turab (17x) = dust/soil — from dust He created you (3:59). Tarib (1x) = dusty/poor — or a poor person, owner of dust (90:16). Turab (3x) = dust (variant). Turaban (1x) = as dust.
meaning.ar: التراب: ما نعوم من الأرض — خلقه من تراب — ترائب

meaning.en: To err, make a mistake; sin, error. 22 occurrences. Akhṭa a (IV, 9x) = to err/make a mistake — if you make a mistake, He will forgive (33:5). Khāṭi ah (19x) = error/sin. Khaṭa (2x) = unintentional mistake — and not upon you is blame for the mistake (33:5). Khaṭi ah (1x) = a sin. Khāṭi in (1x) = sinners. Distinction from dhanb: khaṭa = unintentional error; dhanb = deliberate sin.
meaning.ar: الخطأ: ضد الصواب — وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم — خاطئة

meaning.en: Defect, fault, blemish. 21 occurrences — ALL the noun awrah (private parts / vulnerable places). Awrat (5x) = private parts / vulnerable places. Awratukum (1x) = your private parts. No verb forms in Quran.
meaning.ar: العورة: الخلل والضعف — عورات — عورة

meaning.en: To restrict, confine, besiege; to be restrained. 21 occurrences. Ahṣara (IV, 6x) = to be confined/restricted — if you are confined (during Hajj, 2:196). Ḥaṣara (I, 2x) = to confine/besiege. Ḥaṣīr (3x) = mat/floor (of Hell). Maḥṣūr (1x) = one confined. Ḥaṣūr (1x) = chaste/devoted (John the Baptist, 3:39). Ibn Faris: core = restricting and enclosing.
meaning.ar: الحصر: التضييق — أحصرتم — حصورا — حصير

meaning.en: To remain, stay, endure. 21 occurrences. Baqiya (I, 15x) = to remain — what remains of Allah provision is better (11:86). Abqā (IV, 3x) = to cause to remain/be more lasting. Bāqiyah (3x) = lasting/remaining.
meaning.ar: البقاء: ضد الفناء — بقية الله خير لكم — باقية — أبقى

meaning.en: Youth, young man; to give legal opinion (fatwa). 21 occurrences. Fata (8x) = young man/youth — the youth in the cave (ashab al-kahf). Fityan (4x) = youths. Yastaftuna (X, 5x) = they ask for a ruling — they ask you for a ruling concerning women (4:127). Afta (IV, 2x) = to give a ruling. Fatayat (1x) = young women.
meaning.ar: الفتى: الشاب — أصحاب الكهف فتيان — ويستفتونك في النساء

meaning.en: To be Jewish; the Jews; to repent. 21 occurrences. Hudan (9x) = Jews — those who are Jews (yahud). Hadu (I, 5x) = to repent/turn — those who turn/repent to You. Had (nom., 1x) = Judaism/to be Jews. Tahawwada (V, 1x) = to become Jewish. Yahud (nom., 5x) = Jews. Note: hadu = they repented AND they became Jews — both from same root.
meaning.ar: الهود: التوبة واليهودية — إنا هدنا إليك — والذين هادوا

meaning.en: To hide, conceal, suppress. 21 occurrences. Katama (I, 18x) = to conceal/hide — do not conceal testimony (2:283). Kutima (I pass., 2x) = to be hidden. Katim (1x) = concealer.
meaning.ar: الكتوم: الإخفاء — ولا تكتموا الشهادة — كاتم — يكتم

meaning.en: To wish, desire; to decree; to ejaculate (semen). 21 occurrences. Tamanna (V, 12x) = to wish/desire — what the self desires. Muna (2x) = wish/desire. Yamni (I, 1x) = to decree/destinate. Maniyy (3x) = semen — from a drop of semen. Amniyyat (3x) = wishful thinking.
meaning.ar: التمني: الأمل — أمنية — يتمن — مني

meaning.en: To spread, expand, scatter; to publish; resurrection. 21 occurrences. Nashara (I, 7x) = to spread/scatter — and He spreads mercy (42:28). Nushir (2x) = unrolled scrolls (81:10). Yanshuru (4x) = to expand/spread. Nashr (1x) = spreading. Inshirah (1x) = expansion. Anshara (IV, 3x) = to resurrect.
meaning.ar: النشر: البسط والإحياء — وينشر رحمته — وإذا الصحف نشرت

meaning.en: To establish, prescribe; way, custom; tooth. 21 occurrences. Sanna (I, 2x) = to prescribe/establish. Sinn (1x) = age/old age. Asnan (1x) = teeth — tooth for a tooth (5:45). Sunni (V, 1x) = it was prescribed. Yatasanna (V, 1x) = to age/deteriorate.
meaning.ar: السنن: الطريقة والعمر — سنة — سنن — يسن

meaning.en: To party, group; to befall, distress. 20 occurrences. Ḥizb (19x) = party/group — the party of Allah (hizb Allah). Aḥzāb (11x) = parties/confederates — Surat al-Aḥzāb. Various parties/groups.
meaning.ar: الحزب: الجماعة — حزب الله — الأحزاب — حزب
