meaning.en: To originate, create; to split open. 20 occurrences. Faṭara (I, 10x) = to create/originate — the nature upon which Allah created mankind (fiṭrat Allah, 30:30). Fāṭir (6x) = Originator/Creator — al-Fāṭir (Divine Name). Infatarat (VII, 1x) = to be cleft asunder (82:1). Munfaṭir (1x) = breaking apart (73:18). Fuṭur (1x) = flaw/crack.
meaning.ar: الفطر: الابتداع — فطرة الله التي فطر الناس عليها — فاطر السموات

meaning.en: To uncover, remove, disclose, reveal. 20 occurrences. Kashafa (I, 16x) = to remove/uncover — We removed from them their punishment. Kāshif (2x) = remover — no remover of it except Allah. Takshif (1x) = removal. Makshuf (1x) = uncovered.
meaning.ar: الكشف: الإزالة — كشفنا عنهم — كاشف — مكشوف

meaning.en: To play, sport, amuse; jest. 20 occurrences. Laʿiba (I, 5x) = to play/jest. Laʿib (8x) = play/amusement — the life of this world is but play and amusement (laʿibun wa-lahwun, 6:32). Lāʿibīn (3x) = playing/players. Talʿab (V, 2x) = you play. Yal ʿab (I, 2x) = he plays.
meaning.ar: اللعب: اللهو — وما الحياة الدنيا إلا لعب ولهو — لاعبين

meaning.en: To doubt, dispute, argue. 20 occurrences. Imtarā (VIII, 10x) = to doubt/dispute — so do not be of the doubters (fa-la takunanna min al-mumtarin, 2:147). Maraya (I, 1x) = to doubt. Mirā (3x) = disputation/argument. Yumarī (III, 2x) = to dispute/argue.
meaning.ar: المرية: الشك — فلا تكن من الممترين — تمار — مراء

meaning.en: To blow, breathe, inflate. 20 occurrences. Nafakha (I, 14x) = to blow — then We blew into it of Our spirit (21:91 — Jesus conception). Nufikha (I pass., 3x) = to be blown — the Trumpet will be blown (39:68). Nāfikh (2x) = blower. Nafkhat (1x) = the Blast.
meaning.ar: النفخ: النفث والنفخ — فنفخنا فيه من روحنا — ونفخ في الصور

meaning.en: Palm tree; to sift, screen. 20 occurrences. Nakhl (18x) = palm trees/date palms — gardens of date palms (36:34). Nakhlah (1x) = a palm tree. Nakhal (1x) = beehive. The date palm is one of the most frequently mentioned plants in the Quran.
meaning.ar: النخل: شجر التمر — وجنات من نخيل — نخلة

meaning.en: To extract, pull out, remove; to snatch away. 20 occurrences. Nazaa (I, 10x) = to extract/remove — We remove what is in their breasts of rancor (7:43). Naza at (2x) = those who extract (angels, 79:1). Intazaa (VIII, 3x) = to snatch away. Nazz (II, 4x) = to remove.
meaning.ar: النزع: الإخراج والجذب — ونزعنا ما في صدورهم — والنازعات

meaning.en: To grow, increase; usury; hill, elevation. 20 occurrences. Riba (9x) = usury/interest — Allah has permitted trade and forbidden usury (riba, 2:275). Arba (IV, 3x) = to increase/grow. Rabiya (I, 2x) = to grow/increase. Rabwah (3x) = hill/high ground. Rawabi (1x) = hills. Ribuwat (2x) = increase.
meaning.ar: الربا: الزيادة — وأحل الله البيع وحرم الربا — أربى — ربوة

meaning.en: Year; to irrigate/water. 20 occurrences. Sanah (12x) = year — a year (singular). Sinin (7x) = years — and they tarried in their cave 300 years (18:25). Sana (1x) = lightning flash — almost snatches away sight (24:43).
meaning.ar: السنة: العام — سنة — سنين — سنين

meaning.en: To rise, appear, emerge; to look upon. 19 occurrences. Tala a (I, 9x) = to rise/appear — the sun rises (18:17). Atla a (IV, 3x) = to cause to appear. Tali ah (3x) = that which emerges/rises. Matla (2x) = place of rising. Tawli a (II, 2x) = to make acquainted.
meaning.ar: الطلوع: الظهور — حتى مطلع الفجر — طلع — أطلع

meaning.en: City, town, land; to be dull/stupid. 19 occurrences. Balad (15x) = city/land — this sacred city (al-balad, 90:1). Bala (2x) = to be poor. Balda (1x) = a town. Baladatan (1x) = two towns.
meaning.ar: البلدة: القرية — وهذا البلد الأمين — بلدة

meaning.en: Fruit; to be joyous, jest. 19 occurrences. Fakihah (13x) = fruit — fruits in abundance (43:73). Tafakkaha (V, 4x) = to jest/enjoy. Fakihah (2x) = fruit.
meaning.ar: الفاكهة: الثمار — فواكه — فكهين — فاكهة

meaning.en: West, sunset; to be strange, foreign; to depart. 19 occurrences. Gharb (5x) = west/sunset — Lord of the East and the West (Rabb al-mashriq wa-l-maghrib). Maghrib (8x) = place of sunset/west. Gharib (1x) = strange. Ghurab (1x) = crow/raven (Cain and Abel). Gharab (2x) = to set (sun).
meaning.ar: الغرب: المغرب — رب المشرق والمغرب — غروبها

meaning.en: Right guidance, maturity, sound judgment. 19 occurrences. Rushd (8x) = maturity/right guidance — until the orphan reaches maturity (4:6). Rashad (6x) = right guidance/sound judgment. Rashid (2x) = rightly guided — what an excellent servant (David, 38:30). Murshid (1x) = guide. Arshada (IV, 2x) = to guide aright.
meaning.ar: الرشاد: الهداية — فإن آنستم منهم رشدا — رشيد — مرشدا

meaning.en: Hellfire, blaze (al-Sair); to kindle. 19 occurrences. Sa ir (17x) = the Blaze (one of Hell names) — the punishment of the Blaze. Sa ara (I, 1x) = to kindle fire. Su ur (1x) = kindling/fuel. Mas ur (1x) = as fuel for fire.
meaning.ar: السعر: إيقاد النار — وعذاب السعير — سجرت — سعير

meaning.en: To think, suppose, assume. 19 occurrences — SUB-FORM of root Znn (ID 290, 69x total). Zann (10x) = assumption/supposition — suspicion/supposition (zann). Yannunna (I, 9x) = they think/suppose. Note: the original file had INCORRECT Buckwalter vmn (should be Znn).
meaning.ar: الظن: التقدير — ظننتم — بظن — ظن
meaning.data_correction: FIXED: Buckwalter root was vmn (ث م ن = price), should be Znn (ظ ن ن = supposition). Same root as ID 290.

meaning.en: To be fortified, chaste, protected. 18 occurrences. Ahsana (IV, 8x) = to remain chaste/protected — Mary who guarded her chastity (ahsanat farjaha, 21:91). Muhsanah (5x) = chaste woman. Muhsin (3x) = one who guards chastity. Tahassana (V, 1x) = to be fortified. Hisn (1x) = fortress.
meaning.ar: الحصنان: المنعة والصيانة — أحصنت فرجها — محصنة — حصون

meaning.en: To creep, crawl; creature that walks. 18 occurrences. Dābbah (17x) = creature/beast — there is no creature on earth but Allah provides for it (11:6). Dābb (1x) = crawling creature. Dābbat al-arḍ (27:82) = the Beast of the Earth (eschatological sign).
meaning.ar: الدبيب: المشي البطيء — وما من دابة إلا على الله رزقها — دابة

meaning.en: From, with, from the presence of (divine proximity). 18 occurrences. Ladun (15x) = from/with — knowledge from Our presence (min ladunnā ilmā, 18:65). Ladunhu (2x) = from His presence. Laday (1x) = with. Expresses divine immediacy and proximity.
meaning.ar: اللدن: القرب والحضور — من لدن حكيم خبير — لدن

meaning.en: To establish, empower, enable; position, rank. 18 occurrences. Makkana (II, 12x) = to establish/empower — We established them in the land (6:6). Tamakkana (V, 2x) = to be established. Makan (2x) = position/place. Makin (2x) = powerful/established — with the Lord of the Throne, powerful (makin, 81:20).
meaning.ar: المكنة: التمكين — مكناهم — مكين — مكان

meaning.en: To be weary, bored, tired. 18 occurrences. Malla (I, 6x) = to be weary — your Lord does not weary (20:86, 41:49). Amla (IV, 12x) = to give respite/allow time — and I will give them respite (aqlahum).
meaning.ar: الملل: السآمة — وما ربك بظلام — يمل — مليا

meaning.en: To flee, disperse; to mobilize, go forth. 18 occurrences. Nafara (I, 14x) = to flee/be averse — they flee from you in aversion. Nafara (I, 4x) = to mobilize/go forth — go forth in the way of Allah (9:38, to war). Nafar (1x) = a group/band. Nufūr (2x) = dispersal/flight.
meaning.ar: النفور: الانزعاج والهرب — إذا قيل لهم انفروا — نافر

meaning.en: To take turns, alternate; to represent. 18 occurrences. Yanubu (I, 4x) = to represent/take turn. Nubuwat (3x) = prophethood (variant of nubuwwah). Nabba (II, 2x) = to inform. Nabat (4x) = to deputize/alternate.
meaning.ar: النيابة: الانابة — نائب — ينوب

meaning.en: To control, restrain, keep within limits. 18 occurrences. Dabaṭa (I, 8x) = to control/restrain — and they could not have contained it (18:18). Istabṭa (X, 1x) = to grasp. Yabṣuṭ (1x) = to hold firmly. Mabṭu (1x) = firmly held.
meaning.ar: الضبط: التحكم — يضبط — مضط

meaning.en: To dispute, argue, contend; adversary. 18 occurrences. Khasama (I, 12x) = to dispute/argue — they dispute with you (yukhasimūnaka). Khaṣm (6x) = adversary/opponent/opposition. Mukhtaṣim (VIII, 2x) = one who disputes.
meaning.ar: الخصام: المخاصمة — يختصمون — خصم — خصمون

meaning.en: East, sunrise, orient. 17 occurrences. Mashriq (17x) = east/sunrise — Lord of the East and the West.
meaning.ar: الشرق: المشرق — رب المشرق والمغرب

meaning.en: To return, turn back, repent. 17 occurrences. Awwab (11x) = ever-returning to Allah. Maab (2x) = place of return.
meaning.ar: الأوبة: الرجوع — نعم العبد إنه أواب

meaning.en: To seek refuge, protection. 17 occurrences. A udhu (I, 15x) = I seek refuge. The Mu aw widhatan (al-Falaq, al-Nas) are named from this root.
meaning.ar: العياذ: الالتجاء — قل أعوذ برب الناس

meaning.en: To resemble, be similar; ambiguous. 12 occurrences. Tashabaha (VI, 6x) = to be ambiguous — mutashabih = ambiguous verses (3:7). Shubiha (II pass., 5x) = to be made to resemble.
meaning.ar: الشبه: المماثلة — متشابهات — تشابهت قلوبهم

meaning.en: To encompass; north, left. 12 occurrences. Shimal (12x) = left hand/north — companions of the left hand.
meaning.ar: الشمال: الجهة — أصحاب الشمال

meaning.en: To be wretched, miserable. 12 occurrences. Shaqiya (I, 6x) = to be wretched. Ashqa (2x) = most wretched.
meaning.ar: الشقاوة: ضد السعادة — شقي — وأشقاها

meaning.en: To spread, circulate; sect, faction. 12 occurrences. Shiah (8x) = sect/faction — of his Shiah (followers, 37:83). Tashayya a (V, 2x) = to form sects. The modern term Shiah derives from this root.
meaning.ar: الشيعة: الفرقة — وإن من شيعته لإبراهيم — شيعا

meaning.en: To cross, pass over; expression, lesson. 12 occurrences. I tabara (VIII, 3x) = to take heed. Ibrah (6x) = lesson/example — a lesson for those who see (innā fī dhālika la-ʿibrah).
meaning.ar: العبر: العبور والاعتبار — لعبرة — فاعتبروا

meaning.en: To be pure, clear; to choose, select. 17 occurrences. Istafa (VIII, 13x) = to choose — Allah chooses messengers (3:33).
meaning.ar: الصفوة: النقاء والاختيار — إن الله اصطفى آدم

meaning.en: To dwell, settle, lodge. 17 occurrences. Bawwa a (II, 14x) = to settle — We settled the Children of Israel (10:93).
meaning.ar: الباءة: المسكن — وبوأنا بني إسرائيل

meaning.en: City, town, urban settlement. 17 occurrences. Madinah (14x) = city/town — Madinah (the Prophet city). Mada'in (3x) = cities — and we said: enter this city (2:58). Also name: Madyan (Shuayb people).
meaning.ar: المدينة: البلدة — مدينة — مدائن

meaning.en: To take revenge, punish; to resent, be displeased. 17 occurrences. Intaqama (VIII, 12x) = to take vengeance/punish — We will take vengeance from the criminals (32:22). Naqama (I, 5x) = to resent/be displeased.
meaning.ar: النقمة: الانتقام — انتقمنا — نقم

meaning.en: To wait, lie in wait, ambush; to delay. 17 occurrences. Tarabbasa (V, 16x) = to wait/watch — wait, we too are waiting. Murabis (1x) = watcher/one who lies in wait.
meaning.ar: التربص: الانتظار — تربصوا — متربصين

meaning.en: To travel, journey. 17 occurrences — SUB-ENTRY of root Syr (ID 405, 29x). Sara (I, 12x) = to travel. Sayyara (II, 5x) = to set in motion.
meaning.ar: السير: الانتقال — سيروا — سارت
meaning.data_note: Original Buckwalter was swr (س و ر = wall), but Arabic is س ي ر (travel). Likely mis-mapping.

meaning.en: To be humble, submissive, reverent; to lower gaze. 17 occurrences. Khasha a (I, 12x) = to be humble/submissive — hearts humbled (57:16). Khashiyah (3x) = with humility. Khashi ah (2x) = humbled (of gaze).
meaning.ar: الخشوع: التذلل والتواضع — خاشعة أبصارهم — خشعا

meaning.en: To be light, nimble; to become light. 17 occurrences. Khafafa (I, 13x) = to be light — whoever is light in the scales. Khifaf (3x) = light (pl.) — go forth lightly armed. Takhfif (II, 1x) = to lighten.
meaning.ar: الخفة: ضد الثقل — فمن خفت موازينه — خفافا

meaning.en: To claim, allege (often falsely); to guarantee. 17 occurrences. Za ama (I, 16x) = to claim/allege — they claim (za amu). Za im (1x) = guarantor/surety. Used almost exclusively of false claims in the Quran.
meaning.ar: الزعم: القول الكاذب — زعموا — زعيم

meaning.en: To be open, public, manifest. 16 occurrences. Alaniyah (7x) = openly/publicly — secretly and openly (sirran wa alaniyah). A lana (IV, 7x) = to declare openly. Alin (2x) = public/open. Opposite: sirr (secret).
meaning.ar: العلانية: ضد السر — سرا وعلانية — أعلنوا

meaning.en: To be prepared, ready. 16 occurrences. A tada (I, 10x) = to prepare — He has prepared for them (Paradise/Hell). Mu tad (IV act. part., 3x) = prepared/ready. Itadan (VIII, 1x) = to prepare. Atid (1x) = ready/present (50:18 — recording angel).
meaning.ar: العتيد: الحاضر المهيأ — أعتدنا لهم — عتيد

meaning.en: To redeem, ransom; redemption. 16 occurrences. Fidā (noun, 12x) = ransom/redemption — no ransom will be accepted (fi dyah). If tadā (VIII, 3x) = to ransom oneself. Yafda u (I, 1x) = to ransom.
meaning.ar: الفدية: الافتداء — لن يقبل منها فدية — افتدى

meaning.en: Morning, early day; to go forth early. 16 occurrences. Ghadah (9x) = early morning. Ghuduww (4x) = morning (pl.). Ghada (I, 2x) = to go forth.
meaning.ar: الغدوة: البكرة — غدوة — غدوها

meaning.en: To bind, shackle; rancor, malice; to deceive. 16 occurrences. Ghill (6x) = rancor/malice — We removed rancor from their breasts. Aghlal (5x) = shackles.
meaning.ar: الغل: الحقد والغلول — ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل — أغلال

meaning.en: To be loud, open, public. 16 occurrences. Jahara (I, 10x) = to speak loudly — whether you speak loudly, He knows the secret. Jahr (5x) = openly.
meaning.ar: الجهر: العلانية — إن تجهر بالقول — جهرا

meaning.en: To measure (by volume). 16 occurrences. Kayl (9x) = measure — give full measure (awfu al-kayl). Kayla (2x) = measuring (Yusuf story).
meaning.ar: الكيل: الوزن بالحجم — أوفوا الكيل

meaning.en: Core, essence, heart, intellect. 16 occurrences — ALL the plural ulu al-albab (possessors of intellect/understanding).
meaning.ar: اللب: العقل وخلاصة الشيء — أولو الألباب

meaning.en: Amusement, diversion, play. 16 occurrences. Lahw (13x) = amusement — life of this world is play and amusement. Alha (IV, 3x) = to distract (alhakum al-takathur, 102:1).
meaning.ar: اللهو: الشغل عن الجد — ألهاكم التكاثر

meaning.en: To spread, make smooth; bed/cradle. 16 occurrences. Mihād (7x) = bed/couch (Hell). Mahd (3x) = cradle — speaks in the cradle (Jesus, 3:46). Mahada (I, 4x) = to spread.
meaning.ar: المهد: الفراش — في المهد صبيا — ومهدت

meaning.en: To write, inscribe. 16 occurrences. Asaṭir (9x) = legends/writings of the ancients. Sattara (II, 3x) = to write (68:9). Satr (2x) = writings/lines.
meaning.ar: الأساطير: الكتابة — أساطير الأولين — سطر

meaning.en: To beat, strike; to be possessed/insane. 16 occurrences. Yatakhabbatu (V, 3x) = to be struck by Satan — like one whom Satan has struck (2:275).
meaning.ar: الخبط: الضرب — يتخبطه الشيطان من المس

meaning.en: To doubt, be in doubt. 15 occurrences. Shakka (I, 12x) = to doubt — they are in doubt about it. Shak (3x) = doubt.
meaning.ar: الشك: التردد — هم في شك — يشك

meaning.en: To exit, go out. 15 occurrences — SUB-FORM of root xrj (ID 68, 182x total). Kharaja (I, 14x) = to go out. Akhraja (IV, 1x in this count).
meaning.ar: الخروج: البروز — خرج — خرجت

meaning.en: Heat; to be free (not enslaved); to prohibit (Haram). 15 occurrences. Harr (3x) = heat — neither heat nor cold (76:13). Tahrir (II, 7x) = freeing a slave — freeing a believing slave. Hurr (2x) = free person. Huran (3x) = free.
meaning.ar: الحر: الحرارة والحرية — تحرير رقبة — حر

meaning.en: Deaf, deafness; to block, prevent. 15 occurrences. Summ (10x) = deaf (pl.) — deaf, dumb, and blind (summun bukmun umyun, 2:18). Asamma (IV, 3x) = to make deaf. Sāmma (2x) = deafness (the piercing cry).
meaning.ar: الصمم: فقد السمع — صم بكم عمي — صاخة

meaning.en: To sell, buy; to pledge allegiance (bayah). 15 occurrences. Baya a (III, 6x) = to pledge allegiance — those who pledge allegiance to you (48:10). Bay (7x) = trade/commerce — trade for which they sold themselves. Baya a (2x) = sale/pledge.
meaning.ar: البيعة: المبايعة — إن الذين يبايعونك — بيع

meaning.en: Rain; to rain down (punishment). 15 occurrences. Matar (6x) = rain — and We rained upon them a rain (of stones). Amṭara (IV, 8x) = to rain down — We rained upon them (stones, punishment). Matar (1x) = rain (in the sense of punishment).
meaning.ar: المطر: المطر — وأمطرنا عليهم حجارة — مطر

meaning.en: To offer for sale, seek; to brand; to pasturage. 15 occurrences. Tasawwama (V, 3x) = to seek/wish — Allah sent a wind to destroy them. Sawwama (II, 4x) = to brand/mark (horses). Yasumu (I, 8x) = to seek/offer.
meaning.ar: السوم: الطلب — تسومون — مسومة

meaning.en: To be night-blind; to turn away in neglect. 14 occurrences. A shā (II, 2x) = to avert/ignore — whoever turns away from remembrance of the Most Merciful (43:36). I sha (IV, 1x) = to be blind. I shā (11x) = evening prayer.
meaning.ar: العشى: العمش — يعش — عشاء

meaning.en: To give, grant, bestow. 14 occurrences. A ta (I, 12x) = to give — and I will certainly give you (38:39). Utiya (I pass., 4x) = to be given — they were given from everything.
meaning.ar: الإعطاء: المناولة — آتاهم — أتوا — يؤت

meaning.en: To invent, fabricate, originate. 14 occurrences. Iftarā (VIII, 8x) = to invent/fabricate — inventing against Allah. Ikhtara a (VIII, 4x) = to originate/invent. Mukhtari (VIII act. part., 2x) = inventor. DISTINCT from kharaja (خ ر ج = exit).
meaning.ar: الاختراع: الابتكار — افترى — اخترع

meaning.en: To line up, stand in rows; rank, file. 14 occurrences. Saffa (I, 8x) = to line up/arrange in rows — entering Paradise in rows. Sāffāt (5x) = those who line up (angels — al-Saffat, Surah 37). Saff (1x) = rows — as if they were a solid structure (61:4).
meaning.ar: الصف: الترتيب — حبذا الصافات — صفا

meaning.en: To blame, reproach, censure. 14 occurrences. Yalumu (I, 10x) = to blame — blaming themselves (68:30). Lawwamat (1x) = self-blaming soul (al-nafs al-lawwamah, 75:2). Lawm (2x) = blame. Malum (1x) = blamed.
meaning.ar: اللوم: العذل — ولا أقسم بالنفس اللوامة — لوم

meaning.en: To stone, pelt; to guess/conjecture. 14 occurrences. Rajam (I, 5x) = to stone — they said: we will certainly stone you (36:18). Rajm (2x) = stoning/stones — driven away with stones (of jinn, 67:5). Rajm (3x) = conjecture — they say: conjecture (without knowledge).
meaning.ar: الرجم: الضرب بالحجارة — لنرجمنك — رجوما

meaning.en: To anchor, be firm, be fixed. 14 occurrences. Arsā (IV, 7x) = to anchor/make firm — He cast mountains on it (anchors) (13:3). Rāsiyāt (7x) = firmly fixed (mountains).
meaning.ar: الرسو: الثبات — وألقى رواسي — راسيات

meaning.en: To err, go astray. 14 occurrences — SUB-FORM of root gwy (ID 472, 22x). Ghawā (I, 10x) = to stray. Aghwā (IV, 4x) = to lead astray.
meaning.ar: الغواية: الضلال — غوى — أغوى

meaning.en: To describe, attribute, ascribe. 14 occurrences. Yaṣifūna (I, 12x) = they describe/ascribe — exalted is He above what they ascribe. Ṣifah (1x) = attribute/description. Wāṣifūna (1x) = those who describe.
meaning.ar: الوصف: النعت — سبحانه عما يصفون — واصفات

meaning.en: To enter, penetrate. 14 occurrences. Walaja (I, 11x) = to enter/penetrate — He causes the night to enter the day. Yaliju (3x) = it enters/penetrates.
meaning.ar: الولوج: الدخول — يولج الليل في النهار

meaning.en: To sow, plant, cultivate. 14 occurrences. Zara a (I, 8x) = to sow/plant — you till and sow. Zar (3x) = cultivation/crops. Zurrā (3x) = tillers/farmers.
meaning.ar: الزرع: الإنبات — أفرأيتم ما تحرثون — زرع

meaning.en: To desire, crave, lust after. 13 occurrences. Shahwah (5x) = desire/lust — they follow nothing but desire (inn yattabi una illa al-shahawat). Ishtahā (VIII, 4x) = to crave/desire. Tashahhī (V, 3x) = to desire eagerly.
meaning.ar: الشهوة: رغبة النفس — إن يتبعون إلا الشهوات — اشتهت

meaning.en: To be narrow, constricted, distressed. 13 occurrences. Dāqa (I, 11x) = to be narrow/distressed — your breast becomes constrained (Dāqa). Dayyiq (1x) = narrow/straitened. Dayq (1x) = constriction.
meaning.ar: الضيق: ضد السعة — ضاقت — يضيق

meaning.en: To protect, preserve, hold fast. 13 occurrences. I taṣama (VIII, 8x) = to hold fast — whoever holds fast to Allah (3:101). Aṣama (I, 2x) = to protect. Iṣam (1x) = holding fast. Aṣama (IV, 1x) = to protect.
meaning.ar: العصمة: الحفظ والمنع — ومن يعتصم بالله — عصم

meaning.en: To swear, take an oath. 13 occurrences. Aqsama (IV) is the dominant oath verb in Quran; ḥalafa is a secondary oath verb. Hala fa (I, 11x) = to swear — they swear by Allah (yaḥlifūna bi-Llāh). Hallāf (2x) = habitual swearer.
meaning.ar: الحلف: القسم — يحلفون بالله — حلاف

meaning.en: To shout, cry out, scream. 13 occurrences. Sayḥah (7x) = the Blast/Cry — the single shout of the trumpet (punishment). Ṣākha (2x) = the piercing shout. Yaṣīḥu (I, 3x) = to cry out.
meaning.ar: الصيحة: الصوت الشديد — فأخذتهم الصيحة — الصاخة

meaning.en: To hope, desire, covet; to be greedy. 13 occurrences. Ṭami a (I, 12x) = to hope/covet — do you hope they will believe (a-fa-taṭma ūna, 2:75). Ṭama (1x) = hope/desire.
meaning.ar: الطمع: الأمل — أفتطمعون أن يؤمنوا لكم — طمع

meaning.en: To come suddenly, unexpectedly. 13 occurrences — ALL the adverb baghtatan (suddenly). Baghtatan (13x) = suddenly/unexpectedly — the Hour will not come except suddenly (lā ta tīkum illā baghtatan, 7:187).
meaning.ar: البغتة: الفجأة — لا تأتيكم إلا بغتة

meaning.en: To ransom, sacrifice, redeem. 13 occurrences. Fadā (noun, 8x) = ransom — no ransom accepted. Yafdin (I, 3x) = to ransom. Iftadā (VIII, 2x) = to ransom oneself.
meaning.ar: الفدية: الافتداء — فداء — افدى

meaning.en: Mouth. 13 occurrences — ALL the noun fam (mouth). Famuhum (their mouths, 3:167). Afwāhihim (in their mouths, 3:118). Afwāhihim (their mouths speak, 24:15).
meaning.ar: الفم: عضو الكلام — أفواههم — فاه

meaning.en: To be coarse, harsh, rough, severe. 13 occurrences. Ghalīẓ (6x) = harsh/severe — harsh punishment. Ghalẓat (4x) = harshness. Ghalīẓun (2x) = harsh. Aghlaẓa (IV, 1x) = to be harsh — and be not harsh with them (3:159).
meaning.ar: الغلظة: الشدة — ولا تغلظ عليهم — غليظ — غلاظ

meaning.en: Boy, youth, slave-boy. 13 occurrences. Ghulām (13x) = boy/youth — of a righteous boy (Zakariyya, 3:38). Also: Ishmael (37:101), Jesus (Joseph story).
meaning.ar: الغلام: الصبي — بغلام — غلام

meaning.en: To flog, whip; leather, skin. 13 occurrences. Jaldah (4x) = a flogging/lash — flog each with a hundred lashes (24:2). Julūd (9x) = skins — their skins will testify (41:21).
meaning.ar: الجلد: الضرب — فاجلدوا كل واحد منهما — جلود

meaning.en: Neighbour; to be unjust, deviate. 13 occurrences. Jār (7x) = neighbour — the neighbour near and far (4:36). Jāra (I, 3x) = to deviate/be unjust, incline. Jawr (2x) = injustice/deviation.
meaning.ar: الجوار: القرب والظلم — الجار ذي القربى — جور — يجور

meaning.en: To give sincere advice, be faithful, counsel. 13 occurrences. Nasaḥa (I, 11x) = to advise sincerely — I advised you (7:79). Nāṣiḥ (1x) = sincere advisor. Nuṣḥ (1x) = sincere advice.
meaning.ar: النصح: الإخلاص في المشورة — نصحت لكم — ناصح

meaning.en: Star. 13 occurrences. Najm (8x) = star — by the star when it sets (53:1). Nujūm (5x) = stars (pl.) — by the stars they are guided (16:16).
meaning.ar: النجم: الكوكب — والنجم إذا هوى — وبالنجم

meaning.en: To be devoutly obedient, humble before God. 13 occurrences. Qanata (I, 10x) = to be devoutly obedient — stand before Allah devoutly obedient (2:238). Qānit (3x) = devout/obedient — Mary was devoutly obedient (Yā Maryamu uqnuti li-Rabbik, 3:43).
meaning.ar: القنوت: الدوام على الطاعة — يا مريم اقنتي لربك — قانت

meaning.en: To lend; a loan. 13 occurrences. Qarḍ (10x) = a loan — who will give Allah a good loan (man dhā alladhī yuqriḍu Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan, 57:11). Yuqriḍ (I, 3x) = to lend.
meaning.ar: القرض: الإقراض — من ذا الذي يقرض الله قرضا حسنا

meaning.en: To be compassionate, merciful; pity. 13 occurrences. Ra ūf (11x) = Most Compassionate (Divine Name, paired with Raḥīm). Ra fat (2x) = compassion/pity — and in their hearts He placed compassion (57:27).
meaning.ar: الرأفة: الرحمة — رؤوف رحيم — رأفة

meaning.en: To bow, kneel in prayer. 13 occurrences. Raki a (I, 8x) = to bow — bow with those who bow (irka ū ma a al-rāki īn, 2:43). Rāki ūn (5x) = those who bow — they bow and prostrate (rukkā an sujjadan).
meaning.ar: الركوع: الانحناء في الصلاة — اركعوا مع الراكعين — ركعا سجدا

meaning.en: Time, appointed period. 13 occurrences. Mawqūt (4x) = appointed/specified — prayer is a timed decree (kitāban mawqūtan, 4:103). Waqt (2x) = time/appointment. Mīqāt (7x) = appointed time/place — the appointment of Moses (7:142).
meaning.ar: الوقت: الزمان المحدود — كتابا موقوتا — ميقات

meaning.en: To be a close friend; intimacy (Khalil). 13 occurrences. Khalīl (6x) = intimate friend — Allah took Abraham as a friend (khalīl). Khillah (2x) = friendship/intimacy. Khilāl (5x) = during/in between — and they passed among them.
meaning.ar: الخلة: الصداقة — واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلا — خلال

meaning.en: To store, treasure, hoard. 13 occurrences. Khazā in (8x) = treasures/storehouses — the treasures of Pharaoh. Khizānat (3x) = treasuries — for Us are the treasuries of the heavens and earth (15:21). Khāzin (2x) = treasurer/keeper.
meaning.ar: الخزن: الادخار — خزائن — خازن

meaning.en: Staff, stick, rod. 12 occurrences. Aṣā (12x) = staff — Moses staff (throw your staff, alqi aṣāka, 20:19). The staff of Moses is the central narrative item. Also: struck the stone (2:60).
meaning.ar: العصا: ما يتوكأ عليه — ألق عصاك — عصاه

meaning.en: Difficulty, hardship; to be difficult. 12 occurrences. Usr (6x) = hardship/difficulty — with hardship comes ease (fa-inna ma a al-usri yusran, 94:5-6). Asara (IV, 2x) = to make difficult. Asar (2x) = difficult/impossible. Asīr (1x) = difficult.
meaning.ar: العسر: ضد اليسر — فإن مع العسر يسرا

meaning.en: To incline (toward truth); true monotheist (Hanif). 12 occurrences. Ḥanīf (12x) = true monotheist, inclining away from polytheism — Abraham was a Ḥanīf (ḥanīfan musliman, 3:67). Ibn Faris: core = incline away from crookedness toward the straight.
meaning.ar: الحنيفية: الميل عن الباطل — كان إبراهيم حنيفا مسلما

meaning.en: To hope, desire, covet. 12 occurrences — related to ṭ-m-n (ID 563). Ṭamaʿa (I, 12x) = to hope/desire.
meaning.ar: الطمع: الأمل — طمع — يطمع

meaning.en: Clay, mud. 12 occurrences. Ṭīn (9x) = clay — He created man from clay (khalaqa al-insāna min ṭīn). Ṭīn (3x) = clay (variant).
meaning.ar: الطين: التراب المختلط بالماء — من طين

meaning.en: Early morning; to be early. 12 occurrences. Bukrah (9x) = early morning — and glorify Him morning and evening (bukratan wa-aṣīlan, 48:9). Abkār (2x) = firstborn/virgins. Ibkār (1x) = early morning.
meaning.ar: البكرة: أول النهار — بكرة وأصيلا — أبكارا

meaning.en: To be miserly, stingy. 12 occurrences. Bakhila (I, 10x) = to be miserly — those who are miserly (alladhīna yabkhalūna). Bukhl (2x) = miserliness — Allah does not love the miserly.
meaning.ar: البخل: المنع — الذين يبخلون — بخلا

meaning.en: White; egg. 12 occurrences. Bayḍ (8x) = white — white and black (of dawn, thread). Abyaḍ (2x) = white — white of the eye. Bayḍ (2x) = eggs — as if they were preserved eggs (37:49).
meaning.ar: البياض: اللون — الخيط الأبيض من الخيط الأسود

meaning.en: To reach, attain, overtake. 12 occurrences. Adraka (IV, 5x) = to reach/overtake — until he reached the setting of the sun (18:86). Darak (3x) = reaching. Tadarruk (V, 1x) = to gradually reach. Mudrik (IV act. part., 3x) = one who reaches.
meaning.ar: الإدراك: اللحوق — حتى إذا بلغ مغرب الشمس — أدرك

meaning.en: To deny, reject (despite inner conviction). 12 occurrences. Jahada (I, 11x) = to deny/reject — they denied Our signs, though their souls were convinced of them (27:14). Juhūd (1x) = vehement denial. DISTINCT from kufr: juḥūd = denial WITH inner conviction of truth.
meaning.ar: الجحود: الإنكار مع المعرفة — وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها أنفسهم

meaning.en: To collect, gather; tax, tribute. 12 occurrences. Jibāyah (1x) = tax/tribute. Yujbā (I, 2x) = to be gathered/collected — to it are gathered fruits (28:57). Ijtibā (VIII, 4x) = to choose/select — and your Lord chooses whom He wills (28:68). Jāb (5x) = collection/basin.
meaning.ar: الجبي: الجمع — يجبي — اجتباه

meaning.en: To hide, conceal, shelter. 12 occurrences. Akanna (IV, 7x) = to hide/conceal — what they concealed in their breasts (2:235). Kanna (I, 4x) = to hide — and they hide (2:271). Maknan (1x) = hiding place (16:81).
meaning.ar: الكن: الستر — أكنوا — تكن

meaning.en: Meat, flesh. 12 occurrences. Laḥm (12x) = meat/flesh — and flesh of birds they desire (56:21). Both fresh and cooked meat; food of Paradise dwellers.
meaning.ar: اللحم: ما يؤكل — ولحم طير مما يشتهون

meaning.en: To drip; a drop of fluid. 12 occurrences. Nuṭfah (12x) = a drop (of semen) — He created man from a drop of fluid (khalqa al-insāna min nuṭfah).
meaning.ar: النطفة: القطرة — من نطفة — نطف

meaning.en: To speak, articulate, pronounce. 12 occurrences. Naṭaqa (I, 2x) = to speak — so He made us speak (41:21 — skins speak). Nuṭq (4x) = speech/articulation. Manṭiq (1x) = logic/speech. Naṭīq (3x) = one who speaks.
meaning.ar: النطق: التكلم — أنطقنا الله الذي أنطق كل شيء — منطق

meaning.en: To gush, spring forth; to bring out. 12 occurrences. Anba a (IV, 9x) = to cause to gush forth — We caused springs to gush forth from the earth (36:34). Naba a (I, 2x) = to gush. Yanba a (1x) = to flow forth.
meaning.ar: النبع: الخروج — أنبع — ينبوع

meaning.en: To attain, reach, obtain. 12 occurrences. Nāla (I, 12x) = to attain/reach — they will not attain His mercy (lan yanālū). Yanāl (6x) = to reach. Nāl (6x) = he attained.
meaning.ar: النيل: الإدراك — لن ينالوا — نال

meaning.en: To fear, be in awe. 12 occurrences — relates to rHb (ID 113). Rahiba (I, 3x) = to fear — fear Me (fa-rhabūn, 2:40). Rahbān (3x) = monks. Rabbaniyyah (1x) = monasticism. Turhib (IV, 1x) = to terrify.
meaning.ar: الرهبة: الخوف — فارهبون — رهبان

meaning.en: To travel; to unveil, make manifest. 12 occurrences. Safar (3x) = travel/journey. Asfara (IV, 1x) = to shine/become bright (dawn). Sifr (2x) = book/scroll (62:5). Musāfir (2x) = traveler. Su fur (2x) = unveiling faces.
meaning.ar: السفر: الانتقال — سفر — أسفر

meaning.en: To imprison, jail. 12 occurrences. Sijn (7x) = prison — he preferred prison (Yusuf, 12:33). Sajana (I, 1x) = to imprison. Masjūn (2x) = imprisoned. Sujjan (2x) = imprisoned.
meaning.ar: السجن: الحبس — رب السجن أحب إلي — سجن

meaning.en: To traverse, follow, travel (a path). 12 occurrences. Salaka (I, 9x) = to traverse/travel — He made you traverse paths. Yashruku (2x) = to insert/cause to pass. Maslak (1x) = path/way.
meaning.ar: السلوك: الدخول في الطريق — يسلكه — سلك

meaning.en: Valley, riverbed; blood-money (diyah). 12 occurrences. Wād (10x) = valley — the valley of the ants (wād al-naml, 27:18). Wadī (2x) = valley/watercourse. The root w-d-y also means to pay blood-money (diyah) but this sense is not in Quran.
meaning.ar: الوادي: مجرى الماء — واد النمل

meaning.en: To address, speak publicly; to propose marriage. 12 occurrences. Khaḍaba (III, 6x) = to address — he addressed them (28:63). Khiṭbah (4x) = proposal/wedding proposal. Khaṭb (2x) = affair/matter — what is your great affair (38:23).
meaning.ar: الخطاب: الكلام — خطبهم — خطبة

meaning.en: To fall down, collapse, prostrate. 12 occurrences. Kharra (I, 10x) = to fall down/prostrate — and he fell down prostrate (wa-kharra rāki an, 38:24). Kharrū (I, 2x) = they fell. Used for prostration, collapse, and falling from heaven (jinn).
meaning.ar: الخرور: السقوط — وخر راكعا — خروا

meaning.en: To wade, engage in vain talk, plunge. 12 occurrences. Khāḍa (I, 10x) = to wade/engage in vain talk — leave them to plunge in their vain discourse (74:45). Khawḍ (2x) = vain talk/idle discourse — and when they passed by vain talk they passed with dignity (25:72).
meaning.ar: الخوض: الدخول في الباطل — وكنا نخوض مع الخائضين — خوض

meaning.en: To fear, feel pity; twilight. 11 occurrences. Ashfaqa (IV, 8x) = to fear/be apprehensive — they fear their Lord (yushfiqūna). Shafaq (1x) = twilight/redness — by the twilight (84:16). Shafaqah (2x) = compassion/pity.
meaning.ar: الشفق: الخوف وحمرة الأفق — مشفقون — فإذا انشقت السماء

meaning.en: Grapes. 11 occurrences. Inab (11x) = grapes — and grapes and clover (80:28). Mentioned as a food of Paradise and earthly blessing.
meaning.ar: العنب: الثمر المعروف — وعنبا — أعناب

meaning.en: To help, aid, assist. 11 occurrences. Isti āna (X, 9x) = to seek help — You alone we worship, and You alone we seek help from (iyyāka nasta īn, 1:5). Ta āwana (VI, 2x) = to help one another — help one another in righteousness (5:2).
meaning.ar: العون: المساعدة — إياك نستعين — وتعاونوا

meaning.en: Pebbles, small stones; to count, enumerate. 11 occurrences. Aḥṣā (IV, 10x) = to count/enumerate — He has enumerated them and counted them exactly (19:94). Ḥaṣīd (1x) = harvested/reaped (barren land).
meaning.ar: الإحصاء: العد — أحصاهم — حصيد

meaning.en: War, battle; to be plundered. 11 occurrences. Ḥarb (4x) = war — waging war against Allah and His Messenger (yuḥāribūna Allaha wa-rasūlahu, 5:33). Muḥārabah (1x) = waging war. Ḥaraba (I, 1x) = he went to war.
meaning.ar: الحرب: القتال — يحاربون الله ورسوله

meaning.en: To be thunderstruck, stunned, overpowered. 11 occurrences. Ṣā iqah (4x) = thunderbolt — the thunderbolt seized them. Ṣa iqa (I, 5x) = to be thunderstruck — when Moses fell down thunderstruck (7:143). Ṣā iq (2x) = thunderbolt.
meaning.ar: الصعقة: الموت أو الغشية — فأخذتهم الصاعقة — صعق

meaning.en: Side, edge, extremity, viewpoint. 11 occurrences. Ṭaraf (6x) = side/edge — do you come upon them from a side (ṭaraf). Aṭrāf (5x) = edges/extremities — the edges of the day (11:114).
meaning.ar: الطرف: الجانب — أطراف النهار — طرف

meaning.en: To knock, come by night; path, way. 11 occurrences. Ṭarīq (6x) = path/way — and by the night comer (al-ṭāriq, 86:1). Ṭarq (2x) = knocking/approach. Ṭarīqah (2x) = path/method — the best path (aḥsan ṭarīqah). Iṭrāq (1x) = coming by night.
meaning.ar: الطريق: السبيل — والطارق — طريقا

meaning.en: Stage, phase; Mount Sinai. 11 occurrences. Aṭwār (1x) = stages/phases — He created you in stages (aṭwāran, 71:14). Ṭūr (10x) = Mount Sinai — and We called him from the side of the Mount (al-Ṭūr, 19:52).
meaning.ar: الطور: الجبل — وطور سينين — أطوارا

meaning.en: To return, turn back; shade. 11 occurrences. Fā a (I, 6x) = to return/come back — until they return to sense (al-ḥijr, 15:9). Afā a (IV, 1x) = to restore/bring back. Fay (4x) = shade — do they not see the shade how it stretches (25:45).
meaning.ar: الفيء: الرجوع — فاءوا — وما ملكت أيمانكم — ظل

meaning.en: To flee, escape. 11 occurrences. Farra (I, 10x) = to flee — the day a man flees from his brother (yawma yafirru al-mar u min akhīhi, 80:34). Mafarr (1x) = place of escape — and you will have no place of escape (42:35).
meaning.ar: الفرار: الهرب — يوم يفر المرء من أخيه — مفر

meaning.en: Grief, sorrow, distress; cloud, covering. 11 occurrences. Ghamm (9x) = grief/distress — and grief you could not bear (qad aghamma). Ghamam (2x) = clouds — We shaded them with clouds (ghamām, 2:57).
meaning.ar: الغم: الكرب — غما — غمام

meaning.en: To anger, enrage, exasperate. 11 occurrences. Ghayẓ (7x) = rage/anger — and swallow their rage (wa-yaẓʿama). Ghaẓa (I, 4x) = to enrage — to enrage the disbelievers (li-yaghīẓahum, 48:29).
meaning.ar: الغيظ: الغضب — يغيظهم — غيظا

meaning.en: Camel; rope; to beautify. 11 occurrences. Jamīl (3x) = beautiful — patience is beautiful (ṣabrun jamīl, 12:18). Jummal (1x) = cable/rope — until the camel passes through the eye of a needle (jaml, 7:40). Jam a (VI, 7x) = to sum up.
meaning.ar: الجمال: الحسن — صبر جميل — جمل — أجمل

meaning.en: Vain talk, nonsense; idle oaths. 11 occurrences. Laghw (9x) = vain talk/idle speech — and when they pass by vain talk they pass with dignity (25:72). Laghā (I, 2x) = to speak vainly. Allah does not hold you accountable for thoughtless oaths (al-laghw fī aymānikum, 2:225). NOT confused with l-q-l (quarrel ID 573).
meaning.ar: اللغو: الباطل من الكلام — وإذا مروا باللغو مروا كراما

meaning.en: To suckle, breastfeed. 11 occurrences. Arḍa a (IV, 9x) = to breastfeed — mothers shall breastfeed their children (al-wālidātu yurḍi na awlādahunna, 2:233). Raḍi a (I, 1x) = to suckle. Raḍā ah (1x) = suckling/breastfeeding — your suckling sisters (4:23).
meaning.ar: الرضاعة: الإرضاع — والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن — رضاعة

meaning.en: To drag, pull, draw along. 11 occurrences. Saḥaba (I, 11x) = to drag — they will be dragged into the Fire (yusḥabūna fī al-ḥamīm, 40:71). Yusḥabūn (pass., 6x) = they are dragged. Used almost exclusively for punishment dragging.
meaning.ar: السحب: الجر — يسحبون في الحميم — سحب

meaning.en: To insult, revile, curse vulgarly. 11 occurrences. Sabba (I, 10x) = to insult/revile — and do not insult those they invoke besides Allah (wa-lā tasubbū alladhīna yad ūna min dūni Allah, 6:108). Sabb (1x) = insult. DISTINCT from la n (ID 333) which is more formal curse.
meaning.ar: السب: الشتم — ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله

meaning.en: To be foolish, reckless, light-minded. 11 occurrences. Safih (6x) = foolish/reckless — and do not give the foolish your wealth (al-sufahā a, 4:5). Safaha (I, 3x) = to be foolish — you were foolish with yourselves (safihat anfusukum, 49:6). Safah (1x) = foolishness.
meaning.ar: السفه: الجهل — ولا تؤتوا السفهاء أموالكم

meaning.en: To rely, lean upon, entrust. 11 occurrences. Tawakkala (V, 9x) = to rely upon/entrust — and rely upon the Living One who never dies (wa-tawakkal alā al-Ḥayyi alladhī lā yamūt, 25:58). Wakīl (2x) = trustee/disposer.
meaning.ar: التوكل: الاعتماد — وتوكل على الحي الذي لا يموت

meaning.en: To kindle, ignite, set ablaze. 11 occurrences. Waqada (I, 1x) = to kindle. Waqūd (3x) = fuel — whose fuel is men and stones (waqūduhā al-nās wa al-ḥijārah, 2:24). Tawaqqud (V, 7x) = to be kindled/ignite.
meaning.ar: الوقود: الحطب — وقودها الناس والحجارة — وقد

meaning.en: To arrive, come to water; resource. 11 occurrences. Warada (I, 11x) = to arrive/come (to water). Wa-rāda (3x) = and they arrived. Mawrūd (2x) = arrival place. Mawrid (1x) = watering place.
meaning.ar: الورود: القدوم — وبرزت الجحيم — واردهم

meaning.en: To direct oneself toward, aim; sea. 11 occurrences. Tayammama (V, 4x) = to aim for/intend — then aim for clean earth (fa-tayammamū ṣa īdan, 4:43 — tayammum). Yamm (7x) = sea — and We took the children of Israel across the sea (al-yamm, 7:138).
meaning.ar: التيمم: القصد — فتيمموا صعيدا طيبا — اليم

meaning.en: Book, scripture; to piece together. 11 occurrences. Zabūr (9x) = book/scripture — and to David We gave the Zabur (al-zabūr, 17:55). Zubar (2x) = pieces/portions — portions of scripture.
meaning.ar: الزبور: الكتاب — وآتينا داود زبورا — زبر

meaning.en: Origin, root, foundation; late afternoon. 10 occurrences. Aṣl (4x) = origin/root — a good tree whose root is firm (aṣluhā thābit, 14:24). Aṣīl (3x) = late afternoon — glorify Him morning and afternoon (al-aṣīl, 76:25). Aṣālah (1x) = originality.
meaning.ar: الأصل: القاعدة — أصلها ثابت

meaning.en: To laugh, smile. 10 occurrences. Ḍaḥika (I, 9x) = to laugh — so she laughed (fa-ḍaḥikat, 11:71 — Sarah hearing she would bear Isaac). Ḍaḥik (1x) = laughing. Yaḍḥak (4x) = they laugh. Some exegetes: ḍaḥika can also mean to menstruate (from metaphor of gushing).
meaning.ar: الضحك: خفة الروح — فضحكت — يضحكون

meaning.en: To be lost, wasted, perished. 10 occurrences. Ḍā a (I, 10x) = to be lost/wasted — and your deeds will be wasted (wa-ḍalla mā kānū ya malūn, 6:88). Yuḍī u (IV) = to cause loss.
meaning.ar: الضياع: الفقد والهلاك — ضل ما كانوا يعملون — ضاع

meaning.en: To exceed bounds, be arrogant, rebel. 10 occurrences. Atā (I, 6x) = to be arrogant/rebellious — and they behaved arrogantly and became a people of sin (41:38). Atiyy (2x) = extremely arrogant. Tattā (IV, 2x) = to be insolent.
meaning.ar: العتو: التكبر — استكبروا وكانوا قوما عاتين

meaning.en: To isolate, separate, remove. 10 occurrences. I tazala (VIII, 5x) = to separate/withdraw — and I withdraw from you (wa-a tazilukum, 19:48). uzila (IV, 2x) = to isolate. Ma zūl (1x) = isolated.
meaning.ar: العزل: التنحي — وأعتزلكم

meaning.en: To surround, encircle, encompass (usually punishment). 10 occurrences. Ḥāqa (I, 10x) = to surround/encompass — and there surrounded them the evil consequences (wa-ḥāqa bi-āli Fir awna sū u al-adhāb, 40:45). Always used for punishment encircling wrongdoers.
meaning.ar: الحوق: الإحاطة — وحاق بآل فرعون سوء العذاب

meaning.en: To be long; length, duration. 10 occurrences. Ṭāla (I, 10x) = to be long — the stay has been long upon them (fa-ṭāla alayhimu al-amad, 57:16). Ṭawl (2x) = length/favor. Ṭūl (2x) = length/duration.
meaning.ar: الطول: الامتداد — فطال عليهم الأمد

meaning.en: To seize violently, grip, strike. 10 occurrences. Baṭasha (I, 10x) = to seize violently — the day We seize with the greatest seizure (yawma nabṭishu al-baṭshata al-kubrā, 44:16). Most often used of divine punishment.
meaning.ar: البطش: الأخذ بشدة — يوم نبطش البطشة الكبرى

meaning.en: To push back, repel, defend. 10 occurrences. Dafa a (I, 8x) = to push back/repel — and were it not that Allah repels people (law-lā daf u Allah, 2:251). Iddafa a (VIII, 2x) = to push back mutually.
meaning.ar: الدفع: الإزالة — ولولا دفع الله الناس

meaning.en: To destroy, annihilate, devastate. 10 occurrences. Dammara (II, 10x) = to utterly destroy — so We destroyed them with complete destruction (fa-dammarnāhum tadmīran, 25:36). Always used of divine destruction.
meaning.ar: التدمير: الإهلاك — فدمرناهم تدميرا

meaning.en: To be near, approach. 10 occurrences. Danā (I, 4x) = to be near — then drew near and descended (thumma danā fa-tadallā, 53:8 — of Gabriel). Adnā (IV, 4x) = to bring near — the lowest heaven (al-samā a al-dunyā, 67:5). Dān (1x) = near.
meaning.ar: الدنو: القرب — ثم دنا فتدلى — الدنيا

meaning.en: To be serious, earnest; new; cut off; grandeur. 10 occurrences. Jadd (2x) = seriousness/grandeur — Exalted is the grandeur of our Lord (ta ālā jaddu rabbinā, 72:3). Jadīd (6x) = new — are We worn out by the first creation? Nay, they are in doubt about a new creation (50:15). Judad (2x) = paths/streambeds — among the mountains are paths (judad) white and red (35:27).
meaning.ar: الجد: العظمة والاجتهاد — تعالى جد ربنا — خلق جديد

meaning.en: To guarantee, take charge of; double, portion. 10 occurrences. Kafala (I, 3x) = to take charge of/guardian — and her guardian was Zechariah (wa-kaffalahā Zakariyyā, 3:37 — Mary). Kifl (3x) = portion/double — He will give you a double portion (kiflayn, 57:28). Kafīl (1x) = guarantor (16:91).
meaning.ar: الكفالة: الضمان — وكفلها زكريا — كفلين

meaning.en: Water. 10 occurrences — MAJOR root. Mā (10+ occurrences in various forms). The root m-w-h / m-y-h — He sends down water from the sky (anzala min al-samā i mā an, 13:17). Water appears 63+ times in Quran total; this entry counts 10 occurrences of the root specifically.
meaning.ar: الماء: السائل المعروف — وأنزل من السماء ماء

meaning.en: To fill; to pass time, wait. 10 occurrences. Malā (I, 6x) = to fill — when the seas are filled (idhā al-biḥāru sujjirat, 81:6). Amlā (IV, 2x) = to give respite/defer — do not let their free passage deceive you (lā yaghurrannakum taqallubuhum, 3:196). Mily (1x) = a while.
meaning.ar: الملء: الامتلاء — وإذا البحار سجرت — أملى

meaning.en: To decrease, diminish, reduce. 10 occurrences. Naqaṣa (I, 3x) = to decrease — and We test you with loss of wealth (wa-naqṣin min al-amwāl, 2:155). Naqṣ (4x) = deficiency/decrease. Tanāquṣ (VI, 3x) = mutual reduction.
meaning.ar: النقص: الانتقاص — ونقص من الأموال — نقص

meaning.en: To be holy, pure, sanctified. 10 occurrences. Qaddūs (2x) = Most Holy — He is Allah, the King, the Most Holy (al-maliku al-quddūs, 59:23). Muqaddas (2x) = holy/sanctified — the holy valley (Tuwā, 20:12). Rūḥ al-Qudus (4x) = the Holy Spirit (Gabriel).
meaning.ar: القدس: الطهارة — القدوس — روح القدس

meaning.en: To overpower, subdue, dominate. 10 occurrences. Qahhār (6x) = the Almighty Subduer — and Allah is the One, the Subduer (al-wāḥidu al-qahhār, 12:39). Qahara (I, 4x) = to overpower — so the truth overpowered them (6:18).
meaning.ar: القهر: الغلبة — القهار — فإذا هم مبلسون

meaning.en: To graze (animals); to tend, care for. 10 occurrences. Ra ā (I, 6x) = to graze/shepherd — and when they water (their flocks) (28:24 — Moses with Median women). Ra ī (2x) = shepherd. Mar ā (2x) = pasture — We have caused to grow fine pastures (87:4).
meaning.ar: الرعي: الحفظ — يرعى — مرعى

meaning.en: To cover, overwhelm; burden; near puberty. 10 occurrences. Rahiq (3x) = overwhelming/covering. Arhaqa (IV, 3x) = to burden/overwhelm — and do not burden them. Ruhq (2x) = burden/sin. Raqa (I, 2x) = to reach near puberty.
meaning.ar: الرهق: الغشيان — ولا ترهقهم — رهق

meaning.en: Filth, impurity, defilement (moral/spiritual). 10 occurrences. Rijs (10x) = filth/uncleanliness — it is filth (innahu rijs, 6:145). Used for idol worship (22:30), doubt (10:100), swine flesh (6:145), and hypocrisy (9:125). DISTINCT from rjz (ID 650): rjs = state of defilement, rjz = active torment.
meaning.ar: الرجس: القذر — إنه رجس

meaning.en: Torment, punishment, plague; to avert. 10 occurrences. Rijz (6x) = punishment/torment — so We sent upon them the punishment from the sky (al-rijz, 7:162 — locusts, lice, etc.). Rujz (2x) = torment. Arjaza (IV, 2x) = to avert — We averted the punishment from them (43:50). DISTINCT from rjs (ID 649): rjz = active punishment, rjs = defilement.
meaning.ar: الرجز: العذاب — فأرسلنا عليهم الرجز — رجز

meaning.en: Low, lowest, below. 10 occurrences. Asfal (8x) = lowest - the lowest of the low (asfala safilin, 95:5). Safil (1x) = lower. Siflah (1x) = lowest part.
meaning.ar: السفل: ضد العلو - أسفل سافلين

meaning.en: Black; sovereignty, chiefdom. 10 occurrences. Aswad (7x) = black. Sayyid (3x) = chief/master - and they found her master present (sayyidaha, 12:25). NOTE: s-w-d has two meanings: blackness + sovereignty (sayyid).
meaning.ar: السواد: اللون - أسود - سيدها

meaning.en: To draw near, approach; close portions. 10 occurrences. Zulfa (4x) = close/near approach. Zulaf (2x) = portions - and establish prayer at the approach of night (zulafan min al-layl, 11:114).
meaning.ar: الزلف: القرب - زلفى - زلفا من الليل

meaning.en: To cease, depart, remove; to be separated. 10 occurrences. Zala (I, 10x) = to cease/be removed. They will not cease differing (la yazaluna mukhtalifin, 11:118). NOTE: distinct from z-w-l which also means to cease but is a different root shape.
meaning.ar: الزيل: المفارقة - لا يزالون مختلفين

meaning.en: To walk about, stroll; open space. 9 occurrences. Abaha (I, 9x) = to walk about/stroll. And they walked about in their dwellings (fa-abahu fi masakinihim, 27:18 - Queen of Sheba story).
meaning.ar: الأبح: المشي - فأبحوا في مساكنهم

meaning.en: To cross, traverse; tears; interpretation. 9 occurrences. Abara (I, 3x) = to cross/traverse. Abrah (3x) = a tear. Itibar (VIII, 3x) = to take lesson - so take a lesson, O people of vision (fa-tabiru ya uli al-absar, 59:2).
meaning.ar: العبرة: الانتقال - فاعتبروا يا أولي الأبصار - عبرة

meaning.en: To devote oneself, stay/retreat in worship. 9 occurrences. Akafa (I, 9x) = to stay/devote. While you are devoted in the mosques (wa-antum akifuna fi al-masajid, 2:187 - itikaf in Ramadan).
meaning.ar: العكوف: الإقامة - وأنتم عاكفون في المساجد

meaning.en: Neck; yoke (slavery). 9 occurrences. Unuq (9x) = neck. Every person fate We have fastened to his neck (wa-kulla insanin alzamnahu tairahu fi unuqihi, 17:13).
meaning.ar: العنق: الرقبة - في عنقه - أعناق

meaning.en: To ascend, mount, rise. 9 occurrences. Araja (I, 2x) = to ascend. The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him (taruju al-malaikatu wa al-ruhu ilayhi, 70:4). Miraj (2x) = ascension.
meaning.ar: العرج: الصعود - تعرج الملائكة والروح إليه

meaning.en: Crookedness, curvature; deviation. 9 occurrences. Iwaj (5x) = crookedness. An Arabic Quran without any crookedness (quranan arabiyyan ghayra dhi iwajin, 39:28). A waj (3x) = crooked. NOT same as l-w-y which is to twist/bend.
meaning.ar: العوج: الانحراف - قرآنا عربيا غير ذي عوج

meaning.en: Year. 9 occurrences. Am (9x) = year. And he remained among them a thousand years (fa-labi-tha fihim alfa sanatin illa khamsina aman, 29:14 - Noah lived 950 years). Distinct from sanah (س ن و) which is also year but am often implies a more difficult year.
meaning.ar: العام: السنة - فلبث فيهم ألف سنة إلا خمسين عاما

meaning.en: To resolve firmly, determine; incantation. 9 occurrences. Azama (I, 7x) = to determine/resolve firmly. And determine your affair (fa-ajmiu amrakum, 10:71). Azaim (2x) = incantations/charms - and from the evil of those who blow on knots (al-azzamat, 113:4 in some readings).
meaning.ar: العزم: القصد المؤكد - فاجمعوا أمركم - عزائم

meaning.en: Ornament, jewelry, adornment. 9 occurrences. Hilyah (9x) = ornament/jewelry. And you extract from it ornaments you wear (wa-tastakhrijuna hilyatan talbasunaha, 35:12 - from the sea). Earthly and heavenly adornment.
meaning.ar: الحلية: الزينة - وتستخرجون حلية تلبسونها

meaning.en: To burn, set on fire. 9 occurrences. Haraqa (I, 3x) = to burn. Hariq (3x) = burning fire. Ihraq (IV, 2x) = to burn completely. Muharraq (1x) = burned. He said I will burn him (la-uharriqannahu, 20:97 - Moses to the golden calf).
meaning.ar: الحرق: الإحراق - لأحرقنه - حريق

meaning.en: To ascend, climb with difficulty. 9 occurrences. Sa ida (I, 2x) = to ascend/climb. Sa ad (3x) = ascent/hardship. Sa id (2x) = elevated/uphill. Tasa ad (V, 2x) = to climb with difficulty. I shall make him endure an uphill climb (sa-ur-hiquhu sa udan, 74:17 - no easy exit for the stubborn).
meaning.ar: الصعود: الارتقاء بمشقة - سأرهقه صعودا

meaning.en: Page, sheet, scroll; scriptures. 9 occurrences. Suhuf (5x) = scriptures/pages. Sahifah (3x) = page/sheet. The scriptures of Abraham and Moses (suhufu Ibrahima wa-Musa, 87:19).
meaning.ar: الصحف: الأوراق المكتوبة - صحف إبراهيم وموسى

meaning.en: Cow, cattle. 9 occurrences. Baqarah (9x) = cow. And when Moses said to his people: Allah commands you to slaughter a cow (inna Allaha yamurukum an tabahu baqaratan, 2:67). Surah 2 named after it.
meaning.ar: البقر: الماشية - إن الله يأمركم أن تذبحوا بقرة

meaning.en: To come out, emerge, appear. 9 occurrences. Baraza (I, 4x) = to come out/emerge. When they appear before their Lord (idha barazu li-rabbihim, 14:21). Bariz (1x) = open/apparent. Barzakh (3x) = barrier/isthmus (23:100 - between death and resurrection).
meaning.ar: البروز: الظهور - برزوا لربهم - برزخ

meaning.en: To settle, assign a place, prepare an abode. 9 occurrences. Bawwa a (II, 9x) = to settle/assign a dwelling. And We settled the Children of Israel in a secure dwelling (wa-bawwa na Bani Israila mubawwa a sidqin, 10:93). And We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (wa-idh bawwa na li-Ibrahima makana al-Bayt, 22:26).
meaning.ar: التبوئة: الإنزال - وبوأنا لبني إسرائيل مبوأ صدق

meaning.en: To disperse, scatter; silver. 9 occurrences. Infaḍḍa (VII, 5x) = to disperse/scatter. And if they see commerce or amusement they disperse to it (wa-idha raaw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddu ilayha, 62:11 - Friday prayer). Fiḍḍah (4x) = silver - and vessels of silver (akwabin kānat qawarīrā, 76:15).
meaning.ar: الفض: التفرق - انفضوا إليها - فضة

meaning.en: This root denotes To open relieve. Its 9 Quranic occurrences (e.g., 21:91, 23:5, 24:30) illustrate the concept in contexts ranging from divine action to human responsibility.
meaning.ar: فَرِجَ: انْفَرَجَ. الْفَرَجُ: زَوَالُ الْهَمِّ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفَاءُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالْجِيمُ أَصْلَانِ: الْفَرَجُ

quran_examples.en: Our houses are exposed
quran_examples.context: Hypocrites' excuses

hadith.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «كُلُّ سُلَامَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ»
hadith.en: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Every joint of a person has a charity due upon it each day the sun rises."

shades.explanation: Root meaning: To open relieve.

meaning.en: This root expresses To overflow and appears 8 times in the Quran. It is attested in classical lexicons (Ibn Faris, Lisan al-Arab) and contributes to the human condition vocabulary.
meaning.ar: فَاضَ: كَثُرَ. الْفَيْضُ: الْكَثْرَةُ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْفَاءُ وَالْيَاءُ وَالضَّادُ أَصْلَانِ: السَّيَلَانُ

quran_examples.ar: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ
quran_examples.en: This is a crowd entering with you; no welcome for them
quran_examples.context: Hell

hadith.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ»
hadith.en: Abdullah ibn Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in heaven will have mercy upon you."

shades.explanation: Root meaning: To overflow.

meaning.en: This root expresses To acquire booty and appears 9 times in the Quran. It is attested in classical lexicons (Ibn Faris, Lisan al-Arab) and contributes to the human condition vocabulary.
meaning.ar: غَنِمَ: أَصَابَ. الْغَنِيمَةُ: مَالُ الْعَدُوِّ

lexical_analysis.ibn_faris: الْغَيْنُ وَالنُّونُ وَالْمِيمُ أَصْلَانِ: الْفَوْزُ

quran_examples.en: They ask you about the spoils of war
quran_examples.context: Surah al-Anfal

hadith.ar: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ»

meaning.en: The root ألم is a well-attested triliteral root in classical Arabic appearing 75 times in the Quran. Its core semantic field is documented in the classical Arabic lexicographic tradition — Ibn Faris (Maqayis al-Lugha) identifies its fundamental meaning, al-Raghib al-Isfahani (Mufradat Alfaz al-Qur'an) analyzes its Quranic usage, and Ibn Manzur (Lisan al-Arab) provides comprehensive attestation across the Arabic literary record. The root's semantic range in the Quran encompasses its full classical lexical field. Consult the classical sources for authoritative analysis.

meaning.en: The root ḥāʾ-wāw-lām (ح-و-ل) fundamentally denotes a change of state and an encompassing around something. It conveys two core ideas: (1) transformation, alteration, and shifting from one condition to another; (2) the power, stratagem, or means by which one encompasses or circumvents a matter. In the Quran, this root yields the words for 'state/condition' (ḥāl), 'year' (ḥawl — the full cycle), 'power/stratagem' (ḥīlah), and the preposition 'around' (ḥawla). It captures both the dynamic nature of existence and the divine omnipotence that surrounds all creation.
meaning.ar: الْحَاءُ وَالْوَاوُ وَاللَّامُ أَصْلَانِ: أَحَدُهُمَا تَغَيُّرُ الشَّيْءِ عَنْ حَالِهِ، وَالْآخَرُ الْإِحَاطَةُ بِالشَّيْءِ. فَالْأَوَّلُ: حَالَ الشَّيْءُ يَحُولُ حَوْلًا وَحُئُولًا إِذَا تَغَيَّرَ.

In the Quran, it appears in contexts of mountains being removed (zawāl), and the idea that nothing in this world is permanent except the face of Allah.

The core sense involves a burning indignation that may lead to punitive action. The Quran uses this root for divine wrath against those who reject truth.

The core sense involves a thing that passes through narrow channels or openings, whether literal venom or metaphorical malice. The word 'samm' refers to the eye of a needle as well as poison.

The Quran uses this root for the shedding of blood ('safḥ al-dimāʾ'), a grave act of violence and injustice.
meaning.ar: السِّينُ وَالْفَاءُ وَالْحَاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى السَّيَلَانِ وَالِانْصِبَابِ. يُقَالُ: سَفَحَ الدَّمْعَ وَالدَّمَ يَسْفَحُهُ سَفْحًا، إِذَا صَبَّهُ. وَسَفَحَ الْمَاءَ: صَبَّهُ.

meaning.en: The root rāʾ-tāʾ-lām (ر-ت-ل) fundamentally denotes orderly arrangement and measured recitation. It conveys the idea of things being set in proper sequence, neatly arrayed, or delivered with deliberate, well-spaced articulation. The core sense involves clarity through order — whether of teeth in a beautiful mouth or words in measured Quranic recitation. The command 'wa rattil al-qurʾān tartīlā' (73:4) is foundational to Quranic recitation.

It conveys movement upward, whether literally climbing a ladder or stairs, or metaphorically progressing in rank, status, or spiritual station. The core sense involves incremental elevation toward a higher plane. It also encompasses the practice of spiritual healing and incantation (ruqyah).

meaning.en: The root sīn-ḥāʾ-tāʾ (س-ح-ت) fundamentally denotes consuming unlawfully, ill-gotten gains, and that which is forbidden. It conveys the idea of wealth obtained through corrupt means — bribery, usury, fraud — and the act of consuming or destroying such wealth. The core sense involves the obliteration of blessing from that which was acquired unjustly. The Quran commands: 'lā taʾkulū amwālakum baynakum bil-bāṭil' and condemns 'suḥt' (illicit gain).
meaning.ar: السِّينُ وَالْحَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى قَطْعِ الشَّيْءِ وَاسْتِئْصَالِهِ. يُقَالُ: سَحَتَهُ يَسْحَتُهُ سَحْتًا، إِذَا قَشَرَهُ وَأَذْهَبَهُ.

The core sense involves departure and transition — the movement from one station of life to another, culminating in the final journey toward the Hereafter.

The Quran uses this root for the most contemptible state of life ('ardhal al-ʿumur' — the feeblest stage of old age).

It conveys the act of severing or paring something down, particularly the trimming of nails and the cutting of pens. The core sense involves precise removal of excess or protrusion. The Quran uses this root for those who carved dwellings out of mountains, a mark of advanced civilization and arrogance.

meaning.en: The root lām-mīm-zāy (ل-م-ز) fundamentally denotes defaming, backbiting, and taunting. The Quran uses this root for futile arguments against the truth ('ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun'), which collapse upon scrutiny.

The core sense involves conspicuous elevation — whether a physical tower that dominates the landscape or a statement that is plain and unambiguous. The Quranic 'ṣarḥ' appears in the story of Pharaoh, who commissioned Haman to build a tower to reach the heavens — a symbol of arrogant defiance.
meaning.ar: الصَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ وَالْحَاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الظُّهُورِ وَالْبَيَانِ. فَالصَّرْحُ: الْبِنَاءُ الظَّاهِرُ الْمُرْتَفِعُ. وَالصَّرِيحُ: الْخَالِصُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.

The core sense involves something burning hot or transformed through heat. The Quran describes human creation from 'ḥamaʾin masnūn' — altered black mud — linking our origin to the transmutation of earth.

meaning.en: The root ʿayn-wāw-rāʾ (ع-و-ر) fundamentally denotes a defect, blemish, and that which is flawed or deficient. By extension, it refers to any shameful aspect or vulnerable point ('ʿawrah') — that which must be covered or protected from exposure.

The core sense involves the absence of clear, intelligible communication. The word 'aʿjamī' refers to a non-Arab, and 'ʿajam' is the collective term for non-Arab peoples, reflecting the Quranic emphasis on Arabic as the language of clear revelation.

meaning.en: The root ghayn-wāw-rāʾ (غ-و-ر) fundamentally denotes depth, penetration, and sinking into something. It conveys the act of going deep into the earth, whether for water (a well or spring) or for concealment (a cave). The core sense involves submerging beneath the surface and the hidden resources found there. The Quran uses 'ghawr' for water that sinks deep into the earth, beyond human reach without divine permission.
meaning.ar: الْغَيْنُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الْغُمُوضِ وَالدُّخُولِ. مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْغَارُ، وَهُوَ الْكَهْفُ، وَالْجَمْعُ غِيرَانٌ.

meaning.en: The root ṭāʾ-wāw-qāf (ط-و-ق) fundamentally denotes a collar, capacity, and that which encircles or encompasses. It conveys the idea of something that surrounds — whether a physical necklace, the collar of a garment, or metaphorically, one's ability or capacity to bear something. The core sense involves encirclement and containment. The Quran proclaims: 'lā yukallifu Allāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā' — a foundational principle that Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity ('ṭāqah').

meaning.en: The triliteral root kāf-ʿayn-bā (ك ع ب) in classical Arabic lexicography centers on the concept of swelling, rising, or protruding. Ibn Fāris (مقاييس اللغة) defines its core as 'any elevated or prominent thing' (كُلُّ شَيْءٍ ارْتَفَعَ وَبَرَزَ). This root encompasses both physical protrusions (like the ankle bone or a woman's breast) and abstract notions of completion, maturity, and fullness. In pre-Islamic and early Islamic usage, it also carried connotations of youthfulness, freshness, and the peak of beauty, often applied to young women whose breasts have begun to swell (كواعب). The root's semantic field thus bridges the concrete (anatomical landmarks) and the metaphorical (ripeness, perfection, and the ideal state of being)

meaning.en: The root s-m-r (س-م-ر) primarily conveys the concept of nighttime conversation, storytelling, or social interaction that occurs after dark. In classical Arabic lexicography, it denotes the act of talking or narrating tales during the night, often in a gathering. Ibn Faris (مقاييس اللغة) identifies the core meaning as 'conversation at night' (الحديث بالليل), while Al-Raghib al-Isfahani (المفردات) links it to the idea of 'keeping company at night' (المؤانسة بالليل). The root also extends to the notion of 'being awake at night' (السهر) and 'the night itself' (السمر). In pre-Islamic and early Islamic Arabia, night gatherings (السمر) were a common social practice where poetry, stories, and news were exchanged, often around a fire. The Quranic usage in 23:67:3 reflects this cultural context, where the disbelievers are described as 'conversing by night' (سَـٰمِرًا) in mockery of the Prophet and the Quran

meaning.en: The root hāʾ-nūn-hamza (ه-ن-أ) fundamentally denotes happiness, contentment, and that which is pleasant and wholesome. It conveys the state of satisfaction and well-being, particularly with regard to what one consumes or experiences. The core sense involves delight without harm — food that is 'hanīʾan' is both nutritious and delicious, carrying no ill effects. The Quran uses this word for the provisions of Paradise and permissible worldly sustenance.

meaning.en: The root dāl-lām-wāw (د-ل-و) fundamentally denotes a bucket, letting down, and drawing up water. It conveys the act of lowering a vessel into a well to draw water and the instrument used for this purpose. The core sense involves a cyclical process of descent and ascent — lowering to acquire and raising to deliver. Metaphorically, 'adlā' means to present or offer (as one lowers a bucket), and 'dālīyah' refers to the bucket itself.

meaning.en: The root nūn-mīm-lām (ن-م-ل) fundamentally denotes ants, small creeping creatures, and by extension, meticulous activity. It conveys the idea of numerous small beings moving in orderly, industrious patterns. The core sense involves organized collective labor at a minute scale. Surat al-Naml (The Ant) derives its name from the ant that warned its community of Solomon's approaching army — a powerful symbol of communication, community, and divine wisdom present in the smallest of creatures.

The core sense involves encirclement and adherence — whether the necklace that wraps the neck or the tradition that binds the mind. The Quran condemns blind imitation ('taqlīd') of forefathers when they were not guided.

meaning.en: The root ṣād-dāl-rāʾ (ص-د-ر) fundamentally denotes the chest, issuing forth, and returning. It conveys three interconnected ideas: (1) the chest as the locus of inner thoughts and emotions; (2) the act of going out or issuing forth from a place; (3) the act of returning home. The core sense involves what is within coming outward and what departed returning. The Quran speaks of the 'ṣudūr' (chests/hearts) as the seat of secrets and faith.

meaning.en: The root sīn-fāʾ-nūn (س-ف-ن) fundamentally denotes a ship, vessel, and the act of shaping or smoothing wood. It conveys the craft of shipbuilding and the vessel that traverses the sea. The core sense involves the transformation of raw timber into a water-worthy craft — a symbol of human ingenuity and divine guidance. The Quran repeatedly invokes ships ('sufun') as signs of Allah's mercy, carrying people and goods across the seas.
meaning.ar: سفن: السفينة فعيلة من سفن, وهي مراكب البحر. السفينة: كل ما يحمل عليه الماء من خشب وغيره. قال الله تعالى: حتى إذا ركبا في السفينة خرقها.

The core sense involves deceptive aestheticization — a psychological seduction that distorts moral perception. The Quran attributes this to Satan: 'al-shayṭānu sawwala lahum' — Satan made their deeds fair-seeming to them — a warning that evil often wears a pleasing guise.

meaning.en: The root zāy-bāʾ-dāl (ز-ب-د) fundamentally denotes foam, froth, and the scum that rises to the surface of liquid. It conveys the waste material that floats atop a boiling or agitated liquid, as well as the cream or butter that rises to the top of milk. The core sense involves what is separated and cast aside during purification. The Quran uses the metaphor of 'zabad' — the froth that passes away — to describe falsehood: it rises briefly and is then discarded, while what benefits people remains.

It conveys the act of making one's voice quiet and gentle, whether out of humility before Allah, fear, or secrecy. The core sense involves controlled, measured expression — the discipline of not raising one's voice beyond what is appropriate. The Quran commands: 'wa aghḍuḍ min ṣawtika' — lower your voice — linking vocal restraint to spiritual refinement.

meaning.en: The root wāw-thāʾ-nūn (و-ث-ن) fundamentally denotes an idol, a graven image, and a stationary object of worship. It conveys the concept of a physical object set up for veneration, immobile and inanimate, in contrast to the living God. The core sense involves something fixed and lifeless that is wrongly elevated to divine status. The Quran consistently condemns 'awthān' as the epitome of false worship, contrasting the Creator who acts with the lifeless objects that cannot respond.
meaning.ar: (وَثَنَ) الْوَاوُ وَالثَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى النَّصْبِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ. وَالْوَثَنُ: الصَّنَمُ، سُمِّيَ بِذَلِكَ لِنَصْبِهِ وَإِقَامَتِهِ لِلْعِبَادَةِ.

meaning.en: The root khāʾ-dhāl-lām (خ-ذ-ل) fundamentally denotes forsaking, abandoning, and failing to support when support is needed. It conveys the act of withdrawing help at a critical moment, leaving someone isolated and vulnerable. The core sense involves betrayal through desertion — the failure of an ally, friend, or even one's own faculties at the moment of greatest need. The Quran attributes ultimate aid to Allah alone, warning that any other helper may 'yakhdhul' (forsake) when most needed.

It conveys the subtle, instinctive detection of something — often danger — that arises within the heart before the mind fully registers it. The core sense involves an intuitive, pre-cognitive awareness that manifests as an internal tremor. The Quran uses this root for Moses' sense of fear when he perceived the magicians' threat.

This root appears in Quranic descriptions of destroyed civilizations and serves as a warning of divine punishment against obstinate disbelievers.

It conveys the idea of water flowing across the earth's surface and, by extension, the spiritual practice of wandering the land in devotion and reflection. It conveys the structuring of information into ordered lines — whether written lines on a page, aligned trees in an orchard, or narratives set in sequence. The core sense involves deliberate arrangement and inscription. The Quran uses 'saṭara' and 'yusṭarūna' for the writing of deeds in the divine record, linking every human action to a meticulously maintained ledger.

meaning.en: The root sīn-lām-khāʾ (س-ل-خ) fundamentally denotes stripping, peeling away, and emerging from. It conveys the act of removing a covering or outer layer, like an animal shedding its skin or a snake sloughing its old form. The core sense involves the separation of what was once attached — the shedding of the old to reveal or become something new. The Quran uses this root for the day emerging from the night as if stripped from it — a powerful image of transformation.

meaning.en: The root sīn-lām-wāw (س-ل-و) fundamentally denotes forgetting, consoling, and being distracted from grief. It conveys the gradual process by which sorrow, worry, or attachment fades from the heart, replaced by what brings comfort and peace. The core sense involves the healing passage of time and the replacement of pain with contentment. The word 'salwā' refers to the quails sent as divine provision to the Israelites — food that brought both sustenance and consolation.

meaning.en: The root sīn-jīm-rāʾ (س-ج-ر) fundamentally denotes kindling, filling to the brim, and the merging of waters. It conveys two primary ideas: (1) the fueling and intensifying of a fire; (2) the filling and overflowing of seas, with the eschatological image of oceans being set ablaze. The core sense involves overwhelming fullness and intensity. The Quran swears by 'al-baḥr al-masjūr' — the sea set ablaze — a sign of the cosmic upheaval of the Last Day.

meaning.en: The root rāʾ-mīm-nūn (ر-م-ن) fundamentally denotes the pomegranate, the fruit with its jewel-like seeds. The core sense involves a naturally structured wonder — the pomegranate with its orderly chambers of edible seeds. The Quran names it as one of the fruits of Paradise and a sign of divine artistry in nature: 'fīhimā fākihatun wa nakhlu wa rummān' — in both gardens are fruits, date palms, and pomegranates.

The core sense involves dynamic, profitable movement — the rapid flow of what has value. The root underlies the concept of commercial vitality and the spread of influence in society.

It conveys the act of gathering things into a mound or stack, layer upon layer, whether clouds piled high in the sky, stones heaped together, or wealth accumulated over time. The core sense involves stratified aggregation — the building of mass through successive accumulation. The Quran uses 'rukāman' for clouds that pile up before releasing rain.

It conveys the concept of something given in trust as a guarantee for an obligation. The core sense involves binding commitment — something held to ensure fulfillment. The Quran declares: 'kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīna' — every soul is held in pledge for what it has earned — a profound statement of personal accountability on the Day of Judgment.

It conveys the idea of a small collective, typically of men, bound by kinship or common purpose, fewer than a larger tribe but more than a single family. The core sense involves close-knit, loyal association. The Quran uses 'rahṭ' for the band of Prophet Lot's people who came demanding his guests — a group mobilized for evil.

meaning.en: The root rāʾ-ghayn-dāl (ر-غ-د) fundamentally denotes ease, abundance, and comfortable living. It conveys the state of having ample provisions and living without hardship or scarcity. The core sense involves pleasant, effortless prosperity. The Quran uses 'raghadan' for the life of ease that Adam and Eve enjoyed in Paradise before the fall, and for the blessed lands that Allah provides: 'kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum' — eat from the good things We have provided.

meaning.en: The root qāf-rāʾ-ḥāʾ (ق-ر-ح) fundamentally denotes a wound, ulcer, and that which is raw or painful. It conveys the idea of an injury that penetrates the skin, causing pain and requiring healing. The core sense involves an open, sensitive sore — an affliction that tests endurance. The Quran uses this root metaphorically for the wounds that the Muslim community experienced in battle: 'in yamsaskum qarḥun' — if a wound touches you — teaching that hardship is reciprocal and tests resolve.

meaning.en: The root rāʾ-dāl-fāʾ (ر-د-ف) fundamentally denotes following closely, riding behind, and coming in succession. It conveys the quality of looking vibrant, well-nourished, and full of life — whether the blooming of plants, the brightness of a face, or the splendor of gold. The core sense involves a luminous, appealing vitality. The Quran promises the righteous 'wuḍūʾan nāḍiratan' — shining, radiant faces — that glow with the joy of divine pleasure.
meaning.ar: النُّونُ وَالضَّادُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الْحُسْنِ وَالْبَهْجَةِ وَالنَّضَارَةِ. يُقَالُ: نَضَرَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ، أَيْ حَسَّنَهُ وَنَوَّرَهُ.

meaning.en: The root nūn-hamza-yāʾ (ن-أ-ي) fundamentally denotes distance, remoteness, and being far away. It conveys the spatial and emotional concept of separation — something being far removed from reach or connection. The core sense involves a gulf or barrier that separates. The Quran uses this root for those who distance themselves from guidance: 'wa hum yanhawna ʿanhu wa yanʾawna ʿanhu' — they forbid others from it and they themselves keep far from it — describing hypocrites who reject truth and keep others from it.

meaning.en: The root mīm-zāy-jīm (م-ز-ج) fundamentally denotes mixing, blending, and combining. It conveys the act of fusing different substances together to create a unified compound, particularly the mixing of wine with water or other ingredients. The core sense involves harmonious combination — the creation of something new through the blending of distinct elements. The Quran uses this root for the drink of paradise, mixed ('mizāj') with the water of Tasnīm — a divine blend of supreme delight.

meaning.en: The root mīm-tāʾ-nūn (م-ت-ن) fundamentally denotes firmness, solidity, and the backbone. It conveys the quality of being strong, durable, and resistant to breaking — whether a physical structure, a well-constructed argument, or the spine that supports the body. The core sense involves structural integrity and strength. The word 'matīn' is a divine attribute: 'inna Allāha huwa al-razzāqu dhū al-quwwati al-matīn' — Indeed Allah is the Provider, Possessor of firm strength.
meaning.ar: الْمِيمُ وَالتَّاءُ وَالنُّونُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الْقُوَّةِ وَالشِّدَّةِ. وَالْمَتْنُ: مَا صَلُبَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَارْتَفَعَ. وَمَتْنُ الْإِنْسَانِ: ظَهْرُهُ.

meaning.en: The root mīm-rāʾ-ḥāʾ (م-ر-ح) fundamentally denotes joy, exuberance, and exultation that can lead to arrogance. It conveys a state of intense delight and spiritedness — happiness that brims over — but with an edge of heedless, excessive self-satisfaction that may cause one to forget one's place. The core sense involves levity that borders on pride. The Quran warns: 'lā tamshi fī al-arḍi maraḥan' — do not walk on the earth with exultant pride — cautioning against the arrogance that can accompany joy.

meaning.en: The root mīm-ḥāʾ-wāw (م-ح-و) fundamentally denotes effacing, erasing, and obliterating. It conveys the act of removing something that was once present — wiping away writing from a page, clearing a mark, or nullifying a record. The core sense involves complete removal, leaving no trace behind. The Quran declares: 'yamḥū Allāhu mā yashāʾu wa yuthbitu' — Allah effaces what He wills and confirms what He wills — a profound statement of divine sovereignty over decree and destiny.
meaning.ar: الْمِيمُ وَالْحَاءُ وَالْوَاوُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى إِذْهَابِ شَيْءٍ وَإِزَالَتِهِ. يُقَالُ: مَحَوْتُ الشَّيْءَ أَمْحُوهُ مَحْوًا، إِذَا أَذْهَبْتَ أَثَرَهُ.

meaning.en: The root mīm-ḍād-ghayn (م-ض-غ) fundamentally denotes chewing, mastication, and the morsel of flesh that is chewed. It conveys the act of grinding food between the teeth and, by extension, the small bolus of chewed matter. The core sense involves the processing and transformation of substance. The Quran uses 'muḍgha' for the embryonic stage — a chewed-like lump of flesh — in its remarkable description of human development in the womb.

meaning.en: The root mīm-wāw-rāʾ (م-و-ر) fundamentally denotes agitation, tumultuous movement, and seething. It conveys the idea of violent, chaotic motion — the churning of a stormy sea, the convulsion of an earthquake, or the swirling of a crowd. The core sense involves intense, turbulent energy. The Quran uses this root in eschatological contexts: 'yawma tamūru al-samāʾu mawran' — the Day when the heaven will sway with a circular motion — describing cosmic upheaval.
meaning.ar: الْمِيمُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالرَّاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الْحَرَكَةِ وَالِاضْطِرَابِ. يُقَالُ: مَارَ الشَّيْءُ يَمُورُ مَوْرًا إِذَا تَحَرَّكَ وَجَاءَ وَذَهَبَ.

meaning.en: The root lām-qāf-fāʾ (ل-ق-ف) fundamentally denotes snatching, seizing quickly, and swallowing. It conveys the act of grabbing something suddenly and often consuming it — like a predator snatching prey. The core sense involves rapid, decisive capture. The Quran uses this root in the story of Moses and the magicians: 'talqafu mā ṣanʿū' — it swallows what they have fabricated — when Moses' staff devoured the magicians' illusions, unmasking their falsehood.
meaning.ar: اللَّامُ وَالْقَافُ وَالْفَاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَخْذِ الشَّيْءِ وَابْتِلَاعِهِ بِسُرْعَةٍ. يُقَالُ: لَقِفَ الشَّيْءَ يَلْقَفُهُ لَقْفًا، إِذَا ابْتَلَعَهُ.

It conveys the act of turning away from, ignoring, or treating something as beneath consideration. The core sense involves dismissal through inattention — the refusal to engage with that which is deemed worthless. This root appears in Quranic contexts where disbelievers are characterized by their casual rejection of divine signs, treating revelation as something to be ignored rather than contemplated.

meaning.en: The root lām-dhāl-dhāl (ل-ذ-ذ) fundamentally denotes pleasure, delight, and sweetness of experience. It conveys the sensory and emotional enjoyment that comes from something pleasant — the taste of delicious food, the feeling of comfort, or the joy of companionship. The core sense involves agreeable, satisfying experience that the soul finds delightful. The Quran uses 'ladhdhah' in the context of the pleasures and comforts of worldly life, which the believer must not allow to distract from higher purpose.

It conveys the act of causing something or someone to deviate from a course or to look in another direction. The core sense involves redirection and distraction — the subtle pulling of attention away from what it should be focused on. The Quran uses this root to describe how disbelievers attempt to divert believers from the path of truth.
meaning.ar: اللَّامُ وَالْفَاءُ وَالتَّاءُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى صَرْفِ الشَّيْءِ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، يُقَالُ: لَفَتَهُ يَلْفِتُهُ لَفْتًا، إِذَا صَرَفَهُ.

meaning.en: The root kāf-wāw-rāʾ (ك-و-ر) fundamentally denotes winding, wrapping, and rolling up. It conveys the act of coiling something around itself — like a turban wound around the head — or the cyclical rotation of night and day. The core sense involves cyclical envelopment and transformation. The Quran declares: 'yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā al-nahār' — He wraps the night over the day — a majestic image of the cosmic cycles under divine control.

meaning.en: The root jīm-yāʾ-bāʾ (ج-ي-ب) fundamentally denotes a pocket, collar, and opening in a garment. meaning.en: The root jīm-wāw-wāw (ج-و-و) fundamentally denotes interior, cavity, and atmosphere. It conveys the idea of the inner space of something — the hollow of a valley, the interior of a house, or the air and atmosphere that surrounds the earth. The core sense involves enclosed or enveloping space. The word 'jaww' refers to the atmosphere, the sky, or any interior expanse. The Quran uses this root for the atmospheric domain and the inner dimensions of existence.
meaning.ar: الْجِيمُ وَالثَّاءُ وَالْوَاوُ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى الْجُلُوسِ عَلَى الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ. يُقَالُ: جَثَا يَجْثُو جُثُوًّا، وَجَثَى يَجْثِي جَثْيًا، وَالْجَاثِي: الْجَالِسُ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ
